content: # Sindh High Court Personal Assistant Shorthand Test Schedule 2026 — 24 October Reporting Details
## Official Recruitment Test Notice: High Court of Sindh, Karachi

The **High Court of Sindh, Principal Seat, Karachi**, has officially issued the schedule and instructions for the **Shorthand Test** for recruitment to the posts of **Personal Assistant to Judge / Personal Assistant to Officer (BPS-17)**.

Verified directly on the official [Sindh High Court Jobs Portal](https://sindhhighcourt.gov.pk/jobs.php) on 22 October 2026, this test is organized for **195 shortlisted candidates** who successfully passed the initial MCQs-based screening examination conducted by **SIBA Testing Services (STS)**.
## Quick Facts & Schedule Table

| Attribute | Verified Official Detail |
|---|---|
| **Testing Authority** | High Court of Sindh, Principal Seat, Karachi |
| **Position** | Personal Assistant to Judge / Officer (BPS-17) |
| **Test Type** | Shorthand / Dictation Speed Test |
| **Shortlisted Candidates** | **195 Candidates (STS Qualifiers)** |
| **Test Date** | **Saturday, 24 October 2026** |
| **Reporting Time** | **09:00 AM Sharp** |
| **Test Commences** | **10:00 AM Sharp (Entry strictly closed after 10:00 AM)** |
| **Test Venue** | **Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sabihuddin Block, High Court of Sindh, Principal Seat, Karachi** |
| **Official Notice URL** | [sindhhighcourt.gov.pk/jobs.php](https://sindhhighcourt.gov.pk/jobs.php) |

> [!CAUTION]
> **Strict Entry Cutoff at 10:00 AM**
> As per the official notification, candidate reporting starts at **09:00 AM**. No candidate will be allowed to enter the examination hall after the test begins at **10:00 AM** under any circumstances.
## Mandatory Candidate Instructions & Document Checklist

1. **Original Photo Identity Document:** Candidates must produce an **original, valid Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC)**, original Passport, or original valid Driving License at the entry gate. Photocopied or soft copies will not be accepted.
2. **Roll Number Clarification:** The **Serial Number (Sr. No.)** allocated in the final result list of the MCQs test issued by STS serves as the candidate's Roll Number for this shorthand test. This number must be written accurately on the test copy.
3. **Stationery & Clipboards:** Candidates must bring their own hard writing clipboards, lead pencils, sharpener, and ballpoint pens. Official test paper copies will be supplied by the Court.
4. **Electronic Devices Strictly Prohibited:** Mobile phones, smartwatches, recording devices, Bluetooth earphones, and calculators are strictly banned inside the test premises. Possession of any electronic gadget will result in immediate disqualification and legal proceedings.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Where will the shorthand test take place?**
At Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sabihuddin Block, High Court of Sindh, Principal Seat, Court Road, Karachi.

**Q2: What is the reporting time on 24 October 2026?**
Candidates must report at 09:00 AM. The test starts at 10:00 AM sharp.

**Q3: How many candidates are called for this shorthand test?**
A total of 195 candidates who qualified the STS screening test have been called.

title: SSGC Gasification Plan: 46 Sindh Villages in Sanghar & Shikarpur to Get Gas Grid Connections (Rs 1.92B Project)
shortDescription: Sui Southern Gas Company (SSGC) unveils Phase VI gasification plan allocating Rs 1.922 billion to lay 178.52 km pipeline networks across 46 villages near Bobi and Hassan gas fields in Sanghar and Shikarpur districts. Review coverage, budget sharing, and factual connection status.
content: # SSGC Gasification Plan: 46 Sindh Villages in Sanghar & Shikarpur to Get Gas Grid Connections (Rs 1.92B Project)
## Executive Summary & Official Project Verification

In line with Pakistan's statutory resource-benefit policy for communities residing near natural hydrocarbon fields, **Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGC)** has outlined an expansive **Rs 1.922 billion infrastructure gasification plan** targeting **46 villages and rural towns** across **Sanghar and Shikarpur districts** in Sindh province.

Formally designated as the **Sixth Phase Gasification Programme**, the project addresses historic demands by rural residents living in the immediate vicinity of major natural gas production fields. The project requires laying **178.52 kilometres of gas distribution pipeline networks**, bringing piped natural gas to approximately **2,710 prospective domestic consumers** across both districts.

Funding for the multi-billion-rupee infrastructure initiative is structured under an established government-utility cost-sharing mechanism:
- **Federal Government Development Share (~92%):** Rs 1.776 billion (Rs 1,776 million).
- **SSGC Institutional Capital Share (~8%):** Rs 146.34 million.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Planned Infrastructure (FY 2026–27 Implementation Schedule):**
> - **Executing Agency:** Sui Southern Gas Company Limited (SSGC).
> - **Total Outlay:** Rs 1,922.34 Million (Rs 1.922 Billion).
> - **Target Scope:** 46 Villages/Towns situated within a strict **5-kilometre radius** of producing gas fields in Sanghar and Shikarpur.
> - **Total Pipeline Network:** 178.52 Kilometres of high-grade steel and polyethylene distribution mains.
> - **Prospective Connections:** 2,710 Registered domestic meters.
> - **Factual Implementation Warning:** This project represents an approved engineering rollout and pipeline laying program scheduled across FY 2026–27. Physical pipe-laying and testing must precede individual household meter installations. Prospective consumers should **not** consider connections completed or pay unauthorized third-party middle-men.
## Quick Facts: SSGC Phase VI Gasification Programme

| PROJECT PARAMETER | SANGHAR DISTRICT (BOBI FIELD) | SHIKARPUR DISTRICT (HASSAN FIELD) | TOTAL CONSOLIDATED |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Associated Gas Field** | Bobi Gas Field | Hassan Gas Field | **2 Producing Fields** |
| **Eligible Villages/Towns** | **31 Villages** | **15 Villages** | **46 Villages & Towns** |
| **Pipeline Length (km)** | **132.40 km** | **46.12 km** | **178.52 Kilometres** |
| **Target Consumer Base** | **1,767 Households** | **943 Households** | **2,710 Consumers** |
| **Statutory Proximity** | Within 5 km Radius | Within 5 km Radius | **5 km Radial Policy** |
| **Total Phase Cost** | Pro-rata Allocation | Pro-rata Allocation | **Rs 1.922 Billion** |
| **Federal Funding** | ~92% Share | ~92% Share | **Rs 1.776 Billion** |
| **SSGC Funding** | ~8% Share | ~8% Share | **Rs 146.34 Million** |
| **Execution Schedule** | FY 2026–27 Rollout | FY 2026–27 Rollout | **Multi-Year Implementation** |
## District-by-District Coverage Analysis

### 1. Sanghar District (Bobi Gas Field Network)
Sanghar is one of Pakistan's key energy-producing basins, hosting extensive oil and gas processing complexes. Despite hosting the vital **Bobi gas field**, surrounding rural settlements have long depended on firewood and expensive LPG cylinders for domestic cooking.

Under SSGC's Phase VI program:
- **Coverage:** **31 villages and towns** situated within 5 km of the Bobi field.
- **Network Scope:** **132.40 kilometres** of distribution and transmission branch mains.
- **Household Reach:** Estimated **1,767 prospective domestic consumers** will be tied into the provincial distribution grid upon project completion.

### 2. Shikarpur District (Hassan Gas Field Network)
In Northern Sindh, communities located adjacent to the **Hassan gas field** in Shikarpur district have been slated for grid integration to fulfill statutory social uplift requirements.

Key parameters for Shikarpur:
- **Coverage:** **15 villages and towns**.
- **Network Scope:** **46.12 kilometres** of pipeline distribution lines.
- **Household Reach:** Approximately **943 prospective consumers** will receive metered natural gas supply.

## Statutory Background: The 5-Kilometre Gas Policy
Under Article 158 of the Constitution of Pakistan and the Federal Government's localized energy policy guidelines, local populations living within a **5-kilometre radius** of commercially producing wellheads carry priority rights to natural gas supply for domestic purposes.

Because laying extensive rural distribution mains involves high per-meter capital expenditures that cannot be fully amortized through domestic tariffs alone, the Federal Government finances approximately **92% (Rs 1.776 billion)** of the capital expenditure under special infrastructure development grants, with SSGC contributing **Rs 146.34 million** for technical design, pressure reduction stations, and metering infrastructure.

## Multi-Year Expansion Context (FY 2026 to FY 2029)
This Phase VI initiative forms part of SSGC's broader multi-year gasification roadmap running through FY 2028–29. Other ongoing and upcoming phases encompass rural villages in Matiari, Tando Muhammad Khan, Sujawal, and Ghotki near operational exploration blocks. The program aims to curb deforestation in rural Sindh, alleviate indoor air pollution from biomass combustion, and foster equitable socio-economic development across hydrocarbon-rich districts.
## Consumer Advisory & Safety Guidelines

> [!CAUTION]
> **Consumer Safety & Fraud Advisory:**
> 1. **No Cash to Agents:** SSGC does not appoint local village agents or private contractors to collect cash for 'gas sanction letters'. Official security deposits and meter fees are paid strictly through designated commercial bank challans or authorized digital banking channels following official notification.
> 2. **Pipeline Construction Phase:** Heavy excavation machinery and pipe welding crews will operate along designated village right-of-ways. Residents should maintain safe distances from pipeline trenches during construction.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Have domestic gas connections already been activated in these 46 villages?**
No. The project is currently in the approved engineering and procurement phase for FY 2026–27. Physical pipeline trenching, steel welding, testing, and pressure reduction station construction must occur before individual household service connections are commissioned.

**Q2: Which villages qualify under this specific project?**
Only villages and habitations falling within a certified 5-kilometre radius of the Bobi field in Sanghar and the Hassan field in Shikarpur are included under this Rs 1.922B package.

**Q3: How will residents apply for meters once pipelines are laid?**
Upon completion of distribution mains, SSGC will establish regional customer service facilitation desks where residents can submit formal domestic application forms with verified CNIC copies and proof of residence.

**Q4: Will industrial or commercial gas connections be allowed under this scheme?**
No. This specific government-subsidized capital allocation is strictly restricted to domestic rural household consumers to promote clean residential cooking energy.

title: Sindh Flood Housing Phase III: €115 Million EIB Financing Ratified by Provincial Cabinet (SPHF Reconstruction Update)
shortDescription: Sindh Cabinet ratifies €115 million foreign financing package from the European Investment Bank (EIB) (€100M loan + €15M grant) for Phase III of the Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) project. Review verified breakdown, female title ownership rules, and payment distinction.
content: # Sindh Flood Housing Phase III: €115 Million EIB Financing Ratified by Provincial Cabinet (SPHF Reconstruction Update)
## Executive Summary & Official Cabinet Ratification Verification

In a major advancement for the world's largest climate-resilient post-disaster housing reconstruction initiative, the **Sindh Provincial Cabinet**, presided over by Chief Minister **Syed Murad Ali Shah** on **20 October 2026**, officially ratified a foreign financing package amounting to **€115 million** (approximately Rs 34+ billion) provided by the **European Investment Bank (EIB)**.

This crucial capital injection is formally designated for **Phase III of the Sindh Flood Emergency Housing Reconstruction Project**, executed under the institutional framework of **Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF)**.

The financing package comprises two distinct structural components negotiated with international lending windows and vetted by Pakistan's Federal Economic Affairs Division (EAD):
1. **€100 Million Concessional Loan:** Soft-term developmental credit facility aimed at scaling construction material procurement and field technical validation.
2. **€15 Million Direct Grant Component:** Non-repayable technical assistance and community grant funding specifically earmarked for climate-resilience auditing, clean drinking water systems, and solar sanitation integration.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Financing Arrangements Reported (Operating Programme Ongoing):**
> - **Approved Funding:** €115 Million total (€100M Concessional Loan + €15M Direct Grant).
> - **International Partner:** European Investment Bank (EIB Global window) in coordination with Pakistan's Economic Affairs Division (EAD).
> - **Executing Agency:** Sindh People’s Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF), Government of Sindh.
> - **Distinction of Cabinet Action:** The 20 October 2026 cabinet decision represents provincial government ratification and sovereign sub-loan counter-guarantee approval; it follows earlier preliminary financing negotiations and advances Phase III execution.
> - **Strict Consumer Advisory:** This development does **not** constitute an open public cash disbursement, general unconditional relief grant, or new online application registration portal. Funding flows exclusively to already mapped, biometrically validated flood-affected rural households.
## Quick Facts: Sindh Flood Housing Phase III EIB Package

| PARAMETER | DETAILS & VERIFIED METRICS |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Initiative Name** | Sindh Flood Emergency Housing Reconstruction Project (Phase III) |
| **Institutional Vehicle** | Sindh People’s Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) |
| **Approving Authority** | Sindh Provincial Cabinet (Ratified 20 October 2026) |
| **Total Financing Volume** | **€115 Million** (Euro Hundred and Fifteen Million) |
| **Loan Component** | **€100 Million** (Concessional, Long-Tenure Facility from EIB) |
| **Grant Component** | **€15 Million** (Non-Repayable Climate & Technical Assistance Grant) |
| **Geographic Coverage** | 24 Flood-Impacted Districts Across Sindh Province |
| **Disbursement Architecture** | Tranche-based mobile bank accounts linked with NADRA biometric CNIC |
| **Ownership Mandate** | Official Land Title Deeds (Sanads) registered in female heads of household |
| **Official Portal** | [sphf.gos.pk](https://sphf.gos.pk/) |
## Understanding the €115M EIB Financing Structure

### 1. The Global Partnership (EIB Global & Government of Pakistan)
The European Investment Bank (EIB) is the long-term lending institution of the European Union. Under its dedicated external branch, **EIB Global**, the bank committed over €160 million to Pakistan's post-2022 flood recovery framework, encompassing municipal infrastructure in Karachi and rural resilient housing in Sindh.

The €115 million package ratified on 20 October represents the provincial legal operationalization of Phase III funding. The federal Economic Affairs Division (EAD) serves as the primary borrower, with funds on-lent to the Government of Sindh under established subsidiary loan agreements.

### 2. Breakdown: Loan vs. Grant Elements
- **€100 Million Loan Element:** Channels directly into housing construction subsidies. Rather than hiring central contractors, SPHF utilizes an **owner-driven reconstruction (ODR)** model where beneficiaries construct their own homes according to pre-approved, hazard-resistant engineering designs.
- **€15 Million Grant Element:** Funds essential non-structural resilience elements, including water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) infrastructure, solar home lightning units, environmental screening, and engineering oversight by partner non-governmental organizations (PPOs).
## How SPHF Housing Grants Are Actually Disbursed
To prevent misinformation, CareerDost reiterates the established operational mechanism governing SPHF disbursements:

1. **Biometric Field Validation:** SPHF surveyors mapped damage coordinates using satellite imagery and NADRA CNIC biometric validation during the comprehensive damage assessment following the 2022 monsoon calamity.
2. **Female Title Deed Issuance:** Over 800,000 landless rural residents are being awarded formal land titles (*Sanads*). Crucially, the Sindh Government mandates that title deeds and bank accounts are issued in the name of the **female head of household**.
3. **Milestone-Based Tranches:** Payments are not handed out in cash lump sums. Direct bank transfers are released across four distinct construction verification stages:
   - **Tranche 1 (Mobilization & Layout):** Released upon site clearance and foundation layout approval.
   - **Tranche 2 (Plinth Level):** Released after field engineering teams verify raised plinth construction above historical flood lines.
   - **Tranche 3 (Wall Lintel Level):** Released upon completion of reinforced masonry walls and lintel beams.
   - **Tranche 4 (Roof & Completion):** Final tranche disbursed upon successful installation of durable roofing, door frames, and sanitary latrines.
## Fraud Prevention: Guarding Against Online Scams

> [!CAUTION]
> **Public Safety Advisory — Beware of Fake Flood Grant Portals:**
> Neither the Government of Sindh nor SPHF charges any 'registration fee', 'form fee', or 'agent processing fee'. Any WhatsApp groups, Telegram channels, or social media posts advertising 'Apply online for €115M Flood Cash Relief' or asking for CNIC photos and bank PIN codes are fraudulent scams. Official verifications occur strictly through SPHF field monitoring teams and the official portal [sphf.gos.pk](https://sphf.gos.pk/).
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Can new flood-affected families register for Phase III grants now?**
No. SPHF Phase III funding is allocated to complete reconstruction for households already surveyed, cataloged, and verified under the post-2022 damage assessment database. No new open registration portal has been inaugurated.

**Q2: What is the monetary grant amount provided per home?**
Under the established SPHF owner-driven reconstruction guidelines, beneficiaries receive financial subsidies (typically up to Rs 300,000 paid in four verified milestone tranches) alongside building material support and technical oversight. For detailed tranche mechanics, read our [Complete SPHF Rs 300,000 Subsidy & Title Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-peoples-housing-flood-affectees-sphf-subsidy-guide-2026).

**Q3: Which districts benefit from Phase III?**
Phase III funding covers high-priority flood-affected districts across Southern, Central, and Northern Sindh, including Dadu, Khairpur, Mirpurkhas, Badin, Sanghar, Qambar Shahdadkot, Thatta, Sujawal, and Jacobabad.

**Q4: Why is EIB financing routed through SPHF rather than commercial builders?**
International development lenders mandate transparency, community ownership, and carbon-resilient reconstruction. SPHF's community-driven model with third-party digital monitoring ensures zero contractor kickbacks and direct economic empowerment for rural women homeowners.

title: SPSC CCE 2026 Examination Reforms: Upper Age Limit Raised to 33, 5 Attempts Allowed & 33% Screening Cutoff
shortDescription: Sindh Cabinet officially approves historic reforms for SPSC CCE 2026: upper age limit raised to 33 years, attempts increased to 5, screening test cutoff lowered to 33%, and computer-based testing approved. Review verified rules, gazette status, and syllabus impact.
content: # SPSC CCE 2026 Examination Reforms: Upper Age Limit Raised to 33, 5 Attempts Allowed & 33% Screening Cutoff
## Executive Summary & Official Cabinet Decision Verification

In a landmark policy intervention aimed at modernizing provincial civil service recruitment and addressing long-standing candidate grievances, the **Sindh Provincial Cabinet**, in its meeting held on **20 October 2026** under the chairmanship of Chief Minister **Syed Murad Ali Shah**, formally approved a comprehensive structural reform package for the **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC) Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)**.
The reform package fundamentally transforms candidate eligibility, qualifying thresholds, and examination administration for Sindh's flagship civil competitive examinations:

1. **Upper Age Limit Extension:** The general upper age limit has been enhanced from **30 years to 33 years** (providing a universal three-year relaxation for CCE aspirants).
2. **Permissible Attempt Increase:** The total number of lifetime attempts permissible for each candidate has been raised from **three (3) to five (5) attempts**.
3. **Lowered Screening Passing Benchmark:** The minimum qualifying marks threshold for the CCE preliminary screening test has been reduced from **40% down to 33%**, substantially widening the talent pool advancing to the written examination.
4. **Computer-Based Testing (CBT) Integration:** The cabinet sanctioned the rollout of automated, computer-based testing facilities for single-paper examinations with instant provisional score generation.
5. **FPSC Interview Alignment:** Interview and viva-voce marks are being restructured to conform with the Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) weightage ratio, eliminating subjective evaluation anomalies.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Status: Cabinet Approval Reported (Regulatory Statutory Notification Pending):**
> - **Approving Authority:** Sindh Provincial Cabinet (Meeting chaired by CM Syed Murad Ali Shah on 20 October 2026).
> - **Applicability:** Specifically designated for the **Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)** and general single-paper screening workflows.
> - **Critical Clarification:** These reforms do **not** apply automatically or retroactively to existing, closed advertisements or specialized technical recruitments such as [SPSC Advertisement 05/2026](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-jobs-2026-54-vacancies) which closes on 23 October 2026.
> - **Implementation Path:** Enactment requires formal amendment of the Sindh Public Service Commission (CCE Rules & Regulations) by the Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) through an official Sindh Government Gazette notification.
## Quick Facts: SPSC CCE 2026 Reforms at a Glance

| REFORM PARAMETER | PREVIOUS REGULATIONS | APPROVED REFORM (OCTOBER 2026) | CANDIDATE IMPACT |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Upper Age Limit** | 30 Years | **33 Years** | Adds 3 years of eligibility for graduates across Sindh |
| **Maximum Attempts** | 3 Lifetime Attempts | **5 Lifetime Attempts** | Reduces career jeopardy for dedicated civil service aspirants |
| **Screening Qualifying Cutoff** | 40% (40 Marks out of 100) | **33% (33 Marks out of 100)** | Expands written exam qualification roster by ~25–35% |
| **Single-Paper Testing** | Manual OMR Sheet Only | **Computer-Based Testing (CBT)** | Eliminates manual checking delays; immediate transparency |
| **Interview Ratio** | Disproportionate Provincial Ratio | **Aligned with FPSC Standards** | Reduces discretionary marks skew during final merit ranking |
| **Grievance Protection** | Ad-hoc Review Committees | **Cabinet Reforms Committee Oversight** | Safeguards candidate rights and prevents arbitrary penalization |
## In-Depth Analysis: The 5 Approved Pillars of SPSC Reform

### 1. Upper Age Limit Raised to 33 Years
Under the previous Sindh Public Service Commission Competitive Examination Regulations, candidates could only sit for the CCE up to the age of 30 years (with narrow exceptions for government servants under specific tenure rules). Given recurring academic delays, university session disruptions, and past administrative pauses in SPSC examination cycles, thousands of Sindh graduates found themselves disqualified before exhausting their academic potential.

The Cabinet's decision to raise the age ceiling to **33 years** establishes parity with evolving provincial demands and gives candidates ample preparation time post-graduation. The SGA&CD is expected to draft corresponding amendments to the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion and Transfer) Rules to anchor this change.

### 2. Attempt Ceiling Raised from 3 to 5 Attempts
Previously, SPSC enforced a strict three-attempt cap for CCE. An attempt was counted whenever an applicant appeared in even a single written paper. Under the new cabinet resolution, the limit is extended to **five (5) attempts**.

This adjustment acknowledges that competitive civil service examinations require high tactical mastery, essay refinement, and evolving current affairs analytical skills. Candidates who narrowly missed allocation on initial tries can now persevere without prematurely exhausting their civil service prospects.

### 3. Screening Test Cutoff Reduced to 33%
To manage high applicant volumes, SPSC conducts a mandatory 100-mark Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Screening Test. Formerly, candidates scoring below 40% were summarily disqualified, irrespective of departmental seat quotas.

The Cabinet lowered this qualifying threshold to **33%** specifically for the CCE screening phase. This will ensure that promising candidates who excel in analytical and subjective written components are not prematurely weeded out by tricky or ambiguously keyed single-paper objective tests.

### 4. Computer-Based Testing (CBT) for Single-Paper Exams
Single-paper recruitment tests for general posts (Lecturers, Municipal Officers, Town Officers, Medical Officers) have frequently faced administrative bottlenecks, OMR scanning queues, and paper leak allegations. The Cabinet approved transitioning high-frequency single-paper exams to **Computer-Based Testing (CBT)**.

Key CBT features under implementation:
- Dedicated high-capacity computer test centers in Hyderabad, Karachi, Sukkur, and Larkana.
- Randomized question banking to thwart examination room malpractice.
- Instant automated score computation and preliminary candidate printout upon session completion.

### 5. Interview Marks Alignment with FPSC Standards
One of the most persistent candidate protest demands addressed interview weightage. Historically, high discretionary marks in viva-voce examinations could dramatically overturn strong written examination scores. The Cabinet has resolved to adjust SPSC interview mark allocations to mirror the balanced proportion utilized by the Federal Public Service Commission (FPSC) in Islamabad, ensuring that substantive written examination performance remains the dominant determinant of final merit ranking.
## Implementation Roadmap: What Happens Next?
Candidates must understand the distinction between a **Cabinet Policy Decision** and a **Notified SPSC Regulation**:

1. **Cabinet Minutes Issuance:** The Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) receives the confirmed Cabinet resolution.
2. **Rules Drafting & Law Department Vetting:** Legal draftsmen amend the relevant clauses of the SPSC Regulations 2023 / 2026.
3. **Gazette Notification:** The Government of Sindh issues the official statutory regulatory order (SRO) in the Sindh Government Gazette.
4. **SPSC Operational Adoption:** The SPSC Full Commission ratifies the updated syllabus, eligibility filters, and online application portal software to accept applicants aged up to 33 with up to 5 attempts.
Candidates preparing for upcoming SPSC tests should monitor official commission announcements at [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/).
## Relationship to Active Advertisements

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Distinction for Active SPSC Advertisements:**
> - **CCE Specificity:** The 33-year age limit and 5-attempt rules approved by the Cabinet are formulated for the **Combined Competitive Examination (CCE)**.
> - **Active Advertisement 05/2026 (54 Vacancies):** General gazetted positions advertised under Consolidated Advertisement 05/2026 (closing on **23 October 2026**) follow their respective departmental recruitment service rules. Do not assume age extension for ongoing ads unless SPSC explicitly publishes an addendum extending the deadline or criteria. Review our verified guide: [SPSC Jobs 2026 – 54 Government Vacancies Deadline Reminder](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-jobs-2026-54-vacancies).
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Has the SPSC already updated its online portal for the 33-year age limit?**
Not yet. The Sindh Cabinet has approved the policy reform. The online application portal at spsc.gov.pk will be updated once the Services, General Administration & Coordination Department (SGA&CD) issues the formal Sindh Government Gazette notification.

**Q2: Does the 33% passing mark apply to the written subjective papers or only screening?**
The 33% reduction applies strictly to the **preliminary objective screening test** threshold. Subjective written examination qualifying criteria (individual subject cutoffs and aggregate minimums) remain subject to academic standards set in the CCE syllabus.

**Q3: Will previous attempts be reset under the 5-attempt rule?**
The official notification will specify attempt calculation modalities. Typically, candidates who had exhausted 3 attempts but remain within the eligible age bracket (under 33) will become eligible to utilize the 4th and 5th attempts in future CCE cycles.

**Q4: Does this reform cancel the upcoming CCE schedule?**
No. As previously reported on CareerDost, testing operations follow commission schedules. Candidates should review our companion report on the [SPSC CCE-2026 Screening Test Date & Instructions](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/spsc-cce-2026-screening-test-date).

1. **Academic Qualification:** Minimum Bachelor's / Graduation degree from an HEC-recognized university, preferably in **Business Studies (BBA, BS Accounting & Finance, B.Com, MBA, or Economics)**.
2. **Experience Level:** Open to **fresh university graduates**; candidates with 1 year of experience in SME, credit, or commercial banking are preferred.
3. **Financial & Credit Skills:** Basic lending knowledge, credit analysis skills, and quantitative ability to evaluate client financial statements and build projections.
4. **Business Understanding:** Working familiarity with commercial banking, SME financing, trade finance, and general banking operations.
5. **Core Competencies:** Strong communication, problem-solving, teamwork, and strict adherence to deadlines.
6. **Equal Opportunity:** Samba Bank actively encourages **female candidates and persons with disabilities (PWDs)** to apply.

## Core Job Responsibilities in SME Banking

Selected Relationship Associates work alongside the **Unit Head and Senior Relationship Managers (SRMs)** within the SME Banking division:

- **Cross-Selling Banking Solutions:** Collaborating with **Treasury, Cash Management, Trade, and Investment Banking** teams to create and implement cross-sell opportunities.
- **Credit Exposure & Compliance:** Monitoring assigned account exposures in compliance with Samba Bank credit policies and State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) prudential regulations.
- **MIS & Revenue Support:** Assisting the Unit Head with Management Information System (MIS) tracking for SME business targets.

## Verified Application Instructions

1. **Update Your CV:** Highlight your business degree, financial analysis coursework, Excel skills, and any internships.
2. **Send Email to Official HR:** Email your resume to **`careers@samba.com.pk`**.

content: # Bank Alfalah Jobs 2026: Counter Service Officer, Fresh Graduate Vacancies & Internships Guide

Verified on **18 October 2026** via the official [Bank Alfalah Career Opportunities Portal](https://www.bankalfalah.com/careers/career-opportunities/experienced-professionals/), the **Counter Service Officer** position welcomes **fresh graduates as well as candidates with up to two (2) years of experience** for placement across **Pan-Pakistan** branches, including **Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana, Mirpurkhas, and major national cities**.

## Featured Spotlight: Counter Service Officer (CSO)

### Official Job Summary & Core Branch Responsibilities
According to Bank Alfalah's official job specification on the [Experienced & Entry Professionals Portal](https://www.bankalfalah.com/careers/career-opportunities/experienced-professionals/), the **Counter Service Officer (CSO)** facilitates branch customers accurately and within turnaround time (TAT) benchmarks across these core areas:

1. **Cash & Counter Operations:** Processing daily cash deposits, cheque payments, and currency verification under Bank Alfalah (BAFL) internal controls and State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) regulations.
2. **National Prize Bonds & Utility Bills:** Managing National Prize Bond transactions, utility bill collections, and tax receipts.
3. **Funds Transfers & Clearing:** Executing inter-branch/inter-bank funds transfers and handling inward and outward clearing and collection.
4. **Payment Instruments & Stop Payments:** Issuing Pay Orders (PO), Demand Drafts (DD), and processing Stop Payment instructions with full audit compliance.

### CSO Eligibility Criteria
- **Minimum Education:** **Graduate** (minimum 14 to 16 years of education, such as B.Com, BBA, BS, BA, or B.Sc from an HEC-recognized university).

- **Locations:** **Pan-Pakistan** (nationwide branch network across Sindh, Punjab, KP, Balochistan, Islamabad, and AJK).

3. **Submit Details & CV:** Enter your CNIC, contact details, city preference, education, and experience (*Fresh* or *1–2 Years*), attach your PDF resume, and submit.

> **Zero Fee Policy:** Bank Alfalah never charges any fee for job applications, tests, or interviews. Only apply on official **`bankalfalah.com`** links.

Yes. The official requirement is *"Minimum Education: Graduate"* and *"Minimum Experience: Fresh or up to 2 years experience."*

content: # Pakistan Plans New Support for Poor and Flood-Affected Families: What Is Confirmed

## Executive Summary & Official Status

On the occasion of the **International Day for the Eradication of Poverty (17 October 2026)**, the Government of Pakistan officially communicated its policy commitment to roll out a dedicated assistance initiative for vulnerable segments of society. In an official communique released through the **Press Information Department (PID PR No. 264)**, **Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif** stated that the federal government is launching a *"special initiative to lift extremely poor and flood-affected households out of poverty, with the aim of providing them with a comprehensive package of support."*

Concurrently, in an official message under **PID PR No. 268**, **First Lady Bibi Aseefa Bhutto Zardari** highlighted the United Nations 2026 sub-theme **"A Safe Home for All,"** commending ongoing rehabilitation efforts—specifically the **Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF)** programme, which is reconstructing 2.1 million resilient houses with secure title deeds issued to women, as well as the nationwide social protections delivered through the **Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP)**.

Because misleading claims, fraudulent links, and fabricated registration forms circulate rapidly following high-level policy remarks, CareerDost has conducted a thorough journalistic and factual audit of official state records. Below is the precise, verified picture of what has actually been enacted versus what remains in policy development.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official Verification Checklist (17 October 2026):**
> - **Government Intention:** **Confirmed.** The Prime Minister officially declared the policy objective to assist poor and flood-hit families in PID PR No. 264.
> - **Registration Open:** **NOT Confirmed.** No application form, online portal, SMS shortcode, or local registration office has been designated or authorized.
> - **Cash Relief / Grant Amount:** **NOT Confirmed.** The federal government has **not** announced any monetary figure (neither lump-sum nor monthly stipends).
> - **Eligibility Rules:** **NOT Published.** Formal targeting criteria, cutoff scores, or required documentation have not yet been framed or notified by the Cabinet.
> - **Payment Schedule:** **NOT Confirmed.** No distribution dates or bank mechanisms exist for this proposed initiative at this stage.
> - **Separate from Ongoing Schemes:** This planned federal initiative is distinct from the regular ongoing **BISP 8171 Kafaalat** payments and the **Sindh SPHF (sphf.gos.pk)** housing grant tranches.

## Quick Facts Table: What Is Confirmed vs Unconfirmed

| FACTUAL PARAMETER | VERIFIED OFFICIAL STATUS | REGULATORY CONTEXT |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Authority** | Prime Minister's Office (PMO), Islamabad | Issued via Press Information Department (PID) |
| **Primary Official Source** | **PID PR No. 264 (Dated 17 October 2026)** | PM's Poverty Eradication Day Statement |
| **Secondary Official Source** | **PID PR No. 268 (Dated 17 October 2026)** | Message of First Lady Bibi Aseefa Bhutto Zardari |
| **International Framework** | UN International Day for the Eradication of Poverty | 2026–2028 UN Campaign: *"United for Peace and Human Rights"* (2026 Sub-theme: *"A Safe Home for All"*) |
| **Initiative Status** | **High-Level Policy Intent Announced** | Conceptual stage; operational guidelines pending |
| **Target Beneficiaries** | Extremely poor and flood-affected households | Exact targeting formula to be notified |
| **Registration Status** | **NOT YET OPEN** | **Zero** active portals, apps, or physical intake desks |
| **Financial Grant Amount** | **Unannounced** | No PKR figure finalized or allocated in public notices |
| **Application Deadline** | **None (No Deadline Active)** | Registration has not commenced |
| **Application Processing Fee** | **Rs 0 (Always Free)** | Any agent or website requesting payment is fraudulent |
| **Relationship to BISP** | **Distinct & Independent** | Regular BISP cash transfers proceed via existing 8171 channels |
| **Relationship to Sindh SPHF** | **Distinct Provincial Program** | Sindh SPHF continues under `sphf.gos.pk` independently |

## The Official Government Announcement Explained

The Prime Minister's official address on 17 October 2026 situated poverty eradication as a fundamental constitutional responsibility under the vision of a welfare state. Key takeaways from the federal statement include:

1. **Recognition of Compound Vulnerabilities:** The announcement explicitly linked severe economic deprivation with the escalating consequences of **climate change, recurrent floods, and torrential monsoon rains**, which have exacerbated housing deficits and wiped out rural livelihoods across Pakistan.
2. **Commitment to an Integrated Support Package:** Rather than an isolated cash handout, the Prime Minister described the forthcoming intervention as a *"comprehensive package of support"* designed to enable ultra-poor and flood-ravaged families to achieve long-term economic self-reliance.
3. **Linkage to Broader Welfare Institutions:** The address referenced key pillar institutions of Pakistan's social safety net, including the **Prime Minister's Apna Ghar Scheme** (providing easy financing for affordable shelter construction), the **National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER)**, the **Digital Social Protection Wallet**, **Daanish Schools**, the **National Vocational and Technical Training Commission (NAVTTC)**, the **Prime Minister's Youth Programme ("Uraan Pakistan")**, **Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal**, and the **Pakistan Poverty Alleviation Fund (PPAF)**.
4. **Inter-Governmental Collaboration Required:** Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif stressed that lifting families out of extreme poverty requires joint execution across federal entities, provincial governments, multilateral development partners, civil society, and local community leadership.

## Eligibility Status: What Has and Has Not Been Notified

Public interest inquiries regarding who can qualify for this planned support package have surged. CareerDost clarifies the precise regulatory position:

- **No Criteria Published Yet:** As of 17 October 2026, the federal government has **not gazetted or announced any specific eligibility rules** for this new initiative.
- **Poverty Scorecards Under NSER:** In established federal social safety programs, beneficiary selection is determined through the **National Socio-Economic Registry (NSER)** using **Proxy Means Test (PMT)** scores. While it is probable that the government will leverage existing NSER data to avoid duplication and target the lowest deciles, **no specific PMT cutoff score has been officially assigned** to this new initiative.
- **Flood Impact Assessment:** Whether eligibility will require verification by Provincial Disaster Management Authorities (PDMAs), the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), or local revenue administrations has not been determined.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Avoid False Eligibility Claims:** Any social media post, Facebook page, or video asserting that *"All families with PMT score under 32 can now collect Rs 25,000"* is entirely fabricated. The government has not released any such directive.

## Registration Status: Crucial Guidance on Application Channels

CareerDost unequivocally confirms that **there is currently no application or registration process underway** for this new initiative.

1. **No Online Portal:** The federal government has **not** published any URL or web form to collect beneficiary applications for this scheme.
2. **No SMS Shortcode:** The 8171 SMS service is dedicated exclusively to the Benazir Income Support Programme. No new shortcode has been activated for this special initiative.
3. **No Paper Forms or Office Queues:** District administration offices, Union Councils, NADRA centers, and BISP tehsil desks are **not** distributing or accepting applications for this announced program.
4. **What to Do Now:** Beneficiaries and deserving households should monitor verified official government releases through [PID](https://pid.gov.pk/) and authentic reporting on CareerDost. Do not submit your CNIC, mobile number, or household details to unverified portals.

## Sindh-Specific Context: Understanding SPHF and Existing Provincial Support

In the province of **Sindh**, which bore the brunt of the historic 2022 climate-induced floods, residents must distinguish between today's federal policy declaration and the **Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF)** programme.

### Key Highlights of Sindh's Ongoing Housing Programme (SPHF):
- **Scale & Mandate:** SPHF is an established Government of Sindh initiative backed by the World Bank and other development partners, targeting the reconstruction of **2.1 million climate-resilient homes** across flood-ravaged districts.
- **Women's Land Ownership:** As emphasized by First Lady Bibi Aseefa Bhutto Zardari in PID PR No. 268, SPHF places paramount importance on women's empowerment by issuing permanent land titles (*Sanads*) directly in the names of female heads of households.
- **Milestone-Based Reconstruction Grants:** Beneficiaries identified through the formal SPHF ground damage survey receive **Rs 300,000 in direct bank transfers** split across four inspection-verified construction tranches (Plinth, Lintel, Roof, and Completion).
- **Dedicated Official Portal:** Sindh flood survivors can verify their housing survey records and tranche disbursement status exclusively through the official provincial portal at [sphf.gos.pk](https://www.sphf.gos.pk/). Detailed tranche inspection and bank account rules are documented in our verified [Sindh Peoples Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) 2026 Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-peoples-housing-flood-affectees-sphf-subsidy-guide-2026).

### Other Active Social Protection Initiatives in Sindh:
Sindh households can also access verified ongoing assistance through established programs:
- **BISP Social Protection Wallet:** Eligible women enrolled in BISP can verify quarterly Kafaalat payments via the [BISP 8171 Payment Check & Social Protection Wallet Official Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/bisp-8171-payment-check-2026-official-guide).
- **Maternal & Child Health:** Pregnant women and mothers of infants in 15 targeted Sindh districts can track nutrition grants via our [Sindh Mamta Programme October Dashboard Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-mamta-programme-2026-october-dashboard).
- **Smallholder Farmer Relief:** Sindh farmers can monitor agricultural support and input subsidies through our [Sindh Wheat Subsidy & Benazir Hari Card Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-wheat-subsidy-benazir-hari-card-2026).
- **Clean Energy Access:** Off-grid rural Sindh households can inspect solar system allocations under the [Sindh Solar Energy Project (SSEP) Subsidy Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-solar-energy-project-ssep-home-solar-systems-subsidy-2026).

## Comparing the Proposed Federal Initiative with Existing Programmes

To prevent confusion among low-income families and field workers, the table below delineates the clear distinctions between the new federal announcement and ongoing social safety programs:

| PROGRAMME | JURISDICTION | PRIMARY PURPOSE | REGISTRATION STATUS | OFFICIAL PORTAL / CHANNEL |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **New Proposed Support Initiative** | Federal (Government of Pakistan) | Dedicated comprehensive package for ultra-poor and flood-affected households | **Policy Intent Announced (Registration Not Yet Open)** | [pid.gov.pk](https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/34381) |
| **Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP)** | Federal (Nationwide) | Quarterly unconditional cash transfers (Kafaalat), education (Taleemi Wazaif) & health (Nashonuma) | **Ongoing** (Dynamic registry at BISP Tehsil Offices) | [bisp.gov.pk](https://bisp.gov.pk/) / SMS 8171 |
| **Sindh People's Housing (SPHF)** | Provincial (Sindh) | Reconstruction of 2.1M flood-damaged homes with Rs 300,000 tranches and women land titles | **Ongoing** (Field survey-verified beneficiaries) | [sphf.gos.pk](https://www.sphf.gos.pk/) |
| **Prime Minister's Apna Ghar Scheme** | Federal | Low-cost housing financing and affordable home construction support | Subject to institutional commercial bank quotas | Ministry of Housing & Works |

## Urgent Fraud Warnings: How to Protect Yourself from Scams

Whenever the government announces new welfare or disaster relief initiatives, organized cybercrime rings attempt to exploit needy citizens. CareerDost urges all citizens to strictly adhere to the following fraud prevention protocols:

> [!WARNING]
> **Public Safety Advisory — Do Not Fall for Relief Scams:**
> 1. **Never Click Unverified Links on WhatsApp or Facebook:** Fraudulent messages claiming *"Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announces Rs 25,000 flood grant; click here to register before deadline"* are phishing scams designed to steal personal data or install malicious APK files.
> 2. **Never Pay Registration or Processing Fees:** All genuine Government of Pakistan social safety programs are **100% free of cost**. Any agent, cyber café operator, or caller demanding Rs 500 or Rs 1,000 as a "file charge" is committing fraud.
> 3. **Never Disclose Your OTP or PIN:** No official government department, BISP officer, or bank representative will ever ask for your biometric verification OTP, ATM PIN, or mobile banking password.
> 4. **Only Rely on Official Channels:** Official federal notifications are published strictly on `.gov.pk` domains such as the [Press Information Department](https://pid.gov.pk/).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Has Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif announced a new financial assistance scheme for flood victims?**
On 17 October 2026 (International Day for the Eradication of Poverty), the Prime Minister announced that the Government is launching a special initiative to lift extremely poor and flood-affected households out of poverty with a comprehensive package of support. However, this is currently a high-level policy intent; operational guidelines and distribution frameworks have not yet been released.

**Q2: What is the financial assistance amount for this new initiative?**
No financial grant amount has been announced. Any claims specifying exact cash disbursements (such as Rs 12,000, Rs 25,000, or Rs 50,000) are entirely unconfirmed and unofficial.

**Q3: Where can I submit my application or register online?**
Nowhere at this stage. The federal government has **not launched any registration portal, online form, or SMS application number**. Do not enter your personal credentials on unofficial websites.

**Q4: Is this new initiative part of BISP 8171?**
While the Prime Minister commended BISP's role in poverty eradication, this special initiative for poor and flood-affected households is framed as a distinct intervention. Regular BISP Kafaalat, Taleemi Wazaif, and Nashonuma disbursements continue uninterrupted through their standard channels.

**Q5: How does this announcement affect flood victims in Sindh who are rebuilding homes under SPHF?**
The Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) is an independent Government of Sindh programme supported by international donors, providing Rs 300,000 in tranches for 2.1 million climate-resilient homes. SPHF beneficiaries should continue their construction and verification through [sphf.gos.pk](https://www.sphf.gos.pk/) as usual.

**Q6: What should I do if someone asks for a fee to register me for this government package?**
Refuse immediately and report the individual to the local police or FIA Cyber Crime Wing. Government relief programs never charge any application, registration, or processing fee.

**Q7: When will the official registration dates and eligibility criteria be announced?**
The government has not specified a timeline. Once formal statutory rules and operational mechanisms are notified by the federal authorities, CareerDost will provide verified updates.

## Official Source Links & Verified CareerDost Public Guides

- **Primary Official Authority:** [Press Information Department (PID) — PR No. 264: Prime Minister's Message on International Day for the Eradication of Poverty (17 October 2026)](https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/34381)
- **Supporting Official Announcement:** [Press Information Department (PID) — PR No. 268: Message of First Lady Bibi Aseefa Bhutto Zardari on Poverty Eradication (17 October 2026)](https://pid.gov.pk/site/press_detail/34385)
- **Provincial Flood Housing Authority:** [Sindh People's Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) Official Portal](https://www.sphf.gos.pk/)
- **Related Verified CareerDost Guides:**
  - [Sindh Peoples Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) 2026: Rs 300,000 Grant Tranches, CNIC Verification & Women Title Deeds](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-peoples-housing-flood-affectees-sphf-subsidy-guide-2026)
  - [BISP 8171 Payment Check & Social Protection Wallet 2026 Official Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/bisp-8171-payment-check-2026-official-guide)
  - [Sindh Mamta Programme 2026: October Dashboard & Registration Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-mamta-programme-2026-october-dashboard)

content: # Jazz Careers 2026: AI Associate Programme, Digital Internships & Application Guide

## Executive Summary & Digital Transformation Leadership

**Jazz (VEON Group)**, Pakistan's foremost digital communications operator serving over 70 million subscribers alongside digital financial and streaming ecosystems (including JazzCash, Tamasha, and Garaj Cloud), actively recruits emerging digital innovators through its specialized early-career initiatives. Prominent among these is the **JazzWorld AI Associate Programme**, a dedicated **1-year future-skills accelerator** engineered to cultivate next-generation Artificial Intelligence engineers, data scientists, and digital product specialists across its operational headquarters in **Karachi, Islamabad, and Lahore**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Recruitment Highlights at a Glance (Verified October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Enterprise:** Jazz (VEON Telecom & Digital Ecosystems).
> - **Featured Initiative:** JazzWorld AI Associate Programme & Early-Career Digital Ingestion.
> - **Duration:** 1-Year Accelerated Structured Programme (with performance-linked permanent cadre absorption).
> - **Primary Hubs:** Karachi, Islamabad, and Lahore (featuring flexible hybrid work arrangements).
> - **Target Disciplines:** Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Business Analytics.
> - **Experience Tier:** Fresh Graduates (0 to 1 Year Experience) or Master's graduates.
> - **Official Application Gateway:** [careers.jazzworld.com.pk](https://careers.jazzworld.com.pk/).

## Quick Facts & Programme Specifications

| RECRUITMENT PARAMETER | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Company** | Jazz (VEON Group Pakistan) |
| **Program Name** | JazzWorld AI Associate Programme & Early Careers |
| **Employment Model** | Full-Time (1-Year Specialized Fast-Track with Permanent Potential) |
| **Location** | Karachi, Islamabad, Lahore & Hybrid Options |
| **Minimum Education** | 16 Years (BS / BE / MS in Data Science, AI, CS, SE) |
| **Minimum CGPA** | Minimum 3.0 out of 4.0 (or Equivalent Academic Merit) |
| **Core Skillsets** | Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, SQL, Cloud Analytics |
| **Compensation Package** | Market-Competitive Salary, Health Insurance, Monthly Mobile Allowance |
| **Application Deadline** | Continuous Rolling Intake (Check Specific Requisitions on JazzWorld) |
| **Official Portal Link** | [careers.jazzworld.com.pk](https://careers.jazzworld.com.pk/) |

## Deep Dive into the AI Associate Tech Stack

Participants in the JazzWorld AI Associate Programme are embedded directly inside high-impact digital and fintech product squads, gaining real-world exposure to:

1. **Telecom Big Data & Machine Learning:** Developing predictive subscriber analytics, network traffic forecasting models, and customer churn reduction algorithms using enterprise data lakes.
2. **Generative AI & Natural Language Processing (NLP):** Enhancing conversational AI assistants for customer support in English and Roman Urdu, automated speech recognition, and smart intent detection for digital service platforms.
3. **FinTech Analytics for JazzCash:** Constructing automated credit scoring algorithms, alternative data underwriting models for nano-loans, and fraud-detection neural networks.
4. **Cloud Infrastructure & MLOps:** Deploying machine learning models to production using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud computing architectures.

## Detailed Eligibility: Who Should Apply

Candidates must satisfy the following baseline qualifications:

- **Academic Degree:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Computational Statistics** from an HEC-recognized university.
- **Academic Record:** Minimum CGPA of **3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent percentage).
- **Technical Foundations:** Demonstrated proficiency in Python, common data science libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch), relational database querying (SQL), and algorithmic problem solving.
- **Portfolio / Projects:** Academic final-year project (FYP), Kaggle competition ranking, or GitHub repository demonstrating practical data modeling or AI applications.
- **Fresh Graduate Status:** Fresh graduates who completed their degree in 2025 or 2026 are prioritized.

## Step-by-Step Application Guide via JazzWorld Careers

Follow these verified steps to submit your candidacy to Jazz:

1. **Open the Careers Portal:** Navigate to [careers.jazzworld.com.pk](https://careers.jazzworld.com.pk/).
2. **Search Relevant Roles:** Filter by department (*Digital, Technology, Data & Analytics*) or search *AI Associate* / *Specialist*.
3. **Review Role Description:** Read the specific job requisition details, required tech stack, and location requirements.
4. **Create Profile & Upload CV:** Complete your candidate profile with your contact details, education, and attach an updated PDF resume highlighting your AI/ML projects.
5. **Complete Online Assessment:** Selected applicants will receive an invitation to an online technical evaluation covering Python coding, statistical analysis, and machine learning fundamentals.
6. **Panel & Cultural Interviews:** Successful test candidates attend a technical interview with Jazz data science leads, followed by an HR culture-fit discussion.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the JazzWorld AI Associate Programme?**
It is a specialized 1-year future-skills development initiative launched by Jazz to mentor and fast-track fresh graduates in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, and Machine Learning.

**Q2: Are there openings in Karachi?**
Yes. While Jazz maintains its corporate headquarters in Islamabad, significant commercial, digital, and technology operations are staffed at the Jazz regional offices in Karachi.

**Q3: Can candidates with a general Computer Science degree apply?**
Yes. Graduates in Computer Science or Software Engineering who possess strong personal project experience or coursework in Python and Machine Learning are fully eligible.

**Q4: Is the AI Associate position paid?**
Yes. The AI Associate Programme is a fully compensated, highly competitive corporate position offering monthly market-based pay, healthcare insurance, and corporate telecom allowances.

**Q5: Does Jazz charge any fee to apply?**
No. Jazz never charges any application, registration, or processing fee. Never pay money to anyone claiming to offer job guarantees at Jazz.

content: # HBL Jobs 2026: The League Management Trainee, Project Internships & Career Portal Guide

## Executive Summary & Banking Sector Leadership

**Habib Bank Limited (HBL)**, Pakistan's largest commercial banking institution serving over 37 million customers globally, conducts structured talent acquisition drives through its flagship early-career framework branded **The League**. Designed to identify and cultivate future executive leaders and digital banking specialists, The League encompasses the **Management Trainee Program (MTP)**, the specialized **Accelerate Graduates** initiative, and seasonal **Project Internships**. Career opportunities span corporate strategy, retail branch banking, digital product innovation, information security, and financial analytics at the **HBL Plaza Head Office in Karachi**, regional offices in **Hyderabad and Sukkur**, and nationwide commercial banking networks.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Key Recruitment Specifications (Verified October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Bank:** Habib Bank Limited (HBL).
> - **Signature Talent Initiative:** The League (Management Trainee Program & Project Internships).
> - **Target Intake Tracks:**
>   1. **Management Trainee (MT):** Fresh Graduates with Bachelor's or Master's degrees (0 to 2 years experience).
>   2. **Project Internships 2026:** Penultimate/final-year university students and fresh graduates (3 to 6-month specialized paid assignments).
>   3. **Accelerate Graduates (AG):** Master's degree holders with 2 to 4 years of corporate experience.
> - **Headquarters & Deployment Hubs:** Karachi Head Office, Innovation Labs, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Lahore, Islamabad, and nationwide branches.
> - **Official Application Gateway:** [hbl.com/careers](https://www.hbl.com/careers) (redirecting to HBL People Cloud Oracle HCM portal).

## Quick Facts & Programme Overview

| PROGRAMME SPECIFICATION | VERIFIED DETAILS |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Institution** | Habib Bank Limited (HBL) |
| **Program Name** | The League (Early Career Intake) & Project Internships |
| **Employment Status** | Full-Time Trainee / Permanent Banking Career Track |
| **Eligible Degree Disciplines** | Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, CS, IT, Data Analytics, Economics |
| **Minimum Academic Benchmark** | Minimum 3.0 CGPA (out of 4.0) or First Class Division |
| **Age Upper Limit** | 26 to 28 Years for Trainee Programs |
| **Stipend & Compensation** | Paid Trainee Allowance / Market-Competitive Banking Remuneration |
| **Primary Posting Centers** | Karachi, Hyderabad, Sindh Regional Hubs & Nationwide Branches |
| **Application System** | HBL People Cloud (Oracle HCM Cloud Platform) |
| **Official Portal Link** | [hbl.com/careers](https://www.hbl.com/careers) |

## Comprehensive Functional Streams Across HBL

Selected candidates undergo multi-departmental rotations before final placement across core banking verticals:

1. **Digital Banking & FinTech:** Managing HBL Mobile, Konnect branchless banking, open banking APIs, digital payment gateways, and merchant ecosystems.
2. **Corporate & Investment Banking:** Financial structuring, syndicated loans, corporate advisory, and treasury operations for multinational and large corporate clients.
3. **Retail Banking & Consumer Assets:** Consumer lending products, auto financing, mortgage portfolios, and customer experience operations across Pakistan's widest branch network.
4. **Risk Management & Compliance:** Credit risk assessment, SBP prudential regulation compliance, AML/CFT transaction monitoring, and financial crime prevention.
5. **Data Analytics & Artificial Intelligence:** Predictive financial modeling, customer churn analysis, credit scoring algorithms, and business intelligence dashboards using modern computational toolsets.

## Detailed Eligibility Criteria: Who Qualifies and Who Does Not

### Who Qualifies for HBL Early-Career Programs
- **Education:** 4-year Bachelor's degree (BBA, BS) or 2-year Master's degree (MBA, MS) from an HEC-recognized local or foreign university.
- **Academic Performance:** Minimum CGPA of **3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 70% in conventional grading systems).
- **Experience Cap:** Fresh university graduates or individuals with up to **2 years** of post-qualification corporate experience.
- **Age Criterion:** Maximum 26 to 28 years of age at the time of cohort induction.
- **Talent Reach across Sindh:** Graduates from top universities across Sindh—including IBA Karachi, LUMS, NED University, FAST-NUCES, Mehran UET Jamshoro, and Sukkur IBA—are strongly encouraged to apply.

## Step-by-Step Application Guide via HBL People Cloud

All legitimate applications must be lodged through HBL's secure Oracle Cloud career portal:

1. **Access the Portal:** Open [hbl.com/careers](https://www.hbl.com/careers) and click **Apply Now**.
2. **Navigate to Open Requisitions:** You will enter the **HBL People Cloud (Candidate Experience)** environment.
3. **Search Keywords:** Type *Management Trainee*, *Project Internship*, or browse by location (e.g., *Karachi*, *Hyderabad*).
4. **Create Profile:** Register your account using your personal email and national identity number (CNIC).
5. **Enter Educational Profile:** Input your university name, terminal degree title, graduation year, and official CGPA.
6. **Upload Professional Resume:** Attach your PDF resume highlighting academic honors, extracurricular leadership, technical projects, and internships.
7. **Submit & Monitor Status:** Submit your profile and monitor your registered email for computerized online cognitive test invitations and panel interview schedules.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is 'The League' at HBL?**
The League is HBL's comprehensive umbrella framework for early-career talent, encompassing the Management Trainee Program, Project Internships, and Accelerate Graduate roles.

**Q2: Are HBL Project Internships paid?**
Yes. Structured corporate project internships at HBL provide a monthly stipend to cover local transport and meals for the duration of the 3 to 6-month assignment.

**Q3: Which cities have the most HBL trainee positions?**
The majority of strategic, digital, and head office rotations take place in **Karachi**, with regional operational placements across **Hyderabad, Sukkur, Lahore, and Islamabad**.

**Q4: Can candidates awaiting their final results apply?**
Yes. Students in their final semester who have completed all coursework and have a certified provisional transcript reflecting a 3.0+ CGPA can submit their applications.

**Q5: Does HBL charge any recruitment or test fees?**
No. HBL does not charge any application or processing fee. All official applications through the HBL People Cloud portal are completely free.

content: # Systems Limited Jobs 2026: Associate Software Engineer, Trainee Program & Application Guide

## Executive Summary & IT Industry Leadership

**Systems Limited**, Pakistan's premier global technology innovator and top software exporter, is actively hiring across its core engineering divisions for the position of **Associate Software Engineer (ASE)** and **Graduate Trainee**. Designed to induct high-potential computer science and software engineering talent graduating from recognized national universities, this program provides structured onboarding, direct exposure to enterprise client architectures, and mentorship from senior technology consultants across modern technology stacks in **Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad**, and flexible remote/hybrid models.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Key Hiring Highlights at a Glance:**
> - **Hiring Enterprise:** Systems Limited (Global IT Innovations).
> - **Target Role:** Associate Software Engineer (ASE) / Graduate Trainee.
> - **Key Operational Centers:** Karachi (Clifton & Shahrah-e-Faisal Tech Hubs), Lahore, and Islamabad.
> - **Educational Benchmark:** 4-Year BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering, or Information Technology.
> - **Experience Requirement:** **0 to 1 Year (Fresh Graduates Welcome)**; final-semester students with confirmed degree completion timelines are eligible.
> - **Work Format:** On-site at corporate tech campuses with hybrid working flexibility.
> - **Official Application Gateway:** [systemsltd.com/careers](https://www.systemsltd.com/careers).

## Quick Facts & Job Specifications

| RECRUITMENT PARAMETER | VERIFIED OFFICIAL SPECIFICATION |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Company Name** | Systems Limited |
| **Designation** | Associate Software Engineer (ASE) |
| **Employment Status** | Permanent Staff Cadre |
| **Target Cities** | Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad & Remote Hybrid |
| **Minimum Degree** | BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering or IT |
| **Minimum CGPA** | Minimum 2.80 to 3.00 CGPA (or 70% equivalent) |
| **Technology Verticals** | .NET Core, Java, Cloud Native, Data Analytics, QA, Dynamics 365 |
| **Benefits Package** | Market-Leading Salary, Health & OPD Insurance, Provident Fund, Certifications |
| **Application Deadline** | Continuous Rolling Intakes (Q4 2026 Active Batch) |
| **Official Portal Link** | [systemsltd.com/careers](https://www.systemsltd.com/careers) |

## Core Technology Tracks for Associate Software Engineers

Successful candidates are assigned to specialized business units based on their technical aptitude, algorithmic assessment results, and engineering interests:

1. **Enterprise Full Stack & .NET Development:** Engineering scalable web services, microservices, and enterprise backends using C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, and modern frontend frameworks (Angular, React).
2. **Java & Cloud-Native Engineering:** Developing distributed software solutions utilizing Java/Spring Boot, Docker containerization, Kubernetes clusters, and cloud environments (Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP).
3. **Data Engineering & Business Intelligence:** Building data extraction pipelines, ETL workflows, data warehousing, and predictive reporting dashboards using Python, PySpark, Power BI, and Databricks.
4. **Software Quality Assurance & Automation:** Designing test strategies, developing automated testing scripts using Selenium, Cypress, and Postman, and performing performance/load testing.
5. **Enterprise Business Applications (Microsoft Dynamics 365):** Configuring enterprise ERP and CRM platforms, building custom workflows, and deploying solutions for international Fortune 500 clients.

## Detailed Eligibility & Academic Benchmarks

Applicants must satisfy the following baseline criteria:

- **Education:** BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Data Science from an HEC-accredited institution.
- **Technical Proficiency:** Strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA), Database Management Systems (RDBMS/SQL), and fundamental software architecture concepts.
- **Final-Year Students:** Candidates currently in their 8th semester who have completed coursework and are awaiting degree conferment are eligible to apply.
- **Sindh Talent Inclusion:** Graduates from engineering and CS institutes across Sindh—including FAST Karachi, NED University, IBA Karachi, SSUET, Dawood UET, and Sukkur IBA—are strongly prioritized for Karachi technology center placements.

## Step-by-Step Application Procedure

Follow these verified steps to submit your candidacy to Systems Limited:

1. **Visit the Careers Hub:** Navigate to [systemsltd.com/careers](https://www.systemsltd.com/careers) or the dedicated [systemsltd.com/trainees](https://www.systemsltd.com/trainees) portal.
2. **Filter Open Positions:** Search for **Associate Software Engineer** or filter by your preferred city (e.g., *Karachi* or *Lahore*).
3. **Register Candidate Profile:** Fill out your personal details, contact number, degree institution, and CGPA.
4. **Upload Resume & Portfolio:** Attach an updated PDF resume highlighting academic projects, GitHub repository links, personal tech stacks, and relevant software development internships.
5. **Technical Screening:** Shortlisted candidates will receive an invitation to an online coding assessment evaluating algorithmic problem solving, logic puzzles, and core CS fundamentals.
6. **Technical & HR Interviews:** Candidates who pass the assessment undergo a structured technical evaluation followed by an HR interview before final offer letter issuance.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Can fresh graduates with no prior experience apply for Associate Software Engineer roles?**
Yes. The Associate Software Engineer role is specifically designed for fresh graduates and entry-level professionals with 0 to 1 year of experience.

**Q2: Does Systems Limited hire candidates in Karachi?**
Yes. Systems Limited maintains major technology development centers in Karachi (including Clifton and Shahrah-e-Faisal offices), serving financial and international enterprise clients.

**Q3: What technical subjects should candidates prepare for the screening test?**
Candidates should thoroughly review Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Data Structures & Algorithms, Basic SQL Database Queries, and problem-solving fundamentals in their language of choice (C++, C#, Java, or Python).

**Q4: Are final-semester students eligible to apply?**
Yes. Students in their final semester who have finished their coursework or are completing their final capstone project can apply with their 7th-semester provisional transcript.

**Q5: Does Systems Limited charge any application or testing fee?**
No. Systems Limited never charges any fee at any stage of the recruitment process. Applications submitted through official channels are completely free.

content: # Aga Khan University Jobs 2026: Karachi Traineeships, Hospital Vacancies & Taleo Portal Guide

## Executive Summary & Institutional Overview

The **Aga Khan University (AKU)** and its flagship **Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH)** in Karachi maintain continuous talent acquisition drives across academic teaching faculties, hospital clinical wings, IT enterprise operations, and structured early-career traineeships. Widely recognized as one of South Asia's leading healthcare and higher education institutions, AKU offers structured **12-month Management Traineeships**, specialized **Allied Health & IT Traineeships**, and permanent career appointments at its main **Stadium Road Campus**, **Clifton Medical Services**, and regional diagnostic centers throughout Karachi and interior Sindh.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Recruitment Highlights at a Glance (Verified October 2026):**
> - **Hiring Institution:** Aga Khan University (AKU) & University Hospital Karachi.
> - **Primary Early-Career Track:** 12-Month Management Traineeship Programme (MTP) & On-The-Job Technical Traineeships.
> - **Primary Deployment Locations:** Karachi (Stadium Road, Clifton, Karimabad, Garden & Secondary Centers).
> - **Academic Disciplines:** Business Administration (BBA/MBA), Computer Science & IT (BS/BE), Nursing, Pharmacy, Laboratory Sciences, and General Sciences.
> - **Financial Compensation:** Paid monthly stipend for all formalized traineeship cohorts; competitive institutional salary scales and provident fund for regular appointments.
> - **Official Application Gateway:** [aku.taleo.net/careersection](https://aku.taleo.net/careersection/).

## Quick Facts & Operational Specifications

| RECRUITMENT PARAMETER | VERIFIED OFFICIAL DETAILS |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Organization** | Aga Khan University (AKU) & Hospital Karachi |
| **Sector** | Autonomous Healthcare & Higher Education Institution |
| **Primary Location** | Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan |
| **Featured Intake 1** | Management Traineeship Programme (12-Month Accelerated Rotation) |
| **Featured Intake 2** | IT & Technical Traineeships (Software, Networks & Systems) |
| **Featured Intake 3** | Clinical Traineeships (Nursing, Pharmacy & Laboratory Tech) |
| **Eligibility Benchmark** | Minimum CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0 (for Management & IT Traineeships) |
| **Experience Level** | Fresh Graduates to 1 Year Experience for Trainee Tracks |
| **Application System** | Online Taleo Talent Management System |
| **Official Careers Portal** | [aku.edu/careers](https://www.aku.edu/careers) |

## Detailed Breakdown of Early-Career Traineeship Tracks

AKU provides several distinct career entry points tailored to various academic disciplines:

### 1. Management Traineeship Programme (MTP)
- **Overview:** A premier 12-month fast-track development initiative designed to groom future institutional administrators, operational managers, and healthcare leadership talent.
- **Rotations:** Trainees rotate across Human Resources, Finance, Hospital Operations, Supply Chain Management, Patient Services, and Internal Audit.
- **Eligibility:** Fresh graduates holding a Bachelor's (BBA/BS) or Master's (MBA/MS) degree from HEC-recognized institutions with a minimum cumulative GPA of **3.0 out of 4.0**.
- **Benefits:** Full monthly stipend, comprehensive medical benefits, and fast-track evaluation for regular Assistant Manager or Executive openings upon successful completion.

### 2. Information Technology (IT) Traineeships
- **Overview:** On-the-job training within AKU's central IT and Enterprise Technology Division, managing digital healthcare records, clinical software, data security, and network infrastructure.
- **Eligibility:** BS Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology graduates with foundational knowledge of SQL, Python, network protocols, or web frameworks.

### 3. Clinical & Laboratory Traineeships
- **Overview:** Specialized hands-on hospital apprenticeships for graduates in Nursing (BScN), Medical Laboratory Technology (BS MLT), and Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm-D), providing clinical ward and diagnostic exposure under accredited international medical standards.

## Step-by-Step Taleo Application Process

Applications for AKU positions must be submitted through the official Taleo Talent Management Portal:

1. **Visit the Career Portal:** Open [aku.edu/careers](https://www.aku.edu/careers) and click on **Apply Online / Search Vacancies**.
2. **Access Taleo Portal:** You will be redirected to the secure Taleo environment at [aku.taleo.net/careersection/](https://aku.taleo.net/careersection/).
3. **Search Jobs by Location:** Set the location filter to **Pakistan > Karachi** to view active requisitions.
4. **Create a Candidate Profile:** Click **Sign In** or **New User**. Register using your active email address and a secure password.
5. **Upload Curriculum Vitae (CV):** Upload your resume in PDF or DOCX format. The system's resume parser will automatically populate work and educational fields.
6. **Complete Qualifications & Questionnaires:** Complete mandatory questions regarding your graduation year, CGPA, degree discipline, and notice period.
7. **Submit Application:** Review your information carefully and click **Submit**. Record your unique Taleo Job Submission ID.

## Candidate Documents Checklist

Ensure digital copies of the following documents are ready for upload and in-person verification:

- Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) emphasizing relevant project work and internships.
- Final degree certificate and official academic transcripts showing cumulative CGPA.
- Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC).
- Professional registration certificates (e.g., PNC for Nurses, Pharmacy Council registration for Pharmacists, or PEC for Engineers).
- Two professional or academic recommendation letters.

## Institutional Transparency & Anti-Fraud Advisory

> [!WARNING]
> **Protect Yourself from Recruitment Impersonators:**
> - **No Recruitment Fees:** Aga Khan University never demands any application fee, testing fee, or refundable security deposit from job applicants.
> - **Official Email Domains Only:** Official communication is issued strictly from `@aku.edu` email domains. Disregard emails sent from Gmail, Yahoo, or WhatsApp numbers claiming to represent AKU HR.
> - **Submit Exclusively on Taleo:** Never send confidential documents or fees to third-party recruitment agencies claiming 'guaranteed job placement' at AKU.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Where are the primary job locations for AKU vacancies?**
The vast majority of administrative, teaching, and hospital vacancies are located at the Aga Khan University Stadium Road Campus and Clifton Medical Services in Karachi, Sindh.

**Q2: What is the minimum CGPA required for the Management Traineeship Programme?**
The standard academic requirement for the Management Traineeship is a minimum CGPA of **3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 70% in conventional grading).

**Q3: Can candidates from outside Karachi apply for these roles?**
Yes. Graduates from universities across Sindh (such as Mehran UET, University of Sindh, Sukkur IBA) and nationwide are eligible to apply, provided they can relocate to Karachi for on-site duties.

**Q4: Are AKU traineeships paid?**
Yes. All formalized AKU traineeship programs—including Management Traineeships and Allied Health Traineeships—provide a paid monthly stipend.

**Q5: How can I check the status of my Taleo application?**
Log into your candidate profile at [aku.taleo.net/careersection/](https://aku.taleo.net/careersection/) and open the **My Job Cart / My Applications** section to check real-time application review status.

## Source Attribution & Related CareerDost Resources

- **Related Career Guides:** [MCB Bank Information Security Trainee 2026](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/mcb-bank-infosec-trainee-jobs-2026), [Bank Alfalah Jobs & Internships Complete Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/bank-alfalah-jobs-internships-2026), and [10Pearls SHINE Virtual Internship 2026](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/10pearls-shine-virtual-internship-2026).
