title: DRAP Medicine Barcode Notification 2026: Mandatory 2D Serialization Rules & Older Batch Exemption
shortDescription: Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) issued a statutory notification making 2D Data Matrix barcoding and serialization mandatory for all medicines effective 9 October 2026. Learn the 4 barcode parameters, anti-counterfeit rules, and complete exemption for older batches.
content: # DRAP Medicine Barcode Notification 2026: Mandatory 2D Serialization Rules & Older Batch Exemption
## Statutory Pharmaceutical Regulatory Directive

In a decisive regulatory intervention to curb spurious, counterfeit, and falsified therapeutic goods, the **Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP)** published an official notification on **8 October 2026** enforcing mandatory **2D Barcoding and Serialization** under **Phase I of the National Pharmaceutical Track & Trace System**.

Formally promulgated under statutory powers granted by the amended **Drugs (Labelling and Packaging) Rules, 1978** (via S.R.O. 963(I)/2026), this national mandate entered into legal effect on **9 October 2026** across Pakistan.

> [!NOTE]
> **Key Regulatory Parameters at a Glance:**
> - **Issuing Authority:** Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP), Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations & Coordination
> - **Notification Publication Date:** **8 October 2026**
> - **Effective Enforcement Date:** **9 October 2026**
> - **Scope:** All registered human and veterinary drug products manufactured locally or imported into Pakistan
> - **Technology Standard:** GS1-compliant **2D Data Matrix Barcode** with individual serialization
> - **Older Stock Exemption:** Batches manufactured or imported prior to 9 October 2026 are **100% exempt**
## The 4 Mandatory Barcode Data Points

Under the notified regulations, every unit carton and primary container of registered pharmaceutical products produced or imported on or after 9 October 2026 must embed four distinct data points within a scannable **2D Data Matrix Barcode**:

1. **Global Trade Item Number (GTIN):** A standardized, universally recognized 14-digit identifier denoting the exact drug product, strength, and dosage form.
2. **Unique Serial Number (SN):** An individualized alphanumeric serial code assigned uniquely to each physical pack, rendering duplicate or cloned packaging detectable.
3. **Batch / Lot Number (BN / LOT):** The manufacturer's production batch tracking code corresponding to production logs.
4. **Expiry Date (EXP):** Standardized numeric representation of shelf life (Year/Month/Day).

In addition to machine-readable 2D matrix symbology, these four data elements must also appear in **Human-Readable Interpretation (HRI)** text immediately adjacent to the barcode for visual scrutiny by dispensing pharmacists and patients.
## Crucial Editorial Clarification: Older-Batch Exemption

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Accurate Understanding of the Older-Batch Exemption:**
> To prevent artificial drug shortages, supply-chain bottlenecks, or unnecessary panic among patients, DRAP has enacted an explicit **inventory exemption clause**:
> 
> - **Prior Manufacturing Exemption:** Any batch of medicine that was manufactured locally or customs-cleared for import **with a manufacturing date before 9 October 2026** does **not** require retroactive 2D barcoding.
> - **Full Clearance Permitted:** Pharmacies, hospitals, and wholesalers are legally authorized to sell, distribute, and dispense pre-October 9 stock throughout its normal registered shelf life until expiration.
> - **No Recall Required:** Consumers and retailers should note that older-batch medicines lacking a 2D barcode are **not counterfeit** by default if produced prior to the cutoff date.
## Patient Rights & How Citizens Can Verify Medicines
For healthcare consumers and patients across Pakistan, the Track & Trace framework provides unprecedented protection against lethal adulterated medicines:

- **Smart Scanning:** Consumers will increasingly be able to scan the 2D Data Matrix on drug boxes using standard smartphone camera apps or the official **DRAP MedSafety** mobile application to verify registration status.
- **Rapid Recall Tracking:** In the event of a quality defect or adverse reaction alert, DRAP and provincial health departments can trace specific serial numbers instantly down to the distribution warehouse, preventing widespread harm.
- **Reporting Counterfeits:** Suspected unverified or substandard medicines can be reported to DRAP's Vigilance Division via email at `contact@dra.gov.pk` or through provincial drug inspectors.
## Advisory for Retail Pharmacies & Distributors

> [!WARNING]
> **Compliance Guidance for Chemists and Druggists:**
> - **Do Not Refuse Valid Pre-October Stock:** Retailers must continue dispensing pre-October 9 inventory without panic.
> - **Verification on New Deliveries:** When receiving fresh pharmaceutical consignments manufactured after 9 October 2026, pharmacies should verify that the manufacturer has imprinted the GS1 Data Matrix code alongside readable HRI details.
> - **Severe Penalties:** Distributing deliberately falsified drugs or cloning serial codes constitutes a criminal offence under the **DRAP Act, 2012**, punishable by heavy fines, factory seals, and imprisonment.
## Official Source Attribution & Related Articles

- **Official Authority:** [Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP)](https://dra.gov.pk/), Ministry of National Health Services.
- **Statutory Rules:** Drugs (Labelling and Packaging) Rules, 1978 (as amended by S.R.O. 963(I)/2026).
- **Related CareerDost Resources:** [Sindh Minimum Wage 2026 Workers Salary](/jobs/sindh-minimum-wage-2026-workers-salary), [BISP 8171 Payment Check 2026 Official Guide](/jobs/bisp-8171-payment-check-2026-official-guide).

shortDescription: Associated Press of Pakistan (APP) reported on 12 October 2026 that Section 144 has been promulgated across all nine districts of Hyderabad Division for 15 days. Note: Maintained on strict EDITORIAL HOLD pending primary signed notification.
content: # Hyderabad Division Section 144 Imposed: 15-Day Restrictions Across 9 Districts (Editorial Hold)

> [!WARNING]
> **EDITORIAL HOLD — PRIMARY SOURCE VERIFICATION PENDING:**
> This public advisory report is based on preliminary news reporting distributed by the state-run wire service **Associated Press of Pakistan (APP)** on **12 October 2026**.
> 
> **CareerDost Verification Protocol:** The original, signed official gazette notification issued by the **Office of the Commissioner Hyderabad Division** or the **Sindh Home Department** has **not yet been directly obtained or inspected** on official provincial government publication archives.
> In accordance with strict CareerDost editorial guidelines, this article is held on **EDITORIAL HOLD** as an unapproved internal draft. Commuters, students, examination candidates, and commercial operators are advised to verify operational enforcement with their respective local District Administration (Deputy Commissioner) offices.
## Overview of Reported APP Announcement

According to wire dispatches issued by the Associated Press of Pakistan (APP) on **12 October 2026**, the Commissioner of Hyderabad Division, **Fayyaz Abbasi**, has reportedly promulgated **Section 144 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC)** across the entire administrative division.

The regulatory intervention has been enacted for a reported duration of **15 days** to prevent potential breaches of public peace, maintain law and order, and avert public nuisance or disruptions to vital civic infrastructure.
## Nine Affected Districts Across Hyderabad Division

The reported territorial jurisdiction covers all nine constituent districts comprising Hyderabad Division:

1. **Hyderabad District** (including City, Latifabad, and Qasimabad talukas)
2. **Jamshoro District**
3. **Thatta District**
4. **Sujawal District**
5. **Badin District**
6. **Tando Muhammad Khan District**
7. **Tando Allahyar District**
8. **Matiari District**
9. **Dadu District**
## Reported Prohibitions Under Section 144

Based on the initial administrative dispatch, the following civic activities are reported to be restricted for the duration of the order:
- **Public Assemblies:** A total ban on the unlawful assembly of **five (5) or more persons** in public places, streets, and thoroughfares.
- **Demonstrations & Processions:** Prohibition of unpermitted rallies, political processions, protest sit-ins (*dharnas*), and hunger strike camps.
- **Obstruction of Thoroughfares:** Strict ban on blocking public roads, highways, inter-district arterial routes, and vital government installations.
- **Loudspeakers & Sound Amplifiers:** Ban on unauthorized use of loudspeakers and sound amplification systems, excluding customary calls to prayer (*Azan*).
- **Weapons & Firearms:** Complete ban on the carrying, brandishing, or display of lethal weapons and firearms (licensed or unlicensed), except by on-duty law enforcement officers.
## Potential Impact on Examinations, Schools & Commuters

While Section 144 restricts unlawful public political assemblies and protest rallies, routine civil life is typically managed under specific administrative exemptions:
- **Educational Institutions:** Regular classes at universities, colleges, and schools generally proceed as scheduled unless a separate closure order is issued by the School Education or College Education Department.
- **Commercial Markets:** Routine business operations in bazaars, shopping plazas, and retail centers remain functional, provided crowds do not gather for unauthorized demonstrations.
- **Public Transport:** Intercity and intracity transport generally operates normally along designated arterial routes.
## Legal Penalties for Non-Compliance

Under statutory criminal law in Pakistan, any person violating an operative executive order issued under Section 144 CrPC is subject to prosecution under **Section 188 of the Pakistan Penal Code (PPC)** (Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant), which carries penalties including arrest, summary fines, and imprisonment.
## Source Attribution & Verification Status

- **Primary Wire Source:** Associated Press of Pakistan (APP) news bulletin, 12 October 2026.
- **Pending Primary Document:** Original signed notification from Commissioner Hyderabad Division / Sindh Home Department.
- **Editorial Status:** Maintained on EDITORIAL HOLD pending receipt and authentication of original gazette notification.

title: Sindh Wheat Subsidy 2026: Benazir Hari Card Registration Update
shortDescription: Sindh Agriculture Department announced wheat grower subsidy support on 11 October 2026 via Benazir Hari Card. Check eligibility for farmers up to 25 acres, Form VII land verification, Sindh Bank payment mechanism, and registration steps.
content: # Sindh Wheat Subsidy 2026: Benazir Hari Card Registration Update
## Overview of the Wheat Growers Support Program

The Sindh Agriculture, Supply & Prices Department issued an official circular on **11 October 2026** confirming ongoing registration and relief measures under the **Sindh Wheat Growers Support Program 2026**.

In line with recent provincial cabinet approvals, the initiative provides targeted agricultural subsidies directly to small and medium wheat cultivators ahead of the upcoming Rabi sowing season. The program leverages the **Benazir Hari Card (BHC)** digital ecosystem, ensuring transparent, direct cash assistance without the interference of intermediaries or commission agents.

> [!NOTE]
> **Official Announcement Summary:**
> - **Department:** Agriculture, Supply & Prices Department, Government of Sindh
> - **Key Focus:** Wheat grower input subsidies (DAP fertilizer, certified seed, and crop management support)
> - **Landholding Ceiling:** Farmers owning or cultivating up to **25 acres** of agricultural land
> - **Official Portal:** [benazirharicard.gos.pk](https://benazirharicard.gos.pk/)
> - **Disbursement Channel:** Direct biometric transfer through **Sindh Bank** Benazir Hari Card accounts
## Consolidated Cabinet Policy: 25-Acre Ceiling & Verification

According to policy directives formally approved by the Sindh Cabinet and reported via official news channels (APP), the wheat subsidy is strictly earmarked for smallholders to safeguard food security and lower production costs across the province.

Key pillars of the confirmed policy include:
1. **Landholding Threshold:** Eligibility is restricted to farmers holding up to **25 acres** of cultivable land. Large corporate estates are excluded from this input package.
2. **Form VII Land Verification:** Land ownership and tenancy records are cross-matched digitally against the **Board of Revenue Sindh** (Form VII) database to prevent fraudulent registrations.
3. **Dual Stream (New Registration vs. Revalidation):**
   - **Fresh Registration:** Eligible farmers not yet enrolled in the Benazir Hari Card database must apply with their CNIC, mobile number registered in their own name, and verified land records.
   - **Revalidation:** Existing beneficiaries who received assistance in previous cycles must have their biometric and revenue data re-validated through local Agriculture Extension committees before new disbursements are triggered.
4. **Direct Sindh Bank Transfer:** Approved subsidies are credited directly into beneficiary accounts issued in partnership with Sindh Bank, accessible via debit cards and designated biometric points.
## Eligible Farmer Categories & Input Subsidies

The Agriculture Department covers small and medium growers cultivating wheat during the 2026–27 season. Assistance covers:
- **DAP Fertilizer & Seed Subsidy:** Flat relief payments to offset soaring chemical fertilizer and certified wheat seed prices.
- **Support for Tenancy & Small Landowners:** Both self-cultivating owners and registered tenants verified by local revenue authorities are entitled to claim the facility within the 25-acre ceiling.
- **Procurement Incentives:** Farmers supplying wheat directly to provincial Food Department centers will also benefit from enhanced support mechanisms announced by the provincial government.
## Step-by-Step Registration & Status Verification Guide

Follow these verified steps to register or check your enrollment status under the Benazir Hari Card wheat scheme:

1. **Access the Official Web Portal:** Visit the authentic government portal at [benazirharicard.gos.pk](https://benazirharicard.gos.pk/) or visit your nearest **Directorate General Agriculture Extension (Taluka Office)**.
2. **Prepare Mandatory Documents:**
   - Original 13-digit Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC).
   - Active SIM card registered against the applicant's own CNIC.
   - Updated Land Revenue Record (Form VII / Khata certificate issued by the relevant Mukhtiarkar or Tapedar).
   - Recent passport-sized photograph and farming declaration.
3. **Institutional Verification:** The Taluka and District Facilitation Committees, working under the Directorate General Agriculture Extension Sindh, review the submitted application against revenue archives.
4. **Card Issuance & Sindh Bank Activation:** Once verified, the applicant receives an official Benazir Hari Card linked to a dedicated Sindh Bank account. Biometric verification is completed at a nearby Sindh Bank branch or designated agent.
5. **Monitor Payment Alerts:** Subsidy credit alerts are dispatched exclusively via official government SMS channels.
## Crucial Editorial Warnings for Sindh Farmers

> [!WARNING]
> **Beware of Fraudulent Agents and Fake Payment Dates:**
> - **No Registration Fee:** Registration for the Benazir Hari Card through government offices is completely free of charge. Never pay any private agent or middleman claiming to expedite approval.
> - **Disbursement Timelines:** Specific subsidy release dates are notified phase-wise by the provincial government. Do not rely on viral social media posts claiming immediate cash distribution without official verification.
> - **Secure Biometrics:** Never share your ATM PIN, OTP, or signed blank forms with anyone.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the maximum landholding limit to receive the Sindh wheat subsidy?**
Farmers holding or cultivating up to **25 acres** of land verified through Board of Revenue Form VII records are eligible.

**Q2: What is the official website for Benazir Hari Card registration?**
The only authentic portal is [benazirharicard.gos.pk](https://benazirharicard.gos.pk/). Do not submit personal details on private websites or apps.

**Q3: How will farmers receive the wheat subsidy amount?**
Payments are credited directly into beneficiaries' accounts at **Sindh Bank**, which can be withdrawn using the Benazir Hari Card at ATMs or authorized biometric cash points.

**Q4: Do already registered Hari Card holders need to apply again?**
Existing cardholders generally do not need a new card, but must complete **data revalidation** and biometric verification through their local Agriculture Extension office as mandated by the Sindh Cabinet.

**Q5: Who can I contact for assistance?**
Growers should contact their local Taluka Agriculture Officer (Extension) or visit the nearest Sindh Bank branch for guidance.

- **Related Sindh Updates:** [Sindh Agriculture University Admissions 2027](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-agriculture-university-admissions-2027), [Sindh Govt Electric Scooty Scheme 2026](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-govt-electric-scooty-scheme-2026-women).

content: # Sindh Kisan Subsidy 2026: 25 Acre Tak Farmers Ke Liye Registration Aur Payment Rules

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Editorial Notice — Cross-Reference & Merge Advisory:**
> This article focuses specifically on the **Sindh Cabinet's policy decisions and payment rules** reported via official state media (APP). Because this policy represents the legislative basis of the **Sindh Wheat Growers Support Program**, readers can find the comprehensive operational guide in our master article: [Sindh Wheat Subsidy 2026: Benazir Hari Card Registration Update](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/sindh-wheat-subsidy-benazir-hari-card-2026).
## Cabinet Approval: The 25-Acre Framework

The Sindh Cabinet, in its recent session chaired by Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah, formally ratified a comprehensive relief package for provincial wheat cultivators for the 2026–27 season.

The policy specifically caps financial assistance at **25 acres**, aiming to direct state resources to subsistence growers who bear the brunt of inflation in fuel, fertilizer, and agricultural chemicals.
## Key Rules: New Registration vs. Revalidation

To ensure fiscal transparency and eliminate duplicate payments, the cabinet mandated a strict verification protocol administered through the Revenue Department and Directorate General Agriculture Extension:

1. **Revalidation of Existing Beneficiaries:** Farmers who enrolled during earlier relief cycles must undergo data revalidation to verify continued cultivation and active land status.
2. **Fresh Registration of Unenrolled Growers:** Eligible smallholders not yet registered must present their land title (Form VII) or registered tenancy deeds before local scrutiny committees.
3. **Elimination of Intermediaries:** Under no circumstances will manual vouchers or cash distributions be permitted. All payouts are funneled through digital accounts.
## Payment Mechanism via Sindh Bank & Hari Card

The disbursement workflow approved by the provincial cabinet operates as follows:
- **Account Opening:** Eligible farmers are provided designated accounts at **Sindh Bank** linked with biometric verification.
- **Benazir Hari Card Issuance:** Cardholders receive a customized debit card enabling direct cash withdrawals at ATMs or branch point-of-sale (POS) terminals.
- **Direct Electronic Credit:** Subsidies for inputs such as DAP are credited via electronic funds transfer upon department authorization.
## Unconfirmed Disbursement Dates: What Farmers Should Know

> [!WARNING]
> **Official Disbursement Advisory:**
> While the cabinet has established the regulatory framework and budgetary approval, exact payment release dates are scheduled according to the provincial farming calendar. Farmers should beware of unauthorized agents demanding advance fees to release funds.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the landholding cut-off for the cabinet subsidy?**
The ceiling is strictly set at **25 acres** of land.

**Q2: Which bank processes the subsidy payments?**
Payments are managed through **Sindh Bank** into Benazir Hari Card accounts.

**Q3: Where can farmers report issues?**
Inquiries should be directed to the local Assistant Commissioner or District Agriculture Extension office.

title: Sindh Minimum Wage 2026: Official October Posting Confirms Rs43,000 Unskilled Worker Baseline
shortDescription: Sindh Minimum Wages Board official posting dated 12 October 2026 confirms statutory minimum wage rates in effect since 1 July 2026. Complete schedule for unskilled (Rs43,000), semi-skilled, skilled, and highly skilled workers with legal protections.
content: # Sindh Minimum Wage 2026: Official October Posting Confirms Rs43,000 Unskilled Worker Baseline
## Statutory Minimum Wage Overview & October Clarification

The **Sindh Labour & Human Resources Department**, acting on statutory recommendations formulated by the **Sindh Minimum Wages Board**, issued an official gazette posting on **12 October 2026** confirming the comprehensive schedule of minimum wages across recognized worker categories.

Under this statutory framework, the enforceable minimum wage for unskilled workers throughout Sindh stands firmly at **Rs. 43,000 per month**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Critical Editorial Caveat — No New October Wage Increase:**
> Readers and workers must clearly understand that this 12 October posting **does not announce a new wage hike originating in October 2026**.
> Rather, this official posting confirms and formally schedules the provincial wage rates that **took effect on 1 July 2026** under the Sindh provincial budget for FY 2026–27. Any claims on social media suggesting a separate mid-year wage increment in October are factually incorrect.
## Official Notified Wage Rates by Worker Category

The Sindh Minimum Wages Board has formally structured monthly and daily rates across four statutory tiers of employment:

| Worker Category | Minimum Monthly Wage | Minimum Daily Wage (Based on 26 Working Days) |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Unskilled Worker** | **Rs. 43,000** | **Rs. 1,653.84** |
| **Semi-Skilled Worker** | **Rs. 44,484** | **Rs. 1,710.92** |
| **Skilled Worker** | **Rs. 53,350** | **Rs. 2,051.92** |
| **Highly Skilled Worker** | **Rs. 55,626** | **Rs. 2,139.46** |

*Note on Daily Calculations: As per provincial labour jurisprudence, the daily wage is computed by dividing the monthly rate by 26 days, providing statutory compensation for mandatory weekly rest days.*
## Universal Legal Coverage Across Sindh

The minimum wage mandate applies without exception across the entire province of Sindh to:
1. **Industrial Enterprises:** Textile processing units, ginning factories, pharmaceuticals, automobile assembly lines, engineering workshops, and food manufacturing plants in SITE Karachi, Korangi, Landhi, Nooriabad, Hyderabad, Sukkur, and Larkana.
2. **Commercial & Service Sector:** Retail malls, private security agencies, janitorial contractors, IT software houses, educational academies, transport companies, and corporate offices.
3. **All Employment Formats:** The law strictly encompasses **permanent, temporary, contractual, piece-rate, and daily-wage employees**. Employers are explicitly barred from circumventing statutory rates by outsourcing workers to third-party labour contractors.
## Working Hours, Overtime & Illegal Deductions

- **Statutory Work Limits:** Standard working hours are strictly capped at **8 hours per day** and **48 hours per week** under the Sindh Factories Act and Shops & Establishments legislation.
- **Double Overtime Remuneration:** Any work required beyond standard hours must be compensated at **double the regular hourly wage**.
- **Deduction Protections:** Deductions are permissible solely for statutory social safety contributions, specifically **SESSI** (Sindh Employees Social Security Institution) and **EOBI** (Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution). Arbitrary deductions for tea, uniforms, disciplinary penalties, or broken items that depress take-home pay below statutory thresholds are illegal.
## How Workers Can File Complaints and Recover Wages

When an establishment pays below the statutory floor:
1. **Lodge Formal Grievance:** Submit a written complaint before the **Directorate of Labour Sindh** or the District Labour Officer in your district.
2. **Authority Under Payment of Wages Act:** Workers may file a claim under the **Payment of Wages Act** to recover withheld, deducted, or underpaid earnings along with statutory compensation.
3. **Anti-Retaliation Protection:** Provincial labour legislation strictly penalizes employers who terminate, victimize, or demote workers for asserting their statutory wage rights.
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the effective date of the Rs43,000 minimum wage in Sindh?**
The rate took effect on **1 July 2026**. The circular posted on 12 October 2026 is an official confirmation and schedule notification, not a new increase.

**Q2: Are contract workers and security guards entitled to Rs43,000?**
Yes. The Sindh Minimum Wages Act explicitly covers contract staff, daily-wage workers, and personnel supplied by third-party contracting agencies.

**Q3: Can an employer reduce salary by deducting food or uniform costs?**
No. The statutory minimum wage must be paid in full currency. Arbitrary deductions reducing cash pay below Rs43,000 for unskilled labor are strictly unlawful.

**Q4: Where can employers and workers verify official labour notifications?**
Official circulars are accessible at the Sindh Labour Department portal: [lhr.sindh.gov.pk](https://lhr.sindh.gov.pk/).
## Source Attribution & Related Articles

title: Sindh HEC Research Grants 2026–27 Open – Up to Rs5 Million
shortDescription: Sindh HEC invites research proposals under SRSP 2026–27. Eligible public university faculty members in Sindh can seek grants of up to Rs5 million across physical, medical, engineering, and social sciences. Deadline: 23 October 2026.
content: ### Official Call for Research Proposals: Sindh HEC SRSP 2026–27

The **Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)** has formally invited competitive research proposals from eligible faculty members under its flagship **Sindh Research Support Programme (SRSP) for the financial session 2026–27**.
The programme is specifically designed to provide competitive project financing to address strategic scientific, educational, technological, socioeconomic, and environmental challenges facing Sindh.
Eligible researchers may seek project funding of **up to Rs. 5 million (Rs. 5,000,000)** for a project duration of **two years**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Faculty Opportunity Only:** This programme is strictly intended for regular faculty members at Sindh's public sector universities and degree-awarding institutions. It is **not** an individual student scholarship for undergraduate or general BS students.
### Programme Overview Summary

- **Funding Agency:** Sindh Higher Education Commission (SHEC), Government of Sindh
- **Programme Title:** Sindh Research Support Programme (SRSP) 2026–27
- **Maximum Grant Amount:** Up to Rs. 5,000,000 per approved research project
- **Project Duration:** Two (2) Years
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026**
- **Target Beneficiaries:** Regular PhD and qualified clinical faculty of public-sector universities in Sindh
- **Official Programme Notice:** [sindhhec.gov.pk/sindh-research-support-programme](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/sindh-research-support-programme/)
- **Official Application Form:** [Download SRSP Application Form PDF](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/APPLICATION-FORM-SRSP-2026-27-UPDATED-FINAL-1.pdf)
- **Official Advertisement:** [View SRSP 2026–27 Advertisement](https://sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/SRSP-26-27.webp)
### Eligible Thematic & Research Disciplines

The official Sindh HEC circular covers a broad spectrum of research domains, with explicit funding allocations for:
- **Natural & Physical Sciences:** Physics, Chemistry, Earth Sciences, Mathematics
- **Medical & Health Sciences:** Clinical studies, epidemiology, diagnostics, pharmaceutical development
- **Engineering & Emerging Technology:** Civil, electrical, mechanical, renewable energy systems
- **Computing & Information Technology:** Artificial intelligence, data science, cybersecurity, software engineering
- **Social Sciences & Management:** Economics, public policy, governance, education emergency strategies
- **Agriculture, Food & Environmental Sciences:** Sustainable agriculture, water conservation, climate resilience

> [!NOTE]
> **Provincial Priority Areas:** In accordance with the official notice, preferential evaluation will be given to proposals directly addressing **Climate Change, Food Security, Water Management, Disaster Rehabilitation in Flood-affected areas, Public Health, Waterborne Diseases**, and initiatives with clear commercialization potential aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
### Eligibility Criteria for Principal Investigators (PI)

Applicants must meet all regulatory parameters specified in the official circular:
1. Must be a regular, full-time faculty member at a public-sector university or chartered degree-awarding institution (DAI) located in Sindh.
2. Must hold an earned PhD degree or recognized clinical terminal qualification (**FCPS, MCPS, FRCS** or equivalent).
3. Must not currently be holding another active research grant from Sindh HEC as Principal Investigator.
4. Faculty members who successfully received an SRSP award within the preceding two financial years are restricted from re-applying until completion.
### Step-by-Step Submission Procedure

1. Download the prescribed **SRSP 2026–27 Application Form** directly from the official Sindh HEC portal.
2. Formulate your detailed project proposal including abstract, project background, methodology, work packages, equipment requirements, and itemized budgetary justification.
3. Secure formal endorsement from your university's **Office of Research, Innovation & Commercialization (ORIC)** and head of institution (Vice Chancellor/Registrar).
4. Assemble all mandatory supporting documentation including institutional endorsement certificate, CV of PI and Co-PI, and price quotations for major equipment.
5. Submit the complete application dossier with the signed PDF in strict accordance with the official submission guidelines before **23 October 2026**.
### Important Editorial Caveat

The maximum grant of Rs5 million represents the upper funding ceiling per project, not an automatic grant disbursement. All submissions undergo technical peer review, ethical scrutiny, and competitive budgetary evaluation by the Sindh HEC Scientific Committee.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to submit research proposals for Sindh HEC SRSP 2026–27?**
The official deadline is **23 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can faculty members from private universities in Sindh apply?**
No. As per the official advertisement, SRSP 2026–27 is restricted to regular faculty members of public-sector universities and degree-awarding institutions in Sindh.

**Q3: What is the maximum funding duration?**
The funding period is for up to two years.

**Q4: Where can I obtain the official application form?**
The application form is available directly on the Sindh HEC portal: `sindhhec.gov.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/APPLICATION-FORM-SRSP-2026-27-UPDATED-FINAL-1.pdf`.

content: ### Official Admission Announcement: SZABIST Hyderabad Spring 2027

**Shaheed Zulfikar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST) University, Hyderabad Campus**, has officially published its **Spring 2027 Admission Schedule** across undergraduate, graduate, and postgraduate faculties.
The online admission portal opened on **12 October 2026**, and candidates may complete and submit their electronic applications until the published deadline of **10 December 2026**.
SZABIST is chartered by the Government of Sindh and recognized by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan.
### Key Admission Milestones & Official Schedule

- **Applications Opening Date:** **12 October 2026**
- **Last Date to Apply:** **10 December 2026**
- **On-Campus Entry Test Dates:** **14 & 15 December 2026**
- **Interviews for Shortlisted Candidates:** **18 to 21 December 2026**
- **Merit & Waiting Lists Announcement:** **22 December 2026**
- **Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 2,000** (Pakistani applicants to Bachelor's/Master's programmes)
- **Official Admissions Page:** [hyd.szabist.edu.pk/admissions.html](https://hyd.szabist.edu.pk/admissions.html)
- **Online Application Portal:** [admissionshyd.szabist.edu.pk](https://admissionshyd.szabist.edu.pk/)
### Programmes Offered & Eligibility Criteria

SZABIST Hyderabad offers degree paths across business, computing, and social sciences:

| Programme | Duration | Minimum Academic Requirement |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent A-Level qualifications. |
| **BS Accounting & Finance (BS A&F)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate or equivalent. |
| **BS Computer Science (BSCS)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (Pre-Engineering, ICS, or General Science with Maths). |
| **BS Software Engineering (BSSE)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate (Pre-Engineering / ICS) from an accredited board. |
| **BS Artificial Intelligence (BSAI)** | 4 Years | Minimum 50% marks in Intermediate with Mathematics or equivalent credentials. |
| **BS Psychology** | 4 Years | Minimum 45% marks in Intermediate in any group. |
| **BS International Relations (BSIR)** | 4 Years | Minimum 45% marks in Intermediate in any group. |
| **Master of Business Administration (MBA)** | 1.5 to 2 Years | 16-Year business/non-business degree with minimum 2.5 CGPA or equivalent. |
| **MS Computer Science / Management Sciences** | 2 Years | 16-Year relevant degree with minimum 2.5 CGPA and university GAT test qualification. |
### Fee Structure Highlights & Waivers

According to the official fee schedule displayed by the Hyderabad campus:
- **Application Processing Fee:** Rs. 2,000
- **Course Registration & Exam Fees:** Charged per semester alongside tuition.
- **Disability Fee Waiver:** Complete tuition fee waiver and degree equivalence fee waiver are provided for students with certified disabilities in accordance with university policy.
### Step-by-Step Application Procedure

1. Navigate to the official admission portal: `admissionshyd.szabist.edu.pk`.
2. Create an applicant profile using a functional email address and active mobile number.
3. Select your intended degree programme and complete your academic background details.
4. Upload scanned copies of your Matriculation and Intermediate marks sheets, CNIC/B-Form, and passport-size photographs.
5. Generate the admission processing fee voucher (Rs. 2,000) and pay via authorized bank branches or designated online banking channels.
6. Upload proof of fee payment and finalize submission before **10 December 2026**.
7. Print your application confirmation and monitor your portal profile for entry test roll numbers.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for SZABIST Hyderabad Spring 2027?**
The last date to submit online applications is **10 December 2026**.

**Q2: When will the entry tests take place?**
The on-campus entry tests are scheduled for **14 and 15 December 2026**.

**Q3: What is the minimum percentage required for BS Computer Science?**
Candidates must have at least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) or equivalent qualification with Mathematics.

**Q4: Can awaiting-result students apply?**
Candidates with completed Part-I results may apply subject to the university's provisional admission guidelines.

content: ### Official Notification: Admissions 2027 Deadline Extended

Candidates who were unable to submit their applications by the previous cutoff of 10 October may now submit their online applications until **Saturday, 17 October 2026**.
The pre-entry test schedule remains unchanged, offering prospective candidates an expanded window to complete registration.
### Revised Admission Timetable

- **Issuing Institution:** The Shaikh Ayaz University, Shikarpur, Sindh
- **Notification Date:** 10 October 2026
- **Previous Application Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Revised Application Deadline:** **Saturday, 17 October 2026**
- **Pre-Entry Admission Test:** **Saturday, 7 November 2026**
- **Test Results Announcement:** **Monday, 9 November 2026**
- **First Merit List Display:** **Wednesday, 11 November 2026**

- **Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 2,500** (Payable via Habib Bank Limited / designated challan)

- **Online Admission Portal:** [admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions](https://admissions.saus.edu.pk/admissions)
### Academic Programmes Offered

The university is admitting students into both **1st Semester (4-Year BS)** and **5th Semester (Lateral Entry)** programmes across key faculties:
- **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)**
- **BS Computer Science (BSCS)**
- **BS Information Technology (BSIT)**
- **BS Mathematics**
- **BS Commerce**

### Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]

No. The pre-entry test remains scheduled for **7 November 2026**.

**Q3: What is the application processing fee?**
The application fee is Rs. 2,500 payable via bank challan.

**Q4: When will merit lists be published?**
The first merit list is scheduled for publication on **11 November 2026**.

The Doctor of Physical Therapy is a 5-year full-time undergraduate degree programme.

content: ### Official Notice: FJWU Paid Lab Engineer Internship

**Fatima Jinnah Women University (FJWU), Rawalpindi**, has officially announced a **paid internship opening** for a **Lab Engineer / Intern with PEC/COMP Number** under the university's Placement Office.
The official vacancy circular was released on **9 October 2026**, inviting applications from qualified female engineering and computing graduates.
Interested candidates must submit their application materials to the Placement Office by **14 October 2026**.
### Internship Overview & Requirements

- **Organization:** Fatima Jinnah Women University (FJWU), The Mall, Rawalpindi
- **Position:** Intern (Paid) — Lab Engineer / Intern with PEC/COMP Number
- **Announcement Date:** 9 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **14 October 2026**
- **Stipend:** Paid Internship (Official circular does not quote a specific stipend figure)
- **Official Notification URL:** [fjwu.edu.pk Internship Notice](https://fjwu.edu.pk/internship/internship-openings-intern-paid-lab-engineer-intern-with-peccomp-number/)
### Mandatory Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must satisfy each of the following conditions:
1. **Education:** Minimum **16 years of education** in an applicable engineering or computing discipline.
2. **Graduation Window:** The most recent degree must have been completed **within the last 2 years** (2024–2026).
3. **Employment Status:** Candidates must **currently be unemployed**.
4. **Age Limit:** Maximum age of **30 years** on the closing date.
5. **Professional Registration:** Must hold a valid Pakistan Engineering Council (**PEC**) registration number or computing equivalent (**COMP number**).
### How to Apply

1. Prepare an up-to-date, professional Curriculum Vitae (CV) and a concise cover letter.
2. Clearly state the exact position applied for: *"Intern (paid) - Lab Engineer / intern with PEC/COMP number"*.
3. Submit your CV and cover letter directly to the **Placement Office, Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi** before **14 October 2026**.
4. Only shortlisted applicants meeting all eligibility benchmarks will be contacted for an interview.

> [!NOTE]
> **Salary Integrity:** The university circular describes the internship as paid but does not specify a numerical stipend. In line with CareerDost's editorial standards, no estimated or invented stipend figure is published.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for the FJWU internship?**
Applications must reach the FJWU Placement Office by **14 October 2026**.

**Q2: Is PEC registration mandatory?**
Yes. The official notice specifies that applicants must hold a PEC or COMP registration number.

**Q3: Can candidates with older graduation years apply?**
No. Eligibility is restricted to graduates who finished their final degree within the past two years.

### Registration of Interest: MBBS & BDS Session 2026–27

**Isra University** has officially opened its **Registration of Interest** for prospective medical and dental students seeking admission into **MBBS and BDS programmes for the 2026–27 academic session**.
The university's registration mechanism offers prospective candidates the opportunity to be evaluated for **full and partial scholarships** during its initial registration drive.

This expression of interest constitutes the preliminary stage of applicant engagement and does **not** replace statutory admission procedures governed by the Pakistan Medical and Dental Council (PM&DC).
### Campus Breakdown for Medical & Dental Studies

- **MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine & Bachelor of Surgery):** Available at **Hyderabad**, **Karachi**, and **Islamabad** campuses.
- **BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery):** Available at the **Hyderabad** campus.
### Scholarship Drive Mechanism

According to the university's official application guide, Drive 1 participants will be invited to appear in a specialized **Scholarship Assessment Test and Interview** to compete for full and partial tuition scholarships.
Registration of interest is completely **free of cost** (no initial processing fee is charged at this preliminary stage).
### Mandatory Eligibility Standards

Applicants must satisfy all statutory regulatory benchmarks established by the PM&DC:
1. Minimum 60% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) or equivalent foreign examination (IBCC Equivalence required).
2. Valid MDCAT 2026 result satisfying the provincial/national passing threshold.
3. Final admission offers remain strictly subject to national merit calculation formulas and PM&DC medical admissions regulations.
### Registration Procedure

1. Access the official registration system: `register.isra.edu.pk`.
2. Create your applicant profile using your CNIC/B-Form and contact details.
3. Provide your academic background, MDCAT roll number/score, and select your preferred campus.
4. Indicate your intent to be evaluated for scholarship consideration.
5. Submit your profile and save your electronic confirmation receipt.

title: LUMS Research Associate Jobs 2026 – Nano Physics Lab
shortDescription: LUMS invites applications for a contractual Research Associate (PPS-7) at its Laboratory for Nanophysics. 16-year bachelor degree and 1 year lab experience required. Deadline: 19 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment: LUMS Laboratory for Nanophysics

**Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)** has advertised a contractual **Research Associate (PPS-7)** position at its **Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL)** within the National Centre for Nano-science and Nanotechnology (NCNN).
The role is funded through a government-approved **PSDP project** focused on advanced experimental, theoretical, and computational nanoscience.
Applications are being received via direct email submission to the project Principal Investigator.
### Position Summary

- **Hiring Institution:** Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS), DHA, Lahore
- **Position Title:** Research Associate (Project Pay Scale PPS-7)
- **Laboratory:** Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL) – NCNN
- **Nature of Appointment:** Contractual, PSDP Project-Based
- **Target Deadline:** **19 October 2026** (Editorial baseline; official LUMS HR listing accepts CVs through **22 October 2026**)
- **Application Email:** `adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`
- **Required Email Subject:** `"Research Assistant - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`
- **Official Careers Page:** [hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us](https://hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us)
### Key Roles & Responsibilities

The Research Associate will assist the research group in:
- Conducting experimental, theoretical, or computational research in nano-optics, spintronics, quantum materials, and scientific computing.
- Designing and executing laboratory trials, operating optical and laser characterization equipment, and recording data.
- Performing data analysis using specialized analytical and numerical simulation tools.
- Maintaining laboratory notebooks, managing experimental documentation, and contributing to scholarly peer-reviewed papers.
### Minimum Eligibility Requirements

1. **Academic Qualification:** Bachelor’s degree (16 years of education) in **Physics, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Materials Science, Nanoscience & Nanotechnology, Computer Science**, or a related discipline.
2. **Experience:** Minimum **one (1) year** of demonstrable research or scientific laboratory experience.
3. **Preferred Skills:** Hands-on exposure to optics, lasers, cryogenic instrumentation, condensed-matter physics, scientific computing, or machine learning applications in quantum technologies.
### How to Apply

1. Prepare an updated Curriculum Vitae highlighting your academic coursework, laboratory techniques, research publications, and software proficiencies.
2. Send your CV via email to **`adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`**.
3. Strictly format the email subject line as instructed by LUMS HR: **`"Research Assistant - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`**.
4. Submit your application prior to the closing deadline.

> [!NOTE]
> **Salary Transparency:** This is a project-funded appointment on PPS-7 pay scale rules. The visible vacancy announcement does not quote an exact monthly salary, and none is invented here.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the application deadline for the LUMS Research Associate position?**
The baseline deadline is 19 October 2026, with the official LUMS careers portal noting applications accepted until 22 October 2026.

**Q2: How do I apply?**
Apply by emailing your CV directly to `adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk` with the subject line `"Research Assistant - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`.

**Q3: Can fresh graduates without lab experience apply?**
The official criteria require at least one year of relevant research or laboratory experience.

title: LUMS Electronic Technician Jobs 2026 – Apply by 19 October
shortDescription: LUMS is recruiting an Electronic Technician (PPS-6) for its Laboratory for Nanophysics. Relevant technical diploma and 1 year experience required. Deadline: 19 October 2026.
content: ### Official Technical Vacancy: LUMS Laboratory for Nanophysics

**Lahore University of Management Sciences (LUMS)** is hiring a qualified **Electronic Technician (PPS-6)** for its **Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL)** within the National Centre for Nano-science and Nanotechnology (NCNN).
The technician will be responsible for installing, assembling, maintaining, and calibrating advanced electronic, optical, and scientific equipment supporting research projects.
The role is contractual and linked to a government-sponsored **PSDP research project**.
### Position Profile

- **Employer:** LUMS, Lahore
- **Role Title:** Electronic Technician (Project Pay Scale PPS-6)
- **Department:** Laboratory for Nanophysics (NPL) – NCNN
- **Target Deadline:** **19 October 2026** (Editorial baseline; official LUMS HR listing accepts CVs through **22 October 2026**)
- **Submission Channel:** Direct Email (`adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`)
- **Required Email Subject:** `"Electronic Technician - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`
- **Official LUMS Careers Page:** [hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us](https://hr.lums.edu.pk/join-us)
### Duties & Technical Responsibilities

- Install, operate, maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and repair laboratory instruments and electronic systems.
- Assemble, test, and integrate electronic circuits, power supplies, signal-conditioning units, sensors, and data-acquisition interfaces.
- Assist with the maintenance of vacuum systems, electromagnets, cooling apparatus, and optical instruments.
- Maintain equipment logs, circuit schematics, calibration reports, and preventive maintenance records.
- Ensure strict compliance with laboratory electrical and laser safety protocols.
### Eligibility Standards

1. **Educational Qualification:** Recognized diploma (DAE or equivalent) in **Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Physics**, or a closely related technical field.
2. **Professional Experience:** Minimum **one (1) year** of hands-on experience in electronic equipment repair, circuit testing, or scientific laboratory maintenance.
3. **Practical Skills:** Demonstrated skill in circuit soldering, cable fabrication, equipment testing with oscilloscopes and multimeters, and component inventory control.
### How to Apply

1. Assemble an updated CV clearly outlining your technical diploma, hands-on instrumentation background, and previous work history.
2. Email your CV to **`adam.zaman@lums.edu.pk`**.
3. Use the mandatory email subject line: **`"Electronic Technician - Nano Physics Lab (NPL)"`**.
4. Send your email prior to the closing deadline.

> [!NOTE]
> **No Estimated Salary:** The vacancy notice does not state a numerical monthly stipend or wage. CareerDost adheres to verified reporting and does not estimate compensation.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What qualification is needed for the Electronic Technician role?**
A diploma in electrical, electronics, instrumentation, physics, or a related discipline with at least one year of experience.

**Q2: What is the application deadline?**
The baseline deadline is 19 October 2026, with LUMS HR listing open until 22 October 2026.

**Q3: Is this a permanent university position?**
No. The official announcement clarifies that this is a contractual, PSDP project-based position.

### Official Recruitment Notice: SPSC Advertisement No. 05/2026

The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)**, Thandi Sarak, Hyderabad, has officially issued its **Consolidated Advertisement No. 05/2026 (Dated: 25.09.2026)** inviting online applications for **54 permanent government vacancies** across various provincial departments.

The positions range from **Basic Pay Scale 16 (BPS-16)** to **Basic Pay Scale 18 (BPS-18)** and cover the Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment, Home Department, Information Department, Planning & Development Department, and Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution Department.

Eligible male, female, and minority candidates holding Sindh domicile (Rural and Urban quotas) can apply exclusively online through the SPSC portal before the closing deadline of **23 October 2026 at 5:00 PM**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Manual Applications Barred:** As stated in the official circular, manual hardcopy applications will **NOT** be entertained under any circumstances. All applicants must submit their application electronically via the official SPSC candidate portal (`spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/`).
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Recruiting Body:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Hyderabad
- **Advertisement Number:** Consolidated Advertisement No. 05/2026
- **Issue Date:** 25 September 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026 (Strictly by 5:00 PM)**
- **Total Vacancies:** **54 Positions**
- **Job Categories:** 8 Distinct Posts (BPS-16 to BPS-18)
- **Application Fee:** **Rs. 500 per post** (Payable via PSID 1Bill)
- **Eligible Domicile:** Sindh (Rural & Urban Quotas as specified)
- **Official Notification PDF:** [spsc.gov.pk Adv 05/2026](https://spsc.gov.pk/advertisement/2026/adv-05-2026.pdf)
- **Online Registration Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/)
### Detailed Vacancy Breakdown & Quota Comparison Table

The 54 advertised vacancies are distributed across departments and quota categories as follows:

| Sr | Department | Post Name with Scale | Total Posts | Rural | Urban | Age Limit | Minimum Qualification & Experience |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| 1 | Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment | **Deputy Director (I.T) / Senior Manager I.T (BPS-18)** | 01 | 01 | 00 | 28–35 | 16-Year Bachelor in IT or CS (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA) from HEC recognized university + 5 years relevant experience in IT project implementation and management. |
| 2 | Enquiries & Anti-Corruption Establishment | **Assistant Director (I.T) / System Analyst (BPS-17)** | 01 | 01 | 00 | 21–28 | 16-Year Bachelor in IT or CS (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA) from HEC recognized university. |
| 3 | Home Department | **Medical Officer (Male) (BPS-17)** | 32 | 19 | 13 | 21–28 | MBBS from HEC recognized university, PM&DC registration, and completion of 1-year house job. (Rural: 17 Open, 1 Disabled, 1 Minority; Urban: 11 Open, 1 Disabled, 1 Minority). |
| 4 | Home Department | **Lady Medical Officer (BPS-17)** | 04 | 02 | 02 | 21–28 | MBBS from HEC recognized university, PM&DC registration, and completion of 1-year house job. (All Open Merit). |
| 5 | Information Department | **Information Officer (BPS-17)** | 04 | 02 | 02 | 18–30 | Master's in Mass Communication / Journalism from HEC recognized university + 3 to 5 years relevant experience. (Rural: 1 Open, 1 Female Minority; Urban: 1 Open, 1 Male Differently Abled). |
| 6 | Planning & Development Department | **Assistant Director (BPS-17)** | 01 | 00 | 01 | 21–28 | Master's / 16-Year Degree in Public Administration / Human Resource Management / M.A Economics / Public Policy (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA). (Urban Open Merit). |
| 7 | Planning & Development Department | **Programme Officer (BPS-17)** | 01 | 00 | 01 | 21–28 | 16-Year Graduation in Computer Science / IT / Software Engineering (2nd Div/equivalent CGPA). (Urban Open Merit). |
| 8 | Law, Parliamentary Affairs & Criminal Prosecution | **Assistant (BPS-16)** | 10 | 06 | 04 | 21–31 | Graduate at least in 2nd Division from HEC recognized university. (Rural: 5 Open, 1 Female; Urban: 3 Open, 1 Female). |
### Age Relaxation Guidelines

> [!NOTE]
> General upper age relaxation is admissible in accordance with Government of Sindh Notification **NO.SOII (SGA&CD) 5-64/2011(Part-II) Dated 06.03.2025** across provincial posts, providing qualified candidates appropriate relief as per Sindh civil servant rules.
### Online Application Procedure & PSID Fee Generation

1. **Access the Official Portal:** Navigate to [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk/) and enter the Candidate Portal at `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/`.
2. **Account Registration:** Register using your Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) number and valid mobile/email contacts.
3. **Profile Setup:** Fill in your personal bio-data, academic qualifications, PRC Form-D, and district domicile.
4. **Select Advertised Job:** Click on **Available Jobs** and choose your desired position under Advertisement No. 05/2026.
5. **Generate PSID:** Generate your individual **1Bill / PSID** invoice for the application fee of **Rs. 500/-** per post.
6. **Deposit Challan Fee:** Pay electronically through 1Bill using any Mobile Banking app (Easypaisa, JazzCash, 1Link banking apps, ATM, or over-the-counter).
7. **Final Submit:** Complete verification and submit your form before the portal locks at **5:00 PM on 23 October 2026**.
### Mandatory Documents for Candidate Verification

Candidates qualifying the written test will be called for interview and document scrutiny, where they must present:
- Original CNIC / NADRA Smart Card
- Original Domicile Certificate & PRC on Form-D
- Degree certificates and marks sheets (Matriculation to Terminal Degree)
- PM&DC Registration Certificate (for Medical Officers)
- Valid Experience Certificates where required by the service rules
- Departmental NOC for existing government employees
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPSC Advertisement 05/2026?**
The closing deadline is **23 October 2026 at 5:00 PM (Office Hours)**.

**Q2: What is the application fee per post in SPSC?**
The application fee is **Rs. 500 per post**, payable online through 1Bill invoice/PSID.

**Q3: Can candidates with non-Sindh domicile apply?**
No. All posts under SPSC Adv 05/2026 require a valid Sindh Domicile and PRC (Form-D) under either Rural or Urban quotas.

**Q4: Can one candidate apply for multiple positions?**
Yes. Candidates eligible for more than one post may submit separate online applications with separate PSID payments.

**Q5: Is house job mandatory for Medical Officer (BPS-17) posts?**
Yes. Medical Officer and Lady Medical Officer posts strictly require completion of a one-year regular house job alongside valid PM&DC registration.

title: SPSC Departmental Exam Slips 2026 Available – Examinations Start 12 October
shortDescription: SPSC releases official online Admission Slips for Departmental Examinations starting Monday, 12 October 2026. Review digital reference tablet rules, center protocols, and access your slip on spsc.gov.pk.
content: ### Official Notification: SPSC Departmental Examination Slips Released

The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)** has issued official **Press Release No. PSC/EXAM-II/2026/93 (Dated: 09-10-2026)** informing all concerned departmental officers and candidates that **Admission Slips for Departmental Examinations commencing from 12th October 2026** are now available for online download.
The examinations commence on **Monday, 12 October 2026**, across designated examination halls in Sindh. All appearing officers must print their admission slips and carry them to the exam venue.
### Privacy & Candidate Protection Notice

> [!NOTE]
> **Candidate Privacy Commitment:** In strict compliance with digital privacy standards, **CareerDost does NOT collect, store, or process candidates' CNIC numbers.**
>
> To retrieve your official admission slip safely, visit the authorized SPSC portal directly: `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips`.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Issuing Authority:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC), Hyderabad
- **Press Release Reference:** No. PSC/EXAM-II/2026/93
- **Press Release Date:** 9 October 2026
- **Examinations Commencement:** **Monday, 12 October 2026**
- **Admission Slip Status:** **Live and Available Online**
- **Official Slip Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips)
- **Official Press Release Image:** [spsc.gov.pk PR Image](https://spsc.gov.pk/recent-announcements/Oct2026/PR_Departmentalonlineadmissionslip.jpg)
### Revolutionary Exam Hall Guidelines: Electronic Tablets for Reference Books

In a major technological advancement for provincial examinations, the SPSC examination branch has implemented new paper rules:

1. **No Physical Books Permitted:** No physical printed books or law manuals will be allowed inside the examination hall, nor will SPSC provide any printed books.
2. **Digital Reference Facility on SPSC Electronic Tablets:** All prescribed reference books will be provided in digital format on **electronic tablets supplied by SPSC**.
3. **Interactive Search & Navigation:** Candidates can select the relevant Paper and Book on the tablet, navigate forward/backward through pages, and utilize **advanced keyword search** to locate rules, legal sections, and statutory material rapidly.
4. **No Supplementary Answer Sheets:** The Commission has explicitly notified that **no additional or supplementary answer sheets will be provided** under any circumstances. Candidates must organize their handwriting and time within the sufficient pages provided in the original Answer Copy.
### Mandatory Center Instructions

> [!WARNING]
> - **Mandatory Slip:** No candidate shall be allowed to sit in the examination hall without presenting a clear printed copy of their official Admission Slip.
> - **Original CNIC:** Candidates must also present their original NADRA CNIC alongside the admission slip.
> - **Strict Ban on Personal Gadgets:** Personal smartphones, smartwatches, recording devices, or personal tablets are strictly banned in the exam center.
### Step-by-Step Guide to Download SPSC Admission Slips

1. Open the official SPSC portal: [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips).
2. Enter your valid 13-digit Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) number without hyphens.
3. Select your designated departmental examination category from the dropdown.
4. Click **Search / Download Admission Slip**.
5. Print your admission slip on clean A4 white paper and verify your center location and roll number.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When do the SPSC Departmental Examinations 2026 begin?**
The examinations commence on **Monday, 12 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can candidates bring their own law books or bare acts to the hall?**
No. SPSC has strictly prohibited physical books. Prescribed reference books will be accessible via SPSC-provided digital tablets.

**Q3: Will supplementary answer copies be provided if pages run out?**
No. SPSC has confirmed that no supplementary sheets will be issued, and candidates must utilize the available answer book pages carefully.

**Q4: Where can I download my departmental admission slip?**
Admission slips can be downloaded directly from the official portal at `https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/dde/slips`.

title: Sindh Courts Jobs 2026 – BPS 1 to 4 Vacancy Notice & Walk-in Interview Schedule
shortDescription: Criminal Prosecution Services Department Sindh announces BPS 1–4 vacancies (Circular 000000221) for 232 Head Office posts at High Court Karachi plus 28 District Courts. Walk-in interviews 19–31 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment Circular: Criminal Prosecution Services Department, Sindh

The **Criminal Prosecution Services Department, Government of Sindh**, through the **Office of the Prosecutor General Sindh** (located at 4th Floor, Administration Block, High Court of Sindh, Karachi), has officially published **Circular No. 000000221 (Advertisement INF-KRY No. 4363-26)** announcing walk-in interviews for regular **BPS-01 to BPS-04 vacancies**.
The recruitment drive covers **232 posts at the Head Office in Karachi** and hundreds of Class-IV positions across **all 28 District Public Prosecutor Offices** throughout Sindh.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Recruiting Department:** Criminal Prosecution Services Department, Government of Sindh
- **Headquarters Venue:** 4th Floor, Administration Block, High Court of Sindh, Karachi
- **Circular Reference:** Circular No. 000000221 / INF-KRY 4363-26
- **Notification Date:** 6 October 2026
- **Walk-in Interview Window:** **19 October 2026 to 31 October 2026 (District-wise dates)**
- **Age Bracket:** **18 to 30 Years** (General upper age relaxation admissible per Govt Policy)
- **Provincial Quotas:** Rural 60% & Urban 40% (Head Office); District Domicile/PRC for District Offices
- **Special Quotas:** 5% Minorities, 5% Women, 5% Persons with Disabilities
- **Official Circular PDF:** [sindh.gov.pk Circular 221](https://www.sindh.gov.pk/storage/jobs/G4Icmpe10ofBomVMkntpOEisisUvCt2Tl9Uo8mK0.pdf)
- **Official Sindh Job Portal:** [iwork4sindh.com](https://www.iwork4sindh.com)
### Vacant Posts & Prescribed Qualifications

| Sr | Name of Post | Basic Scale | Minimum Qualification & Recruitment Method |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :--- |
| 1 | **Dispatch Rider** | BPS-04 | At least Primary Pass & valid Driving License for Motor Cycle. |
| 2 | **Driver** | BPS-04 | At least Primary Pass & valid Driving License of Car/LTV with at least two (02) years driving experience with capacity to maintain log book. |
| 3 | **Daftari** | BPS-02 | Primary Pass will be preferred. |
| 4 | **Chowkidar** | BPS-01 | Preferably literate. |
| 5 | **Naib Qasid** | BPS-01 | Preferably literate. |
| 6 | **Sanitary Worker** | BPS-01 | Experience in sanitary and cleaning work. |
### Head Office Vacancy Distribution (High Court Karachi)

For the Office of the Prosecutor General Sindh, Karachi (Head Office), the 232 vacancies are divided as:
- **Naib Qasid (BPS-01):** 105 Posts
- **Daftari (BPS-02):** 41 Posts
- **Dispatch Rider (BPS-04):** 33 Posts
- **Sanitary Worker (BPS-01):** 32 Posts
- **Driver (BPS-04):** 19 Posts
- **Chowkidar (BPS-01):** 02 Posts
### Complete Verified Walk-in Interview Schedule

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Schedule 1: Head Office Posts (Venue: Prosecutor General Sindh, 4th Floor, Administration Block, High Court of Sindh, Karachi)**
>
> - **Day-1 (Monday, 19 October 2026):** Candidates holding Domicile/PRC of District South, East, West, Central & Malir Karachi.
> - **Day-2 (Tuesday, 20 October 2026):** District Sujawal, Thatta, Hyderabad, Jamshoro, Badin & Matiari.
> - **Day-3 (Wednesday, 21 October 2026):** District Tando Muhammad Khan, Tando Allahyar, Mirpurkhas, Tharparkar (Mithi), Sanghar.
> - **Day-4 (Thursday, 22 October 2026):** District Dadu, Umerkot, Sukkur, Ghotki, Naushahro Feroze & Khairpur.
> - **Day-5 (Saturday, 24 October 2026):** District Shaheed Benazirabad, Larkana, Kamber-Shahdadkot, Jacobabad, Shikarpur & Kashmore.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Schedule 2: District Public Prosecutor Office Posts (Venue: Respective District Public Prosecutor Office)**
>
> - **Day-1 (Monday, 26 October 2026):** District Sujawal, Thatta, Hyderabad & Jamshoro.
> - **Day-2 (Tuesday, 27 October 2026):** District Badin, Tando Muhammad Khan, Tando Allahyar & Mirpurkhas.
> - **Day-3 (Wednesday, 28 October 2026):** District Tharparkar (Mithi), Dadu, Umerkot, Sukkur, Ghotki & Naushahro Feroze.
> - **Day-4 (Thursday, 29 October 2026):** District Shaheed Benazirabad, Larkana, Kamber-Shahdadkot, Jacobabad, Shikarpur.
> - **Day-5 (Saturday, 31 October 2026):** District Kashmore, Khairpur, Sanghar & Matiari.
### How to Appear for the Walk-in Interview

1. Prepare a written job application on plain paper stating the post applied for.
2. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
3. Attach attested photocopies of:
   - CNIC / Smart Card
   - Domicile & PRC (Form-D)
   - Educational certificates / Primary school leaving pass
   - Valid Driving License (for Drivers & Dispatch Riders)
   - Two recent passport-size photographs
4. Bring original documents on the interview date corresponding to your district.
5. Selected candidates will be notified via official telephone calls within 15 days following the interview.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Where will the interviews for Head Office posts take place?**
At the Office of the Prosecutor General Sindh, 4th Floor, Administration Block, High Court of Sindh, Karachi.

**Q2: What is the age limit for these BPS 1–4 positions?**
The basic age limit is **18 to 30 years**, with general upper age relaxation admissible under Sindh Government policy.

**Q3: Can candidates from interior Sindh apply for the Head Office posts?**
Yes. Head Office posts maintain 60% rural and 40% urban Sindh quotas according to the assigned district dates.

**Q4: Is there an application fee?**
No. Walk-in interviews for these BPS 1–4 positions carry no application or processing fee.

title: QUEST Nawabshah PhD, ME/MS Admissions 2026 – Apply Before 23 October
shortDescription: QUEST Nawabshah opens online admissions for 17th Batch PhD and 26th Batch ME/MS (Phase-II). 22-Batch final semester students eligible. Apply on pgs.quest.edu.pk by 23 October 2026.
content: ### Official Admission Announcement: Postgraduate Admissions (Phase-II)

**Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah**, has officially announced admissions for the **17th Batch of Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)** and **26th Batch of Master of Engineering (ME) / Master of Science (MS)** for the Phase-II cycle.
Degree tracks are offered under both **Course Work Only** and **Course Work + Research Work (Mixed Mode)** across engineering, computing, mathematics, and linguistics faculties.
Online registration opened on **03 October 2026** and will remain active until **23 October 2026**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Final Year (22-Batch) Students Eligible:** Candidates currently appearing in their 2nd semester final year (22-Batch) BE/BS programs are explicitly declared eligible to apply for ME/MS programs by the Directorate of Postgraduate Studies.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah
- **Covered Batches:** 17th Batch PhD & 26th Batch ME/MS (Phase-II)
- **Announcement Date:** 02 October 2026
- **Online Portal Start Date:** 03 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026**
- **Entry Test Fee:** **Rs. 5,000/-** (Deposited at any Habib Bank Limited branch via generated challan)
- **Official Admission Portal:** [pgs.quest.edu.pk](https://pgs.quest.edu.pk/)
- **University Notice:** [quest.edu.pk/news/290](https://www.quest.edu.pk/news/290/)
- **PGS Focal Contact:** Mr. Pir Riaz Ahmed, Assistant Director (PGS), Ph: 0332-4068888
### Academic Disciplines Offered

1. **PhD Programs (12 Disciplines):**
   - Civil Engineering
   - Mechanical Engineering
   - Electrical Engineering
   - Electronic Engineering
   - Computer Systems Engineering
   - Energy & Environment Engineering
   - Environmental Engineering
   - Telecommunication Engineering
   - Information Technology
   - Mathematics
   - Software Engineering
   - Computer Science

2. **Master of Engineering (ME) Programs (16 Disciplines):**
   - Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering & Management, Structural Engineering
   - Power Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management
   - Computer Systems Engineering, Computer Communication & Networks
   - Energy & Environment Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Energy Systems Engineering
   - Communication Engineering, Industrial Automation & Control
   - Telecommunication Systems & Networks, Electronic Engineering, Software Engineering

3. **Master of Science (MS) Programs (6 Disciplines):**
   - Information Technology
   - Software Engineering
   - Computer Science
   - Data Science
   - Mathematics
   - English Linguistics
### Eligibility Criteria & Minimum Passing Marks

- **For PhD Programs:** Minimum CGPA of **3.00/4.00** in relevant 18-year Master's degree from QUEST or HEC recognized university. Applicants must achieve at least **60% marks** in International GRE/HAT General or the university-administered computer-based test.
- **For ME/MS Programs:** Minimum CGPA of **2.00/4.00** in relevant 16-year Bachelor's degree (BE/BS). Candidates must obtain at least **50% marks** in GRE/HAT General, NTS-GAT General, or the university computer-based entry test.
- **Entry Test Schedule:** Computer-based entry test dates will be officially announced by the university following application scrutiny.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Visit the official QUEST postgraduate portal: [pgs.quest.edu.pk](https://pgs.quest.edu.pk/).
2. Register your user profile with your CNIC and email.
3. Fill in your academic credentials, graduation records, and personal details.
4. Download and print the **Rs. 5,000/- Entry Test Fee Challan**.
5. Deposit the fee at any branch of Habib Bank Limited (HBL) across Pakistan.
6. Upload scanned copies of your paid bank challan, recent photograph, and educational transcripts.
7. Finalize and submit the application before **23 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for QUEST postgraduate admissions?**
The last date for online application submission is **23 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can final year 22-batch BE/BS students apply?**
Yes. Candidates appearing in their final semester (22-Batch) BE/BS can apply for ME/MS programs.

**Q3: What is the entry test fee and where is it paid?**
The test fee is **Rs. 5,000/-**, payable through computerized challan at any HBL branch.

**Q4: Has the entry test date been announced?**
No. QUEST has officially stated that the computer-based test timetable will be announced after application screening.

title: QUEST Special Exams 2026 – Timetable and Exam Centres Announced
shortDescription: QUEST Nawabshah releases official timetable and examination centres (Annexure A) for Special Supplementary Exams of 20 to 22 Batches starting Monday, 12 October 2026.
content: ### Official Notification: Special Supplementary Examination Schedule Released

**Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah**, has officially notified the complete timetable and center distribution for the **Special Supplementary Examination of First Semester First Year (1st Semester) BE/BS/Tech for 20-, 21- & 22-Batches (Notification No. /QUEST/NH/EXAM/-856, Dated: 05.10.2026)**.
The theory examinations will be conducted from **Monday, 12 October 2026, to Monday, 19 October 2026**, covering eligible students of the QUEST Main Campus (Nawabshah) and Larkano Campus (Old).
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering, Science & Technology (QUEST), Nawabshah
- **Notification Number:** No. /QUEST/NH/EXAM/-856
- **Notification Date:** 05 October 2026 (Published: 07 October 2026)
- **Examination Start Date:** **Monday, 12 October 2026**
- **Examination End Date:** **Monday, 19 October 2026**
- **Eligible Batches:** **20-, 21-, and 22-Batches (BE / BS / Technology)**
- **Semester Covered:** **First Semester - First Year (Theory)**
- **Campuses:** Nawabshah Main Campus & Larkano Campus (Old)
- **Official Notice Link:** [quest.edu.pk/news/291](https://www.quest.edu.pk/news/291/)
### Official Examination Centers (Annexure A)

The Controller of Examinations has established designated departmental examination centres as follows:

| Examination Centre | Assigned Departments |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Civil Centre** | Civil Engineering, Building & Architectural Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology |
| **Mechanical Centre** | Mechanical Engineering, Industrial & Manufacturing Engineering, Mathematics |
| **Electrical Centre** | Electrical Engineering, Electrical (Automation Control), Electronic & Bio-Medical Engineering |
| **Computer Systems Centre** | Computer Systems Engineering, Software Engineering |
| **Environment Centre** | Environment Engineering, Energy System, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Food |
| **Telecommunication Centre** | Telecommunication Engineering, Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence |
| **English Centre** | English Department |
| **Computer Science Centre** | Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science |
### Daily Paper Timetable Schedule

Theory examinations will be held in the afternoon session:
- **Monday, 12.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Civil Engineering Materials, Applied Physics, Engineering Materials, Engineering Mechanics.
- **Tuesday, 13.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Functional English across engineering and computing disciplines.
- **Wednesday, 14.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Applied Calculus, Calculus & Analytical Geometry, Linear Algebra & Analytical Geometry, Basic Mathematics / Biology.
- **Thursday, 15.10.2026 (01:00 PM – 04:00 PM):** Pakistan Studies, History of Building Technology, Introduction to Bio-Medical Engineering.
