title: SPSC CCE-2026 Screening Test on 28 November — Apply Online by 11 November Deadline
shortDescription: SPSC officially confirms Saturday, 24 October 2026, as the Screening Test date for the Combined Competitive Examination (CCE-2026). Check official guidelines and portal update.
content:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Official SPSC Notification — Distinct Dates Clarification:**
> - **Online Application Deadline:** **Wednesday, 11 November 2026** (Extended under Adv. No. 06/2026 amending Adv. No. 04/2026).
> - **Screening Examination Date:** **Saturday, 28 November 2026** (Rescheduled from the earlier 24 October date).
>
> Candidates qualifying under the revised age limit (up to 33 years) or submitting fresh applications must complete their online registration and fee payment on `spsc.gov.pk` by **11 November 2026**.

### Official SPSC CCE-2026 Revised Schedule
The **Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)**, Thandi Sarak, Hyderabad, has issued an official notice confirming both the extended application submission window and the rescheduled examination date for CCE-2026 aspirants across Sindh. The CCE examination is the premier competitive gateway for recruitment to provincial executive cadres including Assistant Commissioner (BPS-17), Section Officer (BPS-17), and Excise & Taxation Officer (BPS-17).

### Quick Summary Table
- **Commission:** Sindh Public Service Commission (SPSC)
- **Examination:** Combined Competitive Examination (CCE-2026)
- **Stage:** Preliminary Screening Test (MCQ Based)
- **Online Application Deadline:** **Wednesday, 11 November 2026**
- **Screening Examination Date:** **Saturday, 28 November 2026** (Rescheduled from 24 October)
- **Official Notification Date:** 26 October 2026
- **Testing Centers:** Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, Larkana
- **Application Portal:** [spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal](https://spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal/)
- **Official Commission Website:** [spsc.gov.pk](https://spsc.gov.pk)
- **Roll Number Slip Status:** Available on Candidate Portal prior to 28 November

### Roll Number Slip & Candidate Portal Status
> [!NOTE]
> **Admit Slips:** The SPSC examination branch will issue individualized roll number slips with assigned test centers and reporting shifts on `spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal` approximately one week prior to the 28 November examination.
>
> Candidates must monitor the portal and download their slips before the test day.

### Screening Test Structure & Scoring Policy
The CCE Screening Test is a 100-mark objective multiple-choice paper designed to short-list candidates for the Written Comprehensive Examination:
1. **English General & Comprehension:** Grammar, vocabulary, sentence correction, synonyms/antonyms, and reading comprehension.
2. **General Science & Ability:** Basic everyday science, mathematical reasoning, logical analytical deduction, and numerical ability.
3. **Pakistan Affairs & History:** Movement history, constitutional milestones, post-independence developments, and current political structures.
4. **Current Affairs & Global Issues:** National and international contemporary affairs, climate change, geopolitical events, and economic indicators.
5. **Sindh Affairs & Heritage:** Geography, culture, history, administrative setup, and literature of Sindh.

*Scoring Terms:* Revised qualifying score is 33% (33 marks out of 100) with negative marking of 0.25 marks per incorrect response.

### Essential Examination Day Instructions
- **Mandatory Original Documents:** Candidates must present their original Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC) and printed admit card slip.
- **Stationery:** Use only blue or black transparent ballpoint pens. Pencils and markers are not allowed for filling OMR sheets.
- **Electronic Devices Prohibited:** Mobile phones, digital watches, calculators, and Bluetooth accessories are strictly barred inside examination halls.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
**Q1: What is the application deadline for SPSC CCE-2026?**
The deadline to submit online applications on the SPSC candidate portal is **Wednesday, 11 November 2026**.

**Q2: What is the date of the SPSC CCE-2026 Screening Test?**
The preliminary screening examination will be conducted on **Saturday, 28 November 2026** across major divisional centers.

**Q3: When will CCE-2026 roll number slips be uploaded?**
Admit slips will be available for download on `spsc.gov.pk/candidate_portal` approximately one week prior to the 28 November test date.

**Q4: Which cities host CCE examination centers?**
Major examination centers are established in **Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, and Larkana**.

content: ### Official Announcement: Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus Pre-Entry Test

**Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad**, has officially confirmed the Pre-Entry Test schedule for regular admissions to the **Naushahro Feroze (NF) Campus (Admission Batch 2027)**.

As notified on the university's official news and updates portal, the **NF Campus Pre-Entry Test will be held on 17th and 18th October 2026** for registered candidates across undergraduate and graduate programs.
### Crucial Distinction: NF Campus vs. Affiliated Colleges

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Do Not Confuse the Two Admission Tracks:**
>
> 1. **SBBU Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus Entry Test:** Scheduled for **17 & 18 October 2026**. This test is specifically for candidates who applied for degree programs taught directly at the SBBU NF Sub-Campus.
> 2. **SBBU Affiliated Colleges Admissions:** The online application deadline for public/private affiliated degree colleges is **28 October 2026**, with their separate entrance test for District NF and Dadu colleges to be conducted later on **7 November 2026**.

- **University:** Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad
- **Campus Venue:** **SBBU Naushahro Feroze (NF) Sub-Campus**
- **Entry Test Dates:** **Saturday 17 & Sunday 18 October 2026**
- **Admission Cycle:** Admission Batch 2027
- **Affiliated Colleges Deadline:** **28 October 2026**
- **Affiliated Colleges NF Test Date:** **7 November 2026**
- **Official University Updates:** [sbbusba.edu.pk/news-updates](https://sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/news-updates.html)

### Programs Offered at NF Sub-Campus

The Naushahro Feroze campus provides higher education access across interior Sindh in faculties such as:
- **Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)**
- **BS Computer Science (BS CS)**
- **BS Information Technology (BS IT)**
- **BS English (Literature & Linguistics)**
- **BS Education & Social Sciences**

### Test Day Mandatory Instructions

> - **Identity Proof:** Original CNIC or NADRA Smart Card / B-Form with educational photo card is compulsory.

### Useful University Contacts

- **NF Campus Administrative Office:** Contact via main university helpdesk or visit the sub-campus admissions desk.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When will the SBBU Naushahro Feroze Campus Entry Test be conducted?**
The entry test will take place on **17th and 18th October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the difference between this test and the 7 November test?**
The 17–18 October test is for the university's own Naushahro Feroze Sub-Campus programs. The 7 November test is for undergraduate admissions at affiliated degree colleges in NF and Dadu districts.

Log in to your profile at `https://admissions.sbbusba.edu.pk/` to download your computerized admit card.

title: HEC IRSIP Batch 60 Scholarship 2026 – Research Fellowship Applications Open
shortDescription: HEC Pakistan opens Batch 60 applications for the International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP). Enrolled PhD students can apply for a fully funded 6-month research fellowship abroad by 30 October 2026.
content: ### Official Announcement: HEC IRSIP Batch 60 Applications Open
The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan** has officially invited applications for **Batch 60** of its flagship **International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP)**.

IRSIP provides a **fully funded 6-month research fellowship** at world-class laboratories and research facilities abroad for outstanding full-time doctoral scholars enrolled in Pakistani universities.

The program aims to elevate doctoral research standards in Pakistan, expose scholars to cutting-edge global methodologies, and build lasting institutional linkages between Pakistani universities and top international institutions.
The official deadline for Batch 60 online applications is **30 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Funding Agency:** Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan
- **Program Name:** International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP)
- **Cycle:** **Batch 60**
- **Fellowship Duration:** **6 Months Abroad**
- **Eligibility Cohort:** PhD enrolment date between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025 (Inclusive)**
- **Application Deadline:** **30 October 2026**
- **Application Portal:** [scholarship.hec.gov.pk](https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk/)
- **HEC Program Guidelines:** [hec.gov.pk/IRSIP](https://www.hec.gov.pk/english/scholarshipsgrants/IRSIP)
### Detailed Eligibility Criteria for Batch 60

As verified from the official HEC eligibility regulations:
1. **Nationality & Enrolment:** The applicant must be a Pakistani or Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK) national enrolled as a **full-time PhD student** at an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
2. **Enrolment Date Requirement:** For **Batch 60**, the applicant's official PhD enrolment date must fall strictly between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025**, inclusive.
3. **Coursework Completion:** The applicant must have completed at least **18 credit hours of PhD coursework**.
4. **Program Duration Window:** The applicant must have completed at least **18 months of PhD enrolment** and must **not have exceeded 3.5 years** in the doctoral program at the time of application.
5. **Entry Test Standard:** The scholar must have passed either the local GAT Subject Test or the recognized University Admission Test at the time of PhD enrolment.
6. **Approved Synopsis:** The candidate must hold an approved PhD research topic and synopsis endorsed by the Board of Advanced Studies and Research (BASR) or Directorate of Advanced Studies and Research (DASR).
7. **Foreign Acceptance Letter:** The scholar must possess an official acceptance / invitation letter from an advanced research laboratory or university abroad.
### Host Institution & Supervisor Requirements

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Host University Ranking:** The host institution must be located in a developed country and ranked among the **top world universities** (overall or subject-wise) according to the Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings or QS World University Rankings.
> - **Foreign Supervisor Status:** The proposed foreign supervisor must be a full-time faculty member ranked Assistant Professor or above.
> - **Independence Rule:** The foreign supervisor must **not** be a former supervisor of the scholar's local PhD supervisor.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Navigate to the official HEC scholarship portal: [scholarship.hec.gov.pk](https://scholarship.hec.gov.pk/).
2. Create or log in to your verified HEC e-portal account.
3. Complete your personal, academic, and doctoral enrolment information.
4. Select **International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP) - Batch 60**.
5. Upload your approved BASR synopsis, coursework transcripts, foreign acceptance letter, CV of the foreign supervisor, and local university endorsement.
6. Submit your application online before **30 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline for HEC IRSIP Batch 60?**
The application deadline for Batch 60 is **30 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the duration of the IRSIP research fellowship?**
The fellowship is awarded for a strict duration of **6 months** at a foreign university.

**Q3: Which PhD batches are eligible for Batch 60?**
Only PhD scholars whose enrolment date falls between **Spring 2023 and Spring 2025** and who have completed at least 18 credit hours of coursework.

**Q4: Can scholars already availing an HEC scholarship apply?**
Yes. Scholars holding other HEC scholarships are eligible provided they obtain and submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their designated HEC project officer.

title: Ministry of Climate Change Jobs 2026 – IT Specialist & Animator Vacancies on NJP
shortDescription: Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination invites online applications on National Jobs Portal for IT Specialist (PPS-10) and Senior Animator (PPS-09). Apply before 19 October 2026.
content: ### Official Federal Recruitment Announcement: STC-PSDP Project

The **Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination (MoCC&EC), Government of Pakistan**, has announced high-level contractual vacancies under its Federal PSDP Project titled **"Strengthening Technical Capacities of Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination" (STC - PSDP Project)**.

Published officially on **04 October 2026**, the recruitment drive invites qualified professionals across Pakistan to apply online through the **National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk)** before the closing deadline of **19 October 2026**.

> [!WARNING]
> **Mid-to-Senior Professional Roles:** These are competitive project positions requiring 6 to 8+ years of professional post-qualification experience. They are **NOT** fresh-graduate entry-level posts.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Ministry:** Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination, Islamabad
- **Project Name:** Strengthening Technical Capacities (STC - PSDP Project)
- **Announcement Date:** 04 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **19 October 2026**
- **Project Pay Scales:** PPS-10 & PPS-09
- **Employment Type:** Contractual Project Appointment
- **Official Ministry Portal:** [mocc.gov.pk/Jobs](https://www.mocc.gov.pk/Jobs)
- **Online Application Portal:** [National Jobs Portal (njp.gov.pk)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search)
- **Terms of Reference PDF:** [mocc.gov.pk TORs PDF](https://www.mocc.gov.pk/SiteImage/Jobs/tors-02.10.2026.pdf)
### Advertised Vacancy Breakdown Table

| Post Title | Project Pay Scale | Max Age | Prescribed Qualifications & Experience |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **IT and Data Specialist** | PPS-10 | 52 Years | 16 years of education in IT, Computer Science, or Software Engineering from an HEC recognized university + At least 08 years of relevant post-qualification experience in IT operations, cybersecurity, database management, systems, and digital solutions. Experience with Python/Java/PHP, network administration, and e-Office is required. |
| **Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator** | PPS-09 | 45 Years | Bachelor’s degree in Animation, Multimedia Arts, Graphic Design, or related field + Minimum 6 years of professional experience in motion design, animation, or visual storytelling. Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects (2.5D, expressions), Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro (optional 3D tools Blender/Cinema 4D). A professional creative portfolio is mandatory. |
### Core Responsibilities & Terms of Reference (TORs)

1. **IT and Data Specialist (PPS-10):**
   - Initiate and lead the establishment of a centralized climate data repository for the ministry.
   - Provide technical leadership for climate data management, environmental monitoring, and E-Governance.
   - Manage and maintain ministerial IT infrastructure, servers, network policies, security firewalls, and hardware inventory.
   - Upgrade and maintain the official MoCC&EC website, e-office system, and project dashboards.

2. **Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator (PPS-09):**
   - Lead creative visual storytelling, animation styles, and mood boards for national climate campaigns.
   - Conceptualize and produce motion graphics, animated explainers, and infographic videos explaining complex climate data (e.g. rainfall anomalies, temperature shifts, flood mitigation).
   - Optimize motion content for social channels (YouTube Shorts, Reels, presentations, TV spots).
   - Execute bilingual (Urdu & English) animations ensuring accessibility, regional diversity, and cultural inclusivity.
### Step-by-Step Online Application via NJP

1. Navigate to the official National Jobs Portal: [njp.gov.pk/jobs/search](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search).
2. Search for employer **Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination** or project **STC - PSDP Project**.
3. Log in to your candidate account and verify your CNIC, education, and detailed work experience.
4. For Animator candidates, ensure a clickable URL to your digital portfolio or demo reel is provided.
5. Select your desired vacancy and submit online before **19 October 2026**.
6. Applications submitted through postal mail or directly to the ministry will not be entertained.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Ministry of Climate Change jobs?**
The closing deadline is **19 October 2026**.

**Q2: What pay scales are offered for these positions?**
The IT and Data Specialist is offered at **PPS-10**, while the Motion Design Lead / Senior Animator is offered at **PPS-09**.

**Q3: Where can I submit my application?**
Applications must be submitted online through the National Jobs Portal at `https://njp.gov.pk/`.

**Q4: Is a portfolio required for the Animator post?**
Yes. A professional portfolio demonstrating quality and range in animated work and visual storytelling is mandatory.

title: SBBU Merit List 2027 Announced – MS, MPhil, MBA & BS Bridge Results
shortDescription: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU) Shaheed Benazirabad has released the Provisional Merit Lists for MS, MPhil, MBA, and BS-Bridge programs (Batch 2027). Interview schedule and fee structure to be announced soon.
content: ### Official Announcement: Provisional Merit Lists Released

**Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad**, has officially released the **Provisional Merit Lists for MS, M.Phil & MBA Programs and the BS-Bridge Program (Admission Batch 2027)**.
Both provisional merit lists were published on **8 October 2026**, covering postgraduate and lateral bridge degree disciplines at the **SBBU Main Campus, Nawabshah**.
Candidates who appeared in the university pre-entry screening test can now verify their qualified status online through the official institutional links.
### Privacy & Candidate Protection Notice

> [!NOTE]
> **Candidate Privacy Commitment:** In strict compliance with personal data protection policies, **CareerDost does NOT scrape, copy, or reproduce personal candidate names, fathers' names, test scores, or form IDs.**
>
> All prospective students must check their selection status directly on the official university servers:
> - **MS, MPhil & MBA Merit List:** `https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/ms_mphil_mba_merit_list_2027.html`
> - **BS-Bridge Program Merit List:** `https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/bs_bridge_merit_list_2027.html`
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University (SBBU), Shaheed Benazirabad
- **Campus Covered:** **SBBU Main Campus, Nawabshah**
- **Programs Included:** **MS, MPhil, MBA & BS-Bridge Programs**
- **Batch:** **Admission Batch 2027**
- **List Status:** **Provisional Merit List (Interview Eligibility Only)**
- **Publication Date:** 8 October 2026
- **Interview Schedule:** **To Be Announced Soon by University**
- **Fee Structure:** **To Be Announced Soon by University**
- **Official University Website:** [sbbusba.edu.pk](https://sbbusba.edu.pk/)
- **Direct MS/MPhil/MBA List:** [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk MS List](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/ms_mphil_mba_merit_list_2027.html)
- **Direct BS-Bridge List:** [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk BS-Bridge List](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/bs_bridge_merit_list_2027.html)
### Academic Disciplines Covered in the Merit Lists
The published provisional lists cover candidates who qualified the pre-entry test across various departments:

1. **MS & MPhil Programs:**
   - MS Information Technology (MS IT)
   - MS Computer Science (MS CS)
   - MPhil English Literature & Linguistics
   - MPhil Chemistry
   - MPhil Education & other academic disciplines

2. **Master of Business Administration (MBA):**
   - MBA Morning & Evening programs

3. **BS-Bridge (Lateral Entry) Programs:**
   - BS Chemistry (Bridge)
   - BS English (Bridge)
   - BS Mathematics (Bridge)
   - Other approved bridge transition departments
### Crucial Clarification: Provisional Status & Interviews

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Not Final Admission Confirmation:** Inclusion in this provisional list confirms that the candidate has qualified the Pre-Entry Test and is eligible to appear for the **Departmental Interview**.
>
> The university has explicitly notified:
> *"Congratulations to the following candidates who have successfully qualified the Pre-Entry Test of Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Shaheed Benazirabad, and are eligible to appear for the interview... Note: Interview Schedule and Fee Structure will be announced soon."*
>
> Candidates are not finally admitted until they clear the departmental interview, complete physical document verification, and submit the prescribed admission fees.
### Documents to Prepare for Upcoming Interviews

Qualified candidates are advised to organize the following original documents and attested sets in advance:
1. Original Matriculation (SSC) Certificate & Marksheet
2. Original Intermediate (HSC) Certificate & Marksheet
3. Original Bachelor’s / Terminal Degree Transcripts & Degree Certificates
4. Original CNIC or Form-B
5. Original Domicile and PRC (Form C) Certificates
6. Four recent passport-sized photographs
7. Departmental No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently in government or corporate employment
### Step-by-Step Guide to Check Your Result Online

1. Open the relevant official SBBU portal link:
   - For MS, MPhil, or MBA: [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/ms_mphil_mba_merit_list_2027.html](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/ms_mphil_mba_merit_list_2027.html)
   - For BS-Bridge: [mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/bs_bridge_merit_list_2027.html](https://mail.sbbusba.edu.pk/sbbu-main/bs_bridge_merit_list_2027.html)
2. On desktop, press `Ctrl + F` (or `Cmd + F` on Mac); on mobile, use the browser menu 'Find in page'.
3. Search using your assigned **Form ID** or **Candidate Name**.
4. Check your Test Score and department allocation.
5. Keep visiting the official university website `sbbusba.edu.pk` for the upcoming interview timetable.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: Does appearing on this list guarantee final admission at SBBU?**
No. This is strictly a Provisional Merit List for pre-entry test qualified candidates. Final admission depends on qualifying the interview and fulfilling document/fee requirements.

**Q2: When will the interview schedule be announced?**
The university has stated that the interview timetable will be published soon on the official website.

**Q3: What is the fee structure for MS, MPhil, MBA, and BS-Bridge programs?**
The official fee structure for these postgraduate and bridge programs will be released alongside the interview notification.

**Q4: Which campus are these merit lists for?**
These provisional lists cover admissions at the **SBBU Main Campus, Nawabshah**.

**Q5: What should I do if my name is on the provisional list?**
Gather your original educational credentials, degrees, CNIC, and domicile, and monitor the official SBBU portal for your departmental interview date.

title: NTS NAT & GAT Roll Number Slip 2026 – October 11 Test Details
shortDescription: NTS has issued Roll Number Slips for NAT 2026-X and GAT General 2026-VII scheduled for Sunday, 11 October 2026. Check reporting time, test day instructions, and download your slip from portal.nts.org.pk.
content: ### Official Examination Notice: Sunday, 11 October 2026 Tests

The **National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan** has issued official **Roll Number Slips and Candidate Lists** for two major nationwide standardized tests scheduled to be conducted on **Sunday, 11 October 2026**:

1. **National Aptitude Test — NAT 2026-X** (for undergraduate admissions)
2. **Graduate Assessment Test — GAT General 2026-VII** (for MS / M.Phil admissions and scholarships)

Registered candidates across Pakistan and Azad Jammu & Kashmir can now log in to the official NTS candidate portal to verify their test center allocation, reporting time, and download their printed admit card.
### Privacy & Direct Access Protocol

> [!NOTE]
> **Safe Access Notice:** CareerDost does **NOT** collect, request, or process candidates' CNIC numbers or personal credentials.
>
> Applicants must log into the official NTS secure portal directly at `https://portal.nts.org.pk/login` to retrieve their personalized examination admit slips.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Testing Organization:** National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan
- **Upcoming Test Date:** **Sunday, 11 October 2026**
- **Undergraduate Test:** **National Aptitude Test (NAT 2026-X)**
- **Postgraduate Test:** **Graduate Assessment Test (GAT General 2026-VII)**
- **Roll Number Slip Status:** **Available for Download Online**
- **Portal Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/login](https://portal.nts.org.pk/login)
- **Candidate List Directory:** [nts.org.pk/new/candidates.php](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/candidates.php)
### Mandatory Documents for Test Day Entry

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Candidates will **NOT** be permitted to enter the examination center without the following mandatory documents:
>
> 1. **Printed NTS Roll Number Slip** (with candidate photograph clearly visible).
> 2. **Original Computerized National Identity Card (CNIC)**, Smart Card, or Original Valid Passport. *(Under-18 candidates without CNIC must present their Original NADRA Smart Card or Original B-Form along with a photographic educational identity card / matric certificate).* 
> 3. Clean transparent writing clipboard, black or blue ballpoint pens, and HB pencils.
> 
> **Strict Warning:** Photocopies of CNIC or expired identity documents are strictly **NOT** acceptable.
### Strict Prohibitions & Center Rules

> [!WARNING]
> The following items are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall:
> - Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, and recording gadgets
> - Calculators, mathematical tables, and electronic storage media
> - Bags, weapon replicas, and unauthorized study notes
>
> Any candidate found possessing a mobile phone or unauthorized electronic device will be disqualified immediately and blacklisted from future NTS examinations.
### Reporting Times & Exam Sessions

- NTS tests are conducted in morning and afternoon sessions depending on your specific category (NAT-IA, NAT-IE, NAT-IM, NAT-ICS, NAT-IG, or GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, GAT-D).
- Candidates must reach their designated test center at least **45 minutes prior** to the reporting time stated on their individual roll number slips.
- Entry gates close strictly 15 minutes before the test begins, and late arrivals will not be accommodated under any circumstances.
### How to Download Your NTS Roll Number Slip

1. Navigate to the official NTS candidate login portal: [portal.nts.org.pk/login](https://portal.nts.org.pk/login).
2. Enter your registered CNIC number (without dashes) and password.
3. Access the **Active Applications / Admit Slips** section on your dashboard.
4. Select your registered project (NAT 2026-X or GAT General 2026-VII).
5. Click **Download Roll Number Slip** and print a clean copy on A4 white paper.
6. Verify your test center address, roll number, and session timings carefully.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the date of the NAT 2026-X and GAT General 2026-VII tests?**
Both tests will be conducted nationwide on **Sunday, 11 October 2026**.

**Q2: How can I download my roll number slip?**
You can download it by logging into your profile on the official NTS portal (`portal.nts.org.pk/login`).

**Q3: Can I sit in the exam if I only have a photocopy of my CNIC?**
No. You must carry your original, valid CNIC/Smart Card or original passport. Photocopies are strictly rejected.

**Q4: Are calculators allowed in GAT General?**
No. Calculators of any type are prohibited in both NAT and GAT General examinations.

**Q5: How long is the NTS test score valid?**
NAT scores are valid for **1 year**, while GAT General scores remain valid for **2 years** for admissions across associated universities.

title: Punjab Ophthalmology College Jobs 2026 – Apply Online Through NTS
shortDescription: Government of the Punjab Specialized Healthcare & Medical Education Department announces Junior Ophthalmic Technician jobs (3 posts) at College of Ophthalmology & Allied Vision Sciences Lahore. Apply via NTS by 20 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment Announcement: Punjab Healthcare Department

The **Government of the Punjab, Specialized Healthcare & Medical Education Department**, has announced fresh contractual vacancies at the prestigious **College of Ophthalmology & Allied Vision Sciences (COAVS), King Edward Medical University (KEMU) / Mayo Hospital Lahore**.

Conducted through the **National Testing Service (NTS)** under **Project Code: 2610203**, this recruitment drive invites qualified clinical vision science technicians holding Punjab domicile to join the public health sector.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** College of Ophthalmology & Allied Vision Sciences (COAVS) Lahore
- **Administrative Department:** Specialized Healthcare & Medical Education Department, Govt. of Punjab
- **Affiliated Institution:** KEMU / Mayo Hospital Lahore
- **Project Code:** 2610203
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Announcement Date:** 9 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **20 October 2026**
- **Tentative Test Date:** **30 October 2026**
- **Application Fee:** **Rs. 450 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 460/=**
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzc0](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzc0)
- **Apply Online Portal:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Advertised Vacancy Breakdown Table

The official details of the advertised position are as follows:

| Post Title | Total Vacancies | Prescribed Qualification | Age Limit | Domicile | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Junior Ophthalmic Technician** | 3 | F.Sc (Pre-Medical) with Diploma in Ophthalmic Technology from a recognized Medical Faculty / Board | 18–25 Years (Plus general age relaxation) | Punjab | 20 October 2026 |
### Detailed Eligibility & Qualification Rules

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Educational Criteria:** Higher Secondary School Certificate (F.Sc Pre-Medical) second division from a recognized Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, along with a relevant diploma in Ophthalmic Technology / Vision Sciences.
> - **Age Limit:** **18 to 25 Years** on the closing date.
> - **Age Relaxation:** General age relaxation as per Punjab Government recruitment rules (up to 5 years for male candidates and 8 years for female candidates) is applicable.
> - **Domicile Requirement:** Candidates must hold a valid domicile of any district within the province of **Punjab**.
### NTS Application Fee & Payment Method

- The test fee is **Rs. 450 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total Rs. 460/=)**.
- After filling out the online form, generate the unique 1Link 1Bill invoice.
- Pay through Mobile Banking (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Upaisa, bank apps), ATM, or bank branches.
- Only online forms are entertained. Do not send postal applications or bank receipts to NTS headquarters.
### Selection Mechanism & Screening Test

1. **NTS Written Screening Test:** Tentatively scheduled for **30 October 2026** in Lahore. Test questions cover ophthalmic techniques, clinical optics, basic anatomy, and general English.
2. **Departmental Scrutiny:** Top-ranking candidates will be called for document verification at COAVS Mayo Hospital Lahore.
3. **Interview & Merit Formulation:** Final selection will be determined in accordance with the Punjab Government Contract Appointment Policy.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Navigate to the official NTS project portal: [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzc0](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzc0).
2. Click on **Apply Now** or log into your candidate profile on `portal.nts.org.pk/register`.
3. Complete your personal bio-data, Punjab domicile details, and educational background.
4. Upload your recent photograph and CNIC copy.
5. Select the post **Junior Ophthalmic Technician**.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill payment voucher and deposit the Rs. 460 fee.
7. Submit your application online before the deadline of **20 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Punjab Ophthalmology College jobs?**
The deadline to apply online is **20 October 2026**.

**Q2: How many vacancies are available?**
There are **3 vacancies** for the post of Junior Ophthalmic Technician.

**Q3: Can candidates from Sindh or KPK apply?**
No. The positions are strictly reserved for candidates possessing a valid **Punjab domicile**.

**Q4: What is the test fee?**
The application test fee is **Rs. 460** (Rs. 450 fee + Rs. 10 service charges) payable via 1Link 1Bill.

**Q5: When will the NTS test be held?**
The screening test is tentatively scheduled for **30 October 2026**.

title: Shifa University PharmD Admissions 2026 – Apply Before October 15
shortDescription: Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University Islamabad invites online applications for Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) Class of 2031. Admission test conducted by NTS. Deadline: 15 October 2026. Minimum 60% in FSc Pre-Medical required.
content: ### Official Admission Notice: Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) Class of 2031

**Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University (STMU), Islamabad**, has announced admissions for its prestigious **Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) Program — Class of 2031** at the **Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences (SCPS)**.

The pre-admission entrance examination is administered in collaboration with the **National Testing Service (NTS)** under **Project Code: 2608102**. Online registrations are currently open and will conclude on **15 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Shifa Tameer-e-Millat University (STMU) Islamabad
- **College:** Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences (SCPS)
- **Degree Awarded:** Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D)
- **Graduating Batch:** **Class of 2031** (5-Year Professional Degree)
- **Accreditation:** Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) & Higher Education Commission (HEC)
- **Application Deadline:** **15 October 2026**
- **Tentative Admission Test Date:** **8 November 2026**
- **NTS Application Processing Fee:** **Rs. 5,300 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 5,310/=**
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1)
- **Apply Online Portal:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Crucial Distinction: Admission Test Registration vs Final Admission Selection

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Academic Advisory:** Candidates must recognize that **registration for the NTS Admission Test does NOT guarantee final admission selection at Shifa University.**
>
> Appearing in the NTS entry test is the initial mandatory screening requirement. Final admission selection will be conducted by STMU based on aggregate merit (Matric, F.Sc, Entry Test score, and formal interview).
### Program Overview & Academic Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Minimum Qualification:** Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / F.Sc Pre-Medical) or equivalent with Biology, Chemistry, and Physics from a recognized Pakistani board, OR an equivalent foreign qualification (A-Levels / American High School Diploma) with an official IBCC Equivalence Certificate.
> - **Minimum Marks:** At least **60% aggregate marks** in F.Sc Pre-Medical in accordance with Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) regulations.
> - **Program Duration:** **5 Academic Years** of comprehensive didactic instruction, advanced laboratory training, and clinical pharmacy rotations at Shifa International Hospital Islamabad.
### Application Processing Fee & Payment Mode

- The non-refundable application test processing fee is **Rs. 5,300 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total Rs. 5,310/=)**.
- Fee payment can be executed through 1Link 1Bill using:
  - Mobile Banking apps (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Bank apps)
  - 1Link participating ATM kiosks
  - Over-the-counter banking branches across Pakistan
### Admission Test Structure & Schedule

- The NTS Admission Test is tentatively scheduled for **Sunday, 8 November 2026**.
- The test syllabus comprises Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English, and General Aptitude matching the standard F.Sc Pre-Medical curriculum.
- Roll number slips indicating assigned test centers (Islamabad and major regional cities) will be issued online a week prior to the examination date.
### Step-by-Step Online Registration Guide

1. Visit the NTS project page: `https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMjk1`.
2. Click on **Apply Now** to open the registration system (`portal.nts.org.pk/register`).
3. Register with your CNIC/B-Form and password.
4. Enter personal information, parent details, and educational background.
5. Select **Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm. D) — Class of 2031**.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill payment invoice and pay the fee of Rs. 5,310.
7. Verify payment confirmation on your dashboard and download your application summary before **15 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for Shifa University PharmD admissions?**
The application deadline on the NTS portal is **15 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the minimum percentage required for PharmD eligibility?**
Candidates must have secured at least **60% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical** or equivalent.

**Q3: When will the admission test take place?**
The admission test is tentatively scheduled for **8 November 2026**.

**Q4: What is the application fee amount?**
The application test fee is **Rs. 5,310** (Rs. 5,300 fee + Rs. 10 service charges).

**Q5: Is Shifa College of Pharmaceutical Sciences recognized by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan?**
Yes. SCPS is fully recognized by the Pharmacy Council of Pakistan (PCP) and the Higher Education Commission (HEC).

shortDescription: Verified schedule and preparation guide for NTS Graduate Assessment Test (GAT Subject 2026-VI, Project Code 2611906). Check the Sunday, 15 November 2026 test date, E-roll number slip download schedule, 70% subject / 30% general paper pattern, and 60% PhD qualifying score.
content: ### Official Schedule & Status Update: NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code: 2611906)

The **National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan** is conducting the **Graduate Assessment Test — GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code: 2611906)** on **Sunday, 15 November 2026** across major examination centers nationwide. GAT Subject is the national standardized assessment required by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) and recognized Pakistani universities for **admission into PhD degree programs**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Registration & Schedule Verification (Verified 25 October 2026):**
> - **Initial Registration Deadlines Passed:** The initial annual calendar closing date (**12 October 2026**) and first extended deadline (**19 October 2026**) have passed. *(Note: The live NTS candidate portal entry at [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy) displays a final portal cut-off date of **30 October 2026**; per the official [NTS GAT Subject Schedule (`nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php`)](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php), standard fee is **Rs. 2,210/-** and late fee is **Rs. 3,010/-**)*.
> - **Scheduled E-Roll Number Slip Date:** **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** (or ~7–10 days prior to the test on `portal.nts.org.pk` following the extended portal window).
> - **Confirmed Written Test Date:** **Sunday, 15 November 2026**.
> - **Result Announcement Date:** **Monday, 23 November 2026**.
### Critical Distinction: GAT Subject vs GAT General

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Candidate Advisory:** Confirm the exact test requirement of your target university:
>
> - **GAT General:** Designed for **MS / M.Phil admissions** and assesses general aptitude across Verbal, Quantitative, and Analytical Reasoning.
> - **GAT Subject:** Designed specifically for **PhD admissions** and assesses advanced subject-specific knowledge in the candidate's chosen discipline (70% subject specialization).
### Verified GAT Subject 2026-VI Schedule & Summary Table

| PARAMETER | OFFICIAL NTS SPECIFICATION (GAT-SUB-VI) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Testing Authority** | National Testing Service (NTS) Pakistan |
| **Project Title & Code** | Graduate Assessment Test (`GAT Subject 2026-VI` — Code: `2611906`) |
| **Announcement Date** | Monday, 14 September 2026 |
| **Registration Window** | Regular deadlines (12 Oct / 19 Oct 2026) passed; portal final cut-off listed as **30 October 2026** |
| **E-Roll Number Slip Date** | Scheduled from **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** on `portal.nts.org.pk` |
| **Written Test Date** | **Sunday, 15 November 2026** |
| **Result Declaration Date** | **Monday, 23 November 2026** |
| **Registration Fee** | **Rs. 2,210/-** (Regular: Rs. 2,200 + Rs. 10) / **Rs. 3,010/-** (With Late Fee per `GAT-S.php`) |
| **Scorecard Validity** | **2 Years** for PhD Admissions Nationwide |
| **Official NTS Portal** | [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzUy) & [nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php](https://www.nts.org.pk/new/GAT-S.php) |
### How to Download NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI Roll Number Slip

Registered candidates appearing in the **15 November 2026** examination can download their E-Roll Number Slip online as soon as NTS uploads center allocations (scheduled from **27 October 2026** onwards):

1. Visit the official NTS Candidate Portal ([portal.nts.org.pk](https://portal.nts.org.pk/)) or the NTS Open Applications / List of Candidates section on [nts.org.pk](https://www.nts.org.pk/).
2. Log into your candidate dashboard using your registered **CNIC number** and password.
3. Locate **Graduate Assessment Test (GAT Subject 2026-VI — Code: 2611906)** and download/print your **E-Roll Number Slip**.
4. **Mandatory Test Day Items (15 November 2026):** Bring your printed Roll Number Slip and original **NADRA CNIC** (or valid Passport). Mobile phones, smartwatches, and calculators are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall.
5. For detailed guidance on NTS slip lookup and result checking, see our [NTS NAT & GAT Roll Number Slip Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-nat-gat-roll-number-slip-2026) and [NTS Latest Results & Answer Keys Guide](https://careerdost.blog/jobs/nts-latest-results-answer-keys-2026).
### Test Pattern & Examination Structure (100 MCQs / 120 Minutes)

The GAT Subject examination comprises **100 multiple-choice questions (MCQs)** with a total duration of **120 minutes (2 Hours)**, formatted as follows:

1. **Subject Specialization:** **70%** (70 MCQs covering advanced core undergraduate and master's level concepts in the chosen academic field)
2. **English (Verbal Reasoning):** **15%** (15 MCQs covering academic vocabulary, sentence completion, and reading comprehension)
3. **Analytical Reasoning:** **15%** (15 MCQs covering logical deduction, analytical problem solving, and data inference)
### Academic Disciplines Offered in GAT Subject

GAT Subject is offered across major PhD academic faculties, including:
- **Biological Sciences:** Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Botany, Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Zoology, Environmental Sciences
- **Physical Sciences:** Chemistry, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics
- **Engineering & Technology:** Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering
- **Social Sciences & Humanities:** Economics, Management Sciences, Education, English (Literature/Linguistics), International Relations, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology
- **Medical & Pharmacy:** Pharmacy (Pharmacology, Pharmaceutics), Veterinary Sciences
### Minimum Qualifying Score & Validity

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Passing Threshold:** A minimum cumulative score of **60%** is mandatory to qualify the GAT Subject test for HEC-recognized PhD program enrollment.
> - **Validity:** The official GAT Subject scorecard remains valid for **2 years** from the test date.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: When is the NTS GAT Subject 2026-VI test date?**
The written test for GAT Subject 2026-VI (Project Code 2611906) will be held on **Sunday, 15 November 2026**, and results are scheduled for **Monday, 23 November 2026**.

**Q2: When and how can I download the GAT Subject 2026-VI roll number slip?**
Per the official NTS GAT Subject 2026 schedule, E-Roll Number Slips are scheduled from **Tuesday, 27 October 2026** (or following completion of the extended portal window). Candidates can download and print their slip by logging into `portal.nts.org.pk` with their CNIC.

**Q3: What is the qualifying score for PhD admission in GAT Subject?**
A minimum score of **60% marks** is required to qualify GAT Subject for PhD admissions under HEC regulations, and the result card remains valid for **2 years**.

title: Women University AJK Admissions 2026 – Last Date Today, Apply Online
shortDescription: CRITICAL DEADLINE TODAY: Online admission applications for Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK) Bagh Fall 2026 close today, 9 October 2026. BS, Lateral Entry 5th Semester, MS/MPhil, and PhD programs available.
content: ### URGENT ADMISSION NOTICE: LAST DATE TODAY — 9 OCTOBER 2026

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE ALERT:** Today, **9 October 2026**, is officially the final extended deadline to submit online admission applications for the **Fall 2026 Academic Session** at **Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK), Bagh**.
>
> Prospective female students across Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan, and all provinces of Pakistan must submit their electronic admission forms via the official university portal (`umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM`) before midnight tonight.
### About Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK)

Established to empower women through high-quality higher education, **Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK)** is a premier public-sector higher education institution situated in the scenic district of Bagh, AJ&K. The university offers career-oriented degree programs approved by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan across natural sciences, social sciences, management studies, computing, and allied health sciences.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir (WUAJK), Bagh
- **Intake Session:** **Fall 2026**
- **Programs Offered:** BS (4-Year), Lateral Entry (5th Semester), MS / MPhil, and PhD
- **Extended Application Deadline:** **TODAY, 9 October 2026**
- **Tentative Entry Test Date:** **12 October 2026**
- **Mode of Application:** Strictly Online via UMIS Admission Portal
- **Official News Notification:** [wuajk.edu.pk News 848](https://wuajk.edu.pk/news/view/848)
- **Online Admission Portal:** [umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM](https://umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM)
- **Fee Challan Generator:** [wuajk.edu.pk Challan System](https://wuajk.edu.pk/welcome/generate_challan_common)
### Offered Academic Programs Across Faculties

WUAJK Bagh offers comprehensive degree programs across three distinguished faculties:

1. **Faculty of Science & Technology:**
   - Computer Science (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Information Technology (BS)
   - Biotechnology (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Botany (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Chemistry (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Mathematics (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Physics (BS, MS)
   - Zoology (BS, MS, PhD)

2. **Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences:**
   - Economics (BS, MS)
   - Management Sciences / BBA (BS, MS, PhD)
   - Education / B.Ed 1.5, 2.5 & 4 Years (BS, MS, PhD)
   - English Literature & Linguistics (BS, MS)
   - International Relations (IR) & History (BS, MS)
   - Health & Physical Education / Sports Sciences (BS)

3. **Faculty of Medicine, Dentistry and Allied Health Sciences:**
   - Allied Health Sciences / Medical Laboratory Technology (BS)
### Program-Wise Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **BS Programs (4 Years):** Minimum 45% to 50% marks in Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSSC / Intermediate / FA / FSc / ICS) or IBCC equivalent from a recognized education board.
> - **Lateral Entry (5th Semester):** 14 years of relevant prior education (Associate Degree Program ADP / BA / BSc) with at least 45% marks or 2.0/4.0 CGPA.
> - **MS / MPhil Programs:** Minimum 16 years of education (BS 4-Year or MA/MSc) in the relevant subject with at least 2.50/4.00 CGPA (semester system) or 50% marks (annual system) from an HEC-recognized university, plus qualifying the university entry test.
> - **PhD Programs:** Minimum 18 years of education (MS/MPhil) in the relevant field with minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA or 60% marks, plus clearance of university subject entry test and interview.
### Tentative Entry Test Schedule

According to the official WUAJK notification, the tentative entry test for postgraduate (MS/MPhil/PhD) and specified undergraduate programs is scheduled to be held on **12 October 2026** at the main university campus in Bagh. Applicants must bring their printed admit cards and original CNIC/B-Form to the examination center.
### Required Documents for Online Admission Form

Applicants must upload scanned, legible copies of the following documents during online registration:
1. Recent passport-sized photograph (white background)
2. CNIC / Form-B of candidate
3. CNIC of Father or Guardian
4. SSC / Matriculation Certificate & Marksheet
5. HSSC / Intermediate Marksheet / Result Card
6. Terminal Degree Transcript & Certificate (for Lateral, MS, or PhD applicants)
7. State Subject Certificate / Domicile Certificate (AJ&K / Provincial Quota)
8. Paid Admission Fee Challan receipt
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Open the official university admission portal: [umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM](https://umis.wuajk.edu.pk/admissions/ADM).
2. Register a new student account using your CNIC/B-Form and valid email address.
3. Log in and select your desired program level (Undergraduate, Lateral Entry, MS/MPhil, or PhD).
4. Enter personal, guardian, and domicile details carefully.
5. Fill in academic qualifications from Matric onwards along with marks obtained.
6. Generate and print the prescribed admission processing fee challan from the bank voucher link.
7. Deposit the fee at the designated bank branch or online channel, and upload the paid receipt.
8. Verify all entered data and click **Submit Application** before the deadline closes tonight, **9 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for WUAJK Fall 2026 admissions?**
The official extended deadline is strictly **TODAY, 9 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the entry test be conducted?**
The entry test is tentatively scheduled to take place on **12 October 2026** at WUAJK Bagh.

**Q3: Can male candidates apply for admission at WUAJK?**
No. Women University of Azad Jammu & Kashmir is exclusively dedicated to female higher education.

**Q4: Is lateral entry into the 5th semester offered?**
Yes. Graduates holding a 2-year Associate Degree (ADP), BA, or BSc are eligible for 5th-semester lateral admission in relevant disciplines.

**Q5: What financial assistance is available for deserving students?**
WUAJK provides HEC Need-Based Scholarships, Ehsaas Undergraduate Scholarships, and University Student Welfare Fund concessions to deserving students.

shortDescription: Security Papers Limited (SPL) Karachi invites applications for Non-Management Technical positions with monthly salaries ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000. Maximum age 25 years. Apply online via NTS before 11 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment Announcement: Security Papers Limited (SPL)

**Security Papers Limited (SPL), Karachi**, a national industrial manufacturer operating under strict security protocols to produce banknote paper and security documents for the State Bank of Pakistan and commercial banks, has announced vacancies under its **Non-Management Program (Project Code: 2610502)** through the National Testing Service (NTS).

This recruitment campaign provides well-remunerated industrial technical career pathways for young diploma holders and intermediate candidates, offering attractive monthly compensation packages ranging from **Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000** along with fringe benefits.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Security Papers Limited (SPL), Karachi
- **Project Name:** SPL Non-Management Positions (Code: 2610502)
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Work Location:** Jinnah Avenue, Malir Halt, Karachi, Sindh
- **Monthly Salary Range:** **Rs. 45,000/= to Rs. 75,000/=** (commensurate with post and experience)
- **Maximum Age Limit:** **25 Years** (as of application closing date)
- **Application Deadline:** **11 October 2026**
- **Tentative Test Date:** **20 October 2026**
- **Submission Mode:** Strictly Online via NTS Candidate Portal
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx)
- **Online Application Form:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Specialized Technical Disciplines Advertised

Positions under the SPL Non-Management Program are open in four core engineering and manufacturing streams:

1. **Production & Mechanical:**
   - Machine operators, paper manufacturing technicians, and mechanical maintenance crews.
2. **Electrical & Electronics:**
   - Power distribution maintenance, electric motor technicians, and industrial electronics troubleshooting.
3. **Instrumentation & Process Control:**
   - Calibration, sensor diagnostics, automated control systems, and SCADA instrumentation.
4. **Mould & Cylinder:**
   - Security paper watermarking, cylinder mould preparation, and precision tooling operations.
### Detailed Eligibility & Qualification Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Education:** Diploma of Associate Engineering (DAE) in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation & Process Control from a recognized Board of Technical Education (PBTE/SBTE/KP BTE), OR Intermediate (FSc Pre-Engineering / ICS) with technical aptitude.
> - **Experience:** Minimum **1 to 5 years** of practical hands-on experience in a reputed manufacturing, industrial, or process plant environment.
> - **Age Ceiling:** Candidates must **NOT exceed 25 years of age** on 11 October 2026.
> - **Fitness & Integrity:** Stringent security clearance and physical medical fitness are mandatory prerequisites.
### Salary Package & Corporate Benefits

Security Papers Limited offers one of the most competitive remuneration structures in the national manufacturing sector:
- Starting monthly consolidated salary ranging between **Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 75,000**.
- Medical coverage for self and family as per institutional policy.
- Group life insurance and provident fund benefits.
- Subsidized transport and factory cafeteria facilities in Karachi.
### Selection Process & Written Screening Test

1. **Written Screening Test:** NTS will administer a specialized screening test tentatively on **20 October 2026**. Official sample papers are available for download directly on the NTS portal.
2. **Practical Skills Assessment:** Shortlisted candidates will undergo practical trade tests at SPL facilities.
3. **Panel Interview:** High-scoring applicants will appear before the SPL Departmental Selection Committee.
4. **Medical Examination & Background Check:** Final appointment is subject to comprehensive security vetting.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process on NTS

1. Visit the NTS portal project link: [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcx).
2. Click on **Apply Now** or navigate to the registration portal (`portal.nts.org.pk/register`).
3. Register using your CNIC and secure password.
4. Fill in academic credentials, technical diploma records, and industrial work experience.
5. Upload recent passport-size photograph and scanned CNIC.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice for application fee payment.
7. Pay the fee via ATM, Internet Banking, Easypaisa, or JazzCash before **11 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for SPL Jobs 2026?**
The deadline to submit online applications on NTS is **11 October 2026**.

**Q2: What is the salary range for these non-management posts?**
The advertised salary ranges from **Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month**, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.

**Q3: What is the maximum age limit?**
The upper age limit is strictly **25 years**.

**Q4: Where will the appointed candidates be posted?**
Selected candidates will be posted at the Security Papers Limited manufacturing complex in **Karachi**.

**Q5: Is there a physical form submission required?**
No. Applications are accepted strictly online via the NTS candidate portal. Do not send postal packages to NTS or SPL.

shortDescription: Gujranwala Electric Power Company (GEPCO) has announced Assistant Manager vacancies in Database Administration, Network Support, and Meter Data Management. Age limit 21–33 years. Fee Rs. 280. Apply online through NTS by 23 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment Announcement: GEPCO Career Opportunities

**Gujranwala Electric Power Company (GEPCO)**, a prominent power distribution utility operating under the Ministry of Energy (Power Division), Government of Pakistan, has officially announced technical and IT professional vacancies under **Project Code: 2610202** through the National Testing Service (NTS).

Announced on **6 October 2026**, this recruitment drive invites qualified professionals nationwide to apply for officer-level Assistant Manager positions dedicated to modernizing power grid databases, automated metering infrastructure (AMI), and enterprise network communications.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Gujranwala Electric Power Company (GEPCO)
- **Project Code:** 2610202
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Announcement Date:** 6 October 2026
- **Application Deadline:** **23 October 2026**
- **Tentative Written Test Date:** **30 October 2026**
- **Application Fee:** **Rs. 270 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 280/=**
- **Age Bracket:** **21 to 33 Years** (including general Federal 5-year age relaxation)
- **Official NTS Portal Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcz](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcz)
- **Apply Online Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Advertised Vacancies & Post Breakdown

GEPCO has advertised three specialized Assistant Manager positions with **one vacancy per post**:

1. **Assistant Manager (Database Administration) — 1 Post:**
   - *Role:* Administration, optimization, backup, and high-availability clustering of GEPCO billing and enterprise databases (Oracle / SQL Server / PostgreSQL).
   - *Qualification:* 16-Year BS/BE/BSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent from an HEC-recognized university.
   - *Experience:* Professional database administrator certification (OCP / MCSE) and hands-on DBA experience is highly preferred.

2. **Assistant Manager (Network Support) — 1 Post:**
   - *Role:* Managing enterprise LAN/WAN topology, firewalls, routing protocols, VPNs, and secure transmission communication.
   - *Qualification:* 16-Year BS/BE/BSc in Computer Systems Engineering, Telecommunication, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
   - *Experience:* Network certification (CCNA / CCNP / Network+) and routing/switching experience.

3. **Assistant Manager (Meter Data Management) — 1 Post:**
   - *Role:* Operational oversight of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Smart Metering data acquisition, MDM software analytics, and meter communication protocols.
   - *Qualification:* 16-Year BS/BE in Electrical / Electronics Engineering or Computer Science / IT from an HEC-recognized institution.
### Age Limit & Federal Age Relaxation Rules

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **Prescribed Age Limit:** **21 to 33 Years**.
> - The upper age limit already incorporates the **5 years general age relaxation** granted by the Federal Government of Pakistan.
> - Additional relaxation is applicable for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Buddhist Community, AJK, Northern Areas, and disabled candidates as per Federal Government civil service recruitment policies.
### NTS Application Fee & Payment Method

- The test processing fee is **Rs. 270 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total Rs. 280/=)** per applied post.
- Candidates can deposit the fee using the unique 1Link 1Bill consumer number generated by the NTS portal through:
  - Mobile Banking Apps (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Nayapay)
  - 1Link Member ATM machines
  - Internet Banking / Over-the-counter participating bank branches
### Written Screening Test & Selection Mechanism

NTS is tentatively scheduled to conduct the written screening test on **30 October 2026** at major urban centers across Pakistan. Shortlisted candidates scoring highest in the screening test will be invited for physical document scrutiny and final interview at GEPCO Headquarters in Gujranwala.
### Step-by-Step Guide to Apply Online via NTS

1. Navigate to the official project detail page: `https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzcz`.
2. Click on **Apply Now** or log into the NTS Candidate Portal (`portal.nts.org.pk/register`).
3. Fill in your personal profile, CNIC details, and contact numbers.
4. Enter your academic qualifications, marks percentages, and university accreditation.
5. Select the specific Assistant Manager post matching your degree.
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill payment slip and note down the consumer number.
7. Pay the fee (Rs. 280) via your preferred banking app.
8. Ensure the payment status reflects as **Paid** before the closing date of **23 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for GEPCO Jobs 2026?**
The last date to submit online applications via NTS is **23 October 2026**.

**Q2: How many total vacancies are announced?**
There are 3 total vacancies: 1 for AM Database Administration, 1 for AM Network Support, and 1 for AM Meter Data Management.

**Q3: What is the age limit for these positions?**
The age limit is **21 to 33 years**.

**Q4: What is the application fee?**
The fee is **Rs. 280** (Rs. 270 test fee + Rs. 10 service charges).

**Q5: Can I submit the application form by hand or post?**
No. As explicitly stated by NTS, by-hand or postal submissions are strictly prohibited. All applications must be submitted online.

title: Engineering Development Board Jobs 2026 – 19 Government Vacancies
shortDescription: Engineering Development Board (EDB), Ministry of Industries and Production, invites online applications on the National Job Portal (NJP) for 19 vacancies across 8 specialized positions (PPS-6 to PPS-11). Deadline: 21 October 2026.
content: ### Official Recruitment Notice: Engineering Development Board (EDB)

The **Engineering Development Board (EDB)**, an apex technical organization operating under the **Ministry of Industries and Production, Government of Pakistan**, has advertised **19 contractual vacancies** across **8 professional roles** to drive national industrialization, electric vehicle (EV) policy implementation, and global engineering exports.

The positions carry attractive **Project Pay Scales (PPS-6, PPS-7, and PPS-11)** and are published live on the official **National Job Portal (NJP)**. The application window is open until **21 October 2026**.
### Quick Summary Table

- **Organization:** Engineering Development Board (EDB) Pakistan
- **Supervising Ministry:** Ministry of Industries & Production, Federal Government
- **Total Advertised Vacancies:** **19 Positions**
- **Number of Job Profiles:** 8 Distinct Professional Roles
- **Pay Scales:** PPS-6, PPS-7, and PPS-11
- **Application Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Work Location:** Islamabad, Pakistan
- **Official Application Portal:** [National Job Portal (njp.gov.pk)](https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search?q=Engineering+Development+Board)
### Complete Vacancy & Eligibility Matrix

The complete breakdown of all 19 positions advertised on the National Job Portal is detailed below:

| Position Title | Vacancies | Grade / Scale | Required Qualification | Minimum Experience | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- | :---: | 
| **Research Assistant** (Job #9817) | 6 | PPS-6 | 16-Year Degree in Business Admin, Management Sciences, Marketing, Engineering, or Economics | 2+ Years Experience (EV / Battery manufacturing preferred) | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Accounts Officer / DDO** (Job #9816) | 1 | PPS-7 | 16-Year Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Economics | 5+ Years Experience in public sector accounting, budgeting & audit | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Business Development Manager** (Job #9815) | 2 | PPS-7 | 16-Year Degree in Business Admin, Management Sciences, Marketing/PR, or Economics | 5+ Years Experience in stakeholder coordination & event management | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Consultants** (Job #9814) | 6 | PPS-11 | B.Sc. / B.E. Engineering (Chemical, Steel, Electrical, Heavy Engg, Industrial Process) | 16 Years (B.Sc.) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) in relevant engineering field | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Business Development / Marketing Outreach** (Job #9813) | 1 | PPS-11 | Master’s / MS / PhD in Business Admin, Marketing, PR, or related field | 16 Years (Master's) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) professional experience | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Economist** (Job #9812) | 1 | PPS-11 | Master’s / MS / PhD in Economics or Development Economics | 16 Years (Master's) / 12 Years (MS) / 8 Years (PhD) economic modeling experience | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Cost Accountant** (Job #9811) | 1 | PPS-11 | CA / ACMA / ACCA or Master's in Finance from recognized institution | 10 to 15 Years post-qualification experience as Cost Accountant | 21 Oct 2026 |
| **Financial Analyst** (Job #9810) | 1 | PPS-11 | CA / ACMA / ACCA or Master's in Finance from recognized institution | 10 to 15 Years post-qualification experience as Financial Analyst | 21 Oct 2026 |
### Critical Advisory on Senior vs Fresh Roles

> [!WARNING]
> **Important Career Advisory:** Candidates must note that **the majority of these positions (PPS-7 and PPS-11) are strictly senior-level and mid-career specialist roles requiring between 5 and 16 years of post-qualification experience.**
>
> Fresh graduates are **NOT eligible** for PPS-7 or PPS-11 roles. Junior professionals holding 16 years of education with at least 2 years of relevant experience may apply for the **Research Assistant (PPS-6)** position.
### How to Apply Online on National Job Portal (NJP)

1. Navigate to the official National Job Portal: `https://njp.gov.pk/jobs/search?q=Engineering+Development+Board`.
2. If you already have an NJP profile, click **Login**; otherwise, create a new candidate account with your CNIC.
3. Complete your digital CV, including basic details, academic qualifications, and verified employment history.
4. Open the specific job listing you qualify for (Job IDs 9810 through 9817).
5. Review the specific eligibility criteria and click **Apply Now**.
6. Confirm your submission. No physical hard copies or postal applications need to be submitted to EDB or NJP.
### Selection Procedure

- Shortlisting of candidates will be based strictly on merit, academic records, and relevant post-qualification experience verified through NJP.
- Only shortlisted candidates will be summoned for test/interview at Islamabad.
- No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in test/interview.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for EDB Jobs 2026?**
The application deadline is **21 October 2026** on the National Job Portal.

**Q2: How many total vacancies are advertised?**
There are **19 total vacancies** distributed across 8 different professional roles.

**Q3: Are fresh graduates eligible for all positions?**
No. Only the Research Assistant position accepts candidates with a minimum of 2 years of experience. All other positions require between 5 and 16+ years of post-qualification experience.

**Q4: Where will the appointed officers work?**
Selected professionals will be posted at the Engineering Development Board (EDB) Headquarters in **Islamabad**.

**Q5: Is there any application fee on NJP?**
Applications through the National Job Portal (NJP) for these federal project positions are free of application processing charges.

title: University of Malakand MS MPhil PhD Admissions 2026 – Apply Through NTS
shortDescription: University of Malakand (UOM) Chakdara Dir Lower announces Fall 2026-I MS, MPhil, and PhD admissions. Screening tests GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, and PhD subject tests conducted by NTS. Test fee Rs. 1,310. Apply online before 12 October 2026.
content: ### Official Announcement: University of Malakand Postgraduate Admissions

The **University of Malakand (UOM)**, a leading public university situated in Chakdara, Dir Lower, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, has formally announced the commencement of admissions for **MS, MPhil, and PhD Programs (Fall 2026-I Admission Test)**.

In collaboration with the **National Testing Service (NTS)** under **Project Code: 2609401**, the university will conduct standardized screening tests (GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, and PhD Subject Tests) for all eligible candidates seeking postgraduate admission.
### Quick Summary Table

- **University:** University of Malakand (UOM), Chakdara Dir Lower, KP
- **Intake Session:** Fall 2026-I Postgraduate Admissions
- **Testing Agency:** National Testing Service (NTS)
- **Project Code:** 2609401
- **Application Deadline:** **12 October 2026**
- **Tentative Test Date:** **18 October 2026**
- **NTS Application Fee:** **Rs. 1,300 + Rs. 10 Service Charges = Rs. 1,310/=**
- **Official NTS Project Link:** [portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0](https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0)
- **Online Registration:** [portal.nts.org.pk/register](https://portal.nts.org.pk/register)
### Test Categories & Offered Academic Disciplines

The NTS screening test is structured into specific GAT test categories according to academic faculty:

#### 1. GAT-A (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Management Studies** (Finance, Human Resource Management, Marketing)

#### 2. GAT-B (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Sociology**
- **Social Work**
- **Pashto**
- **Journalism & Mass Communication**

#### 3. GAT-C (MS / MPhil Programs):
- **Computer Science**
- **Pharmacy** (Pharmaceutics, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology)
- **Mathematics**
- **Biotechnology**
- **Geology**

#### 4. PhD Subject Admission Tests:
- Computer Science
- Mathematics
- Pharmacy
- Biotechnology
- Management Studies
- Sociology
- Social Work
### Program-Specific Eligibility Criteria

> [!IMPORTANT]
> - **MS / MPhil Eligibility:**
>   - Minimum 16 years of education (BS 4-Year or Master's 2-Year degree) in the relevant field from an HEC-recognized university.
>   - Minimum 2.50/4.00 CGPA under the semester system, or 50% marks under the annual examination system.
>   - Valid NTS GAT General / University Admission Test score of at least 50%.
> - **PhD Eligibility:**
>   - Minimum 18 years of education (MS / MPhil degree with thesis) in the relevant field.
>   - Minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA under the semester system, or 60% marks under the annual system.
>   - Valid NTS Subject Test / University Subject Admission Test score of at least 60%.
### NTS Application Fee & Payment Guidelines

- The test fee for each candidate is **Rs. 1,300 + Rs. 10 service charges (Total: Rs. 1,310/=)**.
- After filling out the online application form, generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice.
- Pay through any mobile banking application (Easypaisa, JazzCash, Upaisa, bank apps), ATM, or bank branch.
- Keep your transaction receipt safe; manual deposit slips are not required to be posted to NTS.
### Test Format & Preparation Guidance

- **GAT-General (MS/MPhil):** Covers Verbal Reasoning (English vocabulary, comprehension), Analytical Reasoning (logical deduction, pattern recognition), and Quantitative Reasoning (basic mathematics, algebra, arithmetic).
- **PhD Subject Test:** Focuses primarily on advanced subject knowledge (70% subject-specific content, 15% English, and 15% analytical reasoning).
- Candidates should review standard NTS past papers and syllabus guidelines available on the NTS portal.
### Step-by-Step Online Registration Guide

1. Open the official NTS project portal: `https://portal.nts.org.pk/Alldetail/MTAxMzY0`.
2. Click **Apply Now** for your respective category (GAT-A, GAT-B, GAT-C, or PhD Subject Test).
3. Register a new candidate profile with your CNIC and mobile number.
4. Complete academic background details and upload a recent passport-style photograph.
5. Select your preferred test center (e.g., Chakdara, Peshawar, Islamabad).
6. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice and pay the fee of Rs. 1,310 before **12 October 2026**.
7. Download and print the confirmation page for your records.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for UOM MS/MPhil/PhD admissions?**
The deadline to register for the NTS admission test is **12 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will the NTS admission test be held?**
The tentative test date is **18 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the test fee amount?**
The fee is **Rs. 1,310** (Rs. 1,300 test fee + Rs. 10 service charges).

**Q4: Can I apply for both MS and PhD at the same time?**
Candidates must possess 18 years of education (completed MS/MPhil) to be eligible for PhD. You can apply for the program matching your completed qualification.

**Q5: Is physical submission of the NTS form required?**
No. The application is completely paperless and submitted online via the NTS candidate portal.
