title: HEC Jobs 2026 – 9 Government Vacancies, Apply Before October 14
shortDescription: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan invites online applications for 9 government vacancies including Project Director, Project Managers, Law Officer, Project Accountant, Office Assistants, and Attendant. Monthly salary ranges from Rs40,700 to Rs398,130. Apply before 14 October 2026.
content: ### Executive Recruitment Notice & Official Announcement

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan**, the apex statutory federal regulatory body governing higher education in Pakistan, has released its official recruitment advertisement for **9 government vacancies** across federal project scales and regular basic pay scales. Qualified professionals from across Pakistan are invited to submit digital applications via the official HEC recruitment portal (`careers.hec.gov.pk`).
All nine positions are currently active and accepting online submissions until the strict closing deadline of **14 October 2026**.
### Comprehensive Breakdown of 9 Active Positions

Below is the complete, officially verified summary table specifying each of the 9 positions, quota allocation, required qualifications, exact monthly salary scales, and closing deadlines:

| Position Title | Vacancies | Regional Quota | Prescribed Qualification & Experience | Monthly Salary Scale | Application Deadline |
| :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| **Project Director** | 01 | Open Merit | PhD / Master's (16/18 Years) in Management Sciences, Engineering, or Social Sciences with 10+ years executive project management experience | **PPS-10 (Rs. 350,000 – Rs. 398,130 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Open Merit | Master's degree or 16-year BS in Management, CS, or Engineering with minimum 5 years proven project administration experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Punjab Quota | Master's degree or 16-year BS in relevant discipline with minimum 5 years project coordination experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Manager** | 01 | Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KPK) | Master's degree or 16-year BS with 5 years project monitoring & execution experience | **PPS-08 (Rs. 175,000 – Rs. 218,970 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Law Officer** | 01 | Open Merit | Bachelor of Laws (LLB) from an HEC-recognized university with active Bar Council enrollment and 2–3 years corporate/court litigation experience | **BPS-17 (Rs. 75,000 – Rs. 95,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Project Accountant** | 01 | Sindh (Urban) Quota | B.Com / BBA Finance / M.Com / BS Accounting & Finance with 2+ years public/private financial accounting and audit experience | **Project Pay Scale (Rs. 80,000 – Rs. 110,000 / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Office Assistant** | 01 | Punjab Quota | Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Sc / B.Com / BBA) with proven computer literacy (MS Office) and minimum typing speed | **BPS-15 (Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 65,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Office Assistant** | 01 | Sindh (Rural) Quota | Bachelor's Degree (BA / B.Sc / B.Com / BBA) with MS Office proficiency and clerical management skills | **BPS-15 (Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 65,000+ / month)** | 14 October 2026 |
| **Attendant** | 01 | Open Merit / Punjab Quota | Primary / Matriculation with physical fitness, reliability, and office dispatch/hospitality experience | **BPS-01 (Rs. 40,700 / month basic + allowances)** | 14 October 2026 |
### Verified Salary & Scale Structure Breakdown

> [!NOTE]
> **Official Pay Scale Structure:** The advertised positions fall within the verified salary spectrum of **Rs. 40,700 up to Rs. 398,130 per month**:
> - **Executive Leadership (PPS-10):** Fixed Project Pay Scale offering total monthly emoluments ranging from Rs. 350,000 to Rs. 398,130 based on candidate experience.
> - **Mid-Level Project Management (PPS-08):** Fixed Project Pay Scale offering total monthly emoluments between Rs. 175,000 and Rs. 218,970.
> - **Officer & Specialized Roles (BPS-17 & Project Accountant):** Ranging between Rs. 75,000 and Rs. 110,000 including standard federal allowances.
> - **Secretarial & Support Roles (BPS-15):** Basic Pay Scale 15 with allowances totaling Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 65,000.
> - **Office Attendant (BPS-01):** Entry-level federal basic pay scale with cost of living and utility allowances totaling Rs. 40,700 per month.
### Contract Nature & Age Limit Specifications

- **Nature of Appointments:** Project positions (PPS-10, PPS-08, and Project Accountant) are contractual appointments for an initial period of one year, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and project duration. Regular BPS positions (BPS-17, BPS-15, BPS-01) follow standard federal employment rules.
- **Age Limits (Calculated as of 14 October 2026):**
  * Project Director: 35 to 50 Years
  * Project Managers: 25 to 40 Years
  * Law Officer & Project Accountant: 22 to 35 Years
  * Office Assistants: 18 to 30 Years
  * Attendant: 18 to 30 Years
  * Standard general age relaxation of 5 years is admissible under Federal Government rules.
### Provincial & Regional Representation Focus

The recruitment strictly enforces constitutional provincial quota allocations:
- **Sindh Representation:** 1 position of Office Assistant is exclusively reserved under **Sindh (Rural)** quota, and 1 position of Project Accountant is reserved under **Sindh (Urban)** quota.
- **Punjab Representation:** 2 positions (1 Office Assistant, 1 Project Manager) and 1 Attendant are allocated under Punjab quota.
- **Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Representation:** 1 Project Manager position is exclusively reserved for KPK domicile holders.
- **Open Merit:** Project Director, 1 Project Manager, and Law Officer are open to all Pakistani nationals regardless of provincial domicile.
### Application Fee & Payment Mode

- A non-refundable application processing fee is prescribed:
  * **BPS-01 to BPS-15:** Rs. 600
  * **BPS-17 and PPS Roles:** Rs. 1,000
- Fee must be deposited online through **1Link 1Bill Invoice** via ATM, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking Apps (Easypaisa/JazzCash/Bank apps), using the dedicated consumer number generated automatically upon submitting the profile on `careers.hec.gov.pk`.
- Retain the transaction ID and paid receipt for interview verification.
### Selection Process & Testing Criteria

1. **Initial Screening:** Shortlisting of candidates based on academic credentials, domicile eligibility, and requisite years of experience.
2. **Written Screening Test:** Eligible candidates for clerical and officer posts will appear in a screening test conducted by the Education Testing Council (ETC) or HEC testing committee.
3. **Interview Panel:** Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview at HEC Head Office, Sector H-9, Islamabad.
### Required Documents for Online Upload

- CNIC Copy (Front & Back)
- Provincial Domicile Certificate
- All Academic Certificates, Degrees, and Detailed Marks Certificates (DMCs) from Matric to highest degree
- Verified Experience Letters from past and present employers
- Valid Bar Council License / Enrollment Certificate (Mandatory for Law Officer)
- Recent passport-size photograph with blue or white background
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. Navigate to the official HEC recruitment portal: `https://careers.hec.gov.pk/`.
2. Click on **Sign Up** to create an account using your 13-digit CNIC number and a valid email address.
3. Complete your digital profile: Personal Details, Educational History, and Employment Experience.
4. Browse the active vacancies list and choose the position aligned with your qualification and quota.
5. Generate the 1Link 1Bill invoice and pay the fee through your mobile banking application.
6. Confirm payment status on the portal, review all entered records, and click **Submit Application**.
7. Download and print the electronic application form before **14 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for HEC Jobs 2026?**
The final deadline for digital application submission on `careers.hec.gov.pk` is **14 October 2026**.

**Q2: Can I apply for more than one vacancy?**
Yes. Candidates possessing the required eligibility criteria for multiple posts can submit separate applications and pay the respective processing fees for each position.

**Q3: Is hardcopy submission to HEC Islamabad required?**
No. Do not dispatch physical application copies by post. Only candidates shortlisted for test or interview will be asked to present original verified documents.

**Q4: Are government employees eligible to apply?**
Yes, serving government employees can apply online but must obtain a Departmental Permission Certificate (NOC) from their parent department before appearing for the interview.

title: Habib University Admissions 2027 Open – Scholarship, Entry Test & Apply Online
shortDescription: Habib University announces undergraduate admissions 2027 for DSSE and AHSS schools. October-series application and scholarship deadline is 21 October 2026. Entrance examinations on 23 & 26 October. Merit scholarships up to 100% and need-based financial aid available.
content: ### Official Undergraduate Admissions Announcement 2027

**Habib University (HU) Karachi**, Pakistan’s premier dedicated liberal arts and sciences institution, has officially opened undergraduate admissions for the **Class of 2027** (Session 2027–2031). Operating on a global interdisciplinary curriculum anchored by its signature Liberal Core, Habib University invites aspiring leaders to apply in its **October Series Admission Round**.

The official admissions calendar published on the Habib University portal (`habib.edu.pk/admissions/international-examination-board/admission-schedule/`) confirms that the digital application submission and financial aid portal is active, with the October round deadline set for **21 October 2026**.
### October Series Official Schedule Breakdown

Below is the verified timeline for the ongoing October Admissions Series:
- **Admissions Form Submission Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Scholarship & Financial Aid Application Deadline:** **21 October 2026**
- **Habib University Entrance Examinations (HAT):** **23 & 26 October 2026**
- **Admission Interviews:** **30 October 2026 onwards**
- **Admission Decisions:** Rolling Admissions (Decisions communicated sequentially following interviews)
- **Special Information Session:** Prospective applicants and parents are invited to attend the **Admission Information Session on 9 October 2026** (registration available via the admissions portal) to explore degree faculties, campus life, and funding options.
### Subsequent Admission Rounds (For Future Reference)

For students unable to sit the October test, subsequent admission series deadlines are scheduled as follows:
- **November Series:** Deadline 20 November 2026 | Exams 24 & 25 November 2026
- **December Series:** Deadline 23 December 2026 | Exams 29 & 30 December 2026
- **January Series:** Deadline 21 January 2027 | Exams 25–27 January 2027
- **February Series:** Deadline 16 February 2027 | Exams 18–24 February 2027
### Academic Programs Offered Across Two Flagship Schools

Habib University offers six world-class undergraduate degree programmes across its two distinguished schools:

1. **Dhanani School of Science and Engineering (DSSE):**
   - **BS Computer Science (BSCS):** Focused on software systems, artificial intelligence, data engineering, and modern theoretical computation.
   - **BS Computer Engineering (BSCE):** Bridging computer architecture, embedded hardware design, and robotics.
   - **BS Electrical Engineering (BSEE):** Specializing in energy systems, telecommunications, and digital electronics.

2. **School of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (AHSS):**
   - **BSc (Honours) Social Development & Policy (SDP):** Pioneering interdisciplinary studies in South Asian development, urban ecology, governance, and public policy.
   - **BSc (Honours) Comparative Humanities (CH):** Critical exploration of world literatures, philosophy, history, and religious studies.
   - **BA (Honours) Communication and Design (CND):** Integrating visual design, moving image, digital media, typography, and creative narrative.
### Academic Eligibility Criteria

Applicants must meet the following minimum academic standards based on their educational background:
- **Intermediate (HSC / Board of Intermediate Education):** Minimum aggregate of **60% marks** in Pre-Engineering, Computer Science, Pre-Medical (with additional mathematics where required for engineering), or General Science.
- **A Levels (Cambridge / Pearson Edexcel):** Minimum of **2 B's and 1 C** across three principal academic A-Level subjects. (General Paper, Thinking Skills, and Urdu as a second language do not fulfill primary requirements).
- **International Baccalaureate (IB) / High School Diploma:** Minimum of **28 IB Diploma points** or an accredited US High School Diploma with official Equivalence Certificate issued by the Inter Board Coordination Commission (IBCC).
### Entrance Examination & Test Exemption Criteria

Candidates must complete the **Habib University Entrance Examination (HAT)** scheduled for **23 & 26 October 2026**:
- **DSSE Test Modules:** Advanced Mathematics & English Language Comprehension & Critical Writing.
- **AHSS Test Modules:** Quantitative Reasoning & English Language Comprehension & Critical Writing.
- **SAT / ACT Exemption:** Applicants who have achieved a minimum composite score of **1250 on the SAT (Reasoning)** or a composite score of **28 on the ACT** are eligible for an exemption from the HU Entrance Examination.
### Clarification on Scholarships vs. Need-Based Financial Aid

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Financial Support Transparency:** Habib University does NOT characterize all financial assistance as a fully funded scholarship. Funding is distinctly separated into merit-based awards and need-based financial aid:
> - **Merit Scholarships:** Awarded purely based on academic distinction and entrance examination results. Merit tiers cover **25%, 50%, 75%, and up to 100% of tuition fees** for all four years of study.
> - **Need-Based Financial Aid:** Graded financial grants calculated solely based on the applicant's assessed family financial circumstances. Over **85% of admitted Habib students** receive financial aid or merit scholarships.
> - **HU TOPS (Talent Outreach, Promotion and Support):** A specialized 100% fully funded scholarship program dedicated exclusively to high-achieving Intermediate Board students from public and affiliated colleges.
> - **Yohsin Scholarship:** Flagship prestigious award granted to extraordinary candidates exemplifying intellectual passion and community leadership.
### Required Application Documents

- Scanned copy of CNIC / B-Form / Passport
- Secondary School Certificate (SSC / Matric) or Cambridge O-Level Statement of Results
- Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC Part-I / Pre-Board) or Cambridge AS-Level / A-Level Statement of Results
- Statement of Purpose / Personal Essay highlighting intellectual interests and community engagement
- Financial Aid Application Form accompanied by proof of family income, utilities, and tax returns (if applying for aid by 21 October 2026)
### Step-by-Step Online Application Process

1. Visit the official Habib University admissions portal at `https://eapplication.habib.edu.pk/`.
2. Create a new user account with your active email address and phone number.
3. Fill in your personal profile, family information, and high school academic history.
4. Select your preferred degree programme within DSSE or AHSS.
5. If applying for financial assistance, complete the comprehensive Financial Aid section before submitting.
6. Pay the application processing fee of **Rs. 3,500** via online debit/credit card or designated banking voucher.
7. Review and finalize your submission before the deadline of **21 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline for October series admissions?**
The application and financial aid deadline is **21 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will entrance examinations take place?**
The examinations will be held on **23 & 26 October 2026**.

**Q3: Can I apply for financial aid in later rounds?**
Financial aid pools are largest in early rounds. Applying in the October round maximizes your opportunity for optimal financial aid and merit scholarship consideration.

**Q4: How do I attend the 9 October Admission Information Session?**
Register directly through the admissions portal at `habib.edu.pk/admissions/` to participate in person or virtually.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027–28 for Pakistani Students – Apply Online
shortDescription: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships 2027–28 open for Pakistani researchers and PhD scholars. Fully funded monthly stipend of CHF 1,920 to CHF 3,500, full health insurance, and return airfare. Applications close 31 October 2026 via direct ESKAS submission.
content: ### Prestigious Academic Research Opportunities in Switzerland

The **Swiss Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS / ESKAS)**, in direct coordination with the **Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad**, has formally opened applications for the **Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships for the Academic Year 2027–28**. This premier European initiative provides exceptional Pakistani scholars and researchers the opportunity to pursue advanced doctoral and postdoctoral research at Switzerland’s world-renowned cantonal universities, research institutes, and federal institutes of technology (**ETH Zurich** and **EPFL**).
All applications must be submitted directly through the official Swiss ESKAS electronic portal (`go.eskas.ch/LoginServlet`) before the strict closing deadline of **31 October 2026**.
### Critical Institutional Clarification: HEC Role vs. ESKAS

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **HEC Role & Financial Clarification:** The Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan advertises this opportunity solely for public awareness and student facilitation (`hec.gov.pk/english/services/students/swiss-scholarship`).
>
> - **Zero Financial Liability:** HEC bears absolutely NO financial liability or funding commitment for this scholarship.
> - **Direct Swiss Application:** HEC does NOT conduct screening, shortlisting, or nominations. Candidates must apply directly to ESKAS / the Embassy of Switzerland.
> - **No HEC Portal Submission:** Submissions made solely on HEC portals will not be forwarded to the Swiss government. You must apply directly through the official Swiss portal.
### Eligible Programs & Clear Ineligibility Notice

For Pakistani applicants, the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships are strictly restricted to the following postgraduate research tracks:
1. **PhD Scholarships:** Full doctoral degree research (up to 36–48 months) leading to a doctorate awarded by an accredited Swiss university.
2. **Research Fellowships:** 12-month non-degree research projects intended for enrolled PhD students or junior researchers wishing to conduct field or laboratory research in Switzerland.
3. **Postdoctoral Scholarships:** 12-month advanced scientific research for scholars who hold a recognized PhD degree.

> [!WARNING]
> **Undergraduate & Taught Master's Exclusion:** Bachelor's degree and taught Master's (MA / MSc / MBA) programmes are **STRICTLY NOT OFFERED** for Pakistan under the Swiss Government Excellence framework. Applications for taught courses will be rejected immediately.
### Mandatory Prerequisite: Host Professor Acceptance Letter

The single most critical prerequisite for obtaining the Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship is securing an **Academic Host Professor Confirmation Letter** prior to submitting your application:
- Applicants must independently contact a tenured professor or faculty member at an eligible Swiss cantonal university or federal institute (e.g., ETH Zurich, EPFL, University of Zurich, University of Geneva, University of Basel, University of Bern, EPFL).
- The professor must issue a formal, signed written letter explicitly agreeing to supervise your research project and confirming that adequate laboratory space, computing infrastructure, and departmental facilities are available for your tenure.
### Comprehensive Financial Coverage & Monthly Stipends

The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship covers all essential living and academic expenses in Switzerland:
- **Monthly Living Stipend:**
  * **PhD and Research Fellows:** **CHF 1,920 per month** (tax-free living allowance).
  * **Postdoctoral Fellows:** **CHF 3,500 per month**.
- **Mandatory Swiss Health Insurance:** Full coverage of mandatory Swiss health and accident insurance premiums, paid directly by the Federal Commission for Scholarships.
- **Housing Allowance Lump-Sum:** A one-time relocation grant of **CHF 300** disbursed upon arrival in Switzerland to assist with housing lease deposits and furniture essentials.
- **Swiss Public Transport Half-Fare Card:** A prepaid Swiss Halbtax card providing 50% discount on all Swiss public trains, buses, and ferries for the entire duration of stay.
- **Return Economy Airfare:** Return flight ticket subsidy paid at the conclusion of the fellowship to cover repatriation back to Pakistan.
### Detailed Eligibility Checklist

- **Nationality:** Must hold Pakistani citizenship.
- **Academic Profile:** Must possess a recognized Master's degree (MS / MPhil with minimum 17–18 years of education) for PhD/Research applications, or an accredited PhD degree completed within the last 3 years for Postdoctoral applications.
- **Age Ceiling:** For PhD and Research Fellowships, candidates must have been born after **31 December 1991**.
- **Language Competence:** Strong proficiency in English or the language of instruction (German, French, or Italian) required by the host laboratory.
- **Dual Residency Clause:** Candidates who have already resided in Switzerland for more than one year prior to September 2027 are ineligible.
### Required Application Dossier (Triplicate Submissions)

Applicants must assemble their complete application package consisting of:
1. Official FCS Application Form (with photograph)
2. Comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) including publication records
3. Detailed Research Proposal (maximum 5 pages) outlining methodology, literature review, and academic timeline
4. Formal Host Professor Acceptance Letter and Professor's short CV
5. Two confidential letters of recommendation from academic referees
6. Attested copies of academic transcripts and degree certificates (HEC / IBCC verified)
7. Medical Health Certificate signed by a certified physician
8. Clear scanned copy of valid Pakistani Passport
### Step-by-Step Direct Application Procedure

1. Secure written acceptance from an eligible Swiss host professor.
2. Access the official Swiss electronic scholarship portal at `https://www.go.eskas.ch/LoginServlet`.
3. Request and download the standardized FCS application package and reference templates.
4. Complete all digital forms, compile required supporting documents into organized PDF dossiers, and submit online.
5. Print three complete hardcopy sets (1 original with original signatures + 2 copies) and submit them to the **Embassy of Switzerland in Islamabad** before **31 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the final deadline to apply for Swiss Government Scholarships 2027–28?**
The application deadline is **31 October 2026**.

**Q2: Does HEC provide any funding for this scholarship?**
No. HEC has zero financial liability and does not provide matching grants or stipends for this program. All funding is borne by the Swiss Federal Government.

**Q3: Can I apply without an acceptance letter from a Swiss professor?**
No. Applications lacking a formal written commitment from a Swiss host professor are considered incomplete and will not be evaluated by the Federal Commission for Scholarships.

**Q4: Can I apply for a Master's degree under this scholarship?**
No. The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarship for Pakistan is restricted exclusively to Research Fellowships, PhD, and Postdoctoral studies.

title: HEC Research Awards 2026–27 – Win Up to Rs1 Million, Apply Before October 31
shortDescription: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan invites applications for HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27. Cash prizes up to Rs 1,000,000 for Best Publication, and Rs 500,000 each for Best Researcher and Young Researcher. Apply online before 31 October 2026.
content: ### National Call for HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27

The **Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan**, through its **Research and Development (R&D) Division**, has issued the national call for applications for the **HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27**. Instituted to recognize, encourage, and reward scientific ingenuity and research excellence, these premier state awards confer national prestige alongside cash prizes of **up to Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** and citation shields.

Eligible university faculty members, active research scholars, and independent scientists across Pakistan are invited to submit digital applications via the official HEC Research Portal (`research.hec.gov.pk`) before the strict national deadline of **31 October 2026**.
### Categorical Clarification: Exact Cash Prizes per Award Track

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Crucial Cash Prize Breakdown:** Please note that cash rewards are categorized strictly by award title. **Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** is awarded exclusively for the **Best Publication Award**, while other award tracks carry **Rs. 500,000** each:
>
> 1. **Best Publication Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 1,000,000 (Rs. 1 Million)** + Gold Plaque & Certificate. Conferred for groundbreaking original research articles published in premier high-impact international journals indexed in Web of Science (WOS) / Scopus.
> 2. **Best Researcher Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 500,000 (Rs. 500k)** + Citation Plaque & Certificate. Conferred upon active senior or mid-career faculty demonstrating consistent, high-impact research output, exceptional citation metrics, H-index, research grants, and commercialized patents.
> 3. **Best Young Researcher Award:** Cash prize of **Rs. 500,000 (Rs. 500k)** + Citation Plaque & Certificate. Specially reserved for promising early-career scholars **aged 40 years or below** who demonstrate remarkable scientific productivity.
### Three Broad Academic Disciplines

Applications are invited across three recognized disciplinary clusters:
- **Domain 1: Biological, Medical, Health & Agricultural Sciences:** Encompassing Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Pharmacology, Clinical Sciences, Agronomy, Veterinary Sciences, and Environmental Biology.
- **Domain 2: Physical Sciences, Engineering, Technology, Computer Science & Mathematics:** Covering Physics, Chemistry, Material Science, Electrical/Mechanical/Civil Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and Pure & Applied Mathematics.
- **Domain 3: Social Sciences, Humanities, Management Sciences & Arts:** Encompassing Economics, Public Policy, Governance, Business Administration, Sociology, Law, Education, Literature, and Creative Arts.
### Strict Eligibility Criteria & Age Ceiling

- **Citizenship:** Applicants must be Pakistani or Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK) nationals.
- **Institutional Affiliation:** Must be regular, contract, or tenure-track faculty members, researchers, or post-doctoral fellows serving in HEC-recognized public or private higher education institutions or public R&D establishments.
- **Young Researcher Age Limit:** Candidates competing for the **Best Young Researcher Award** must be strictly **40 years of age or below** on the application cutoff date (**January 1, 2026**).
- **Originality & Plagiarism Standards:** All submitted publications and research claims must adhere strictly to HEC's Policy on Research Ethics and Plagiarism. Articles previously awarded an HEC national prize or state civil award are ineligible.
### Required Documentation & Institutional Endorsement

Applicants must compile and upload the following digital documents to the HEC portal:
- Scanned copy of CNIC / Passport
- Official Appointment Order and Institutional Identity Card proving current employment
- Comprehensive Academic CV highlighting Scopus Author ID, Web of Science ResearcherID, and Google Scholar profile
- Full-text PDF copies of candidate research papers, book chapters, or patent grant letters
- Proof of Journal Impact Factor and JCR quartile ranking for the year of publication
- **Head of Institution Endorsement Form:** Formal endorsement signed and stamped by the Vice Chancellor, Rector, or Head of the R&D Institution.
### Step-by-Step Portal Application Process

1. Navigate to the official HEC Research Portal at `https://research.hec.gov.pk/`.
2. Log in using your existing HEC e-portal CNIC credentials or register a new user account.
3. Navigate to **Faculty Services** and select **HEC Outstanding Research Awards 2026–27**.
4. Complete the candidate profile and select your category (Best Publication, Best Researcher, or Best Young Researcher).
5. Enter publication bibliographic citations (DOI, ISSN, Journal Name, Impact Factor) and upload PDF reprints.
6. Generate the formal summary endorsement form, obtain the signature of your Vice Chancellor / Rector, and upload the signed copy.
7. Review all data fields and click **Submit Application** before **31 October 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to apply for HEC Research Awards 2026–27?**
The deadline for online submissions on `research.hec.gov.pk` is **31 October 2026**.

**Q2: Does every award recipient receive Rs 1 Million?**
No. The Rs 1,000,000 (Rs 1 Million) prize is awarded exclusively to the recipient of the Best Publication Award. Best Researcher and Best Young Researcher awardees receive Rs 500,000 each.

**Q3: What is the age limit for the Young Researcher category?**
Applicants must be 40 years of age or younger on **1 January 2026**.

**Q4: Can researchers from private universities apply?**
Yes. Faculty members and researchers from both public and private HEC-recognized universities are fully eligible.

title: Virtual University Fall 2026 Admissions – Apply Before 10 October
shortDescription: Virtual University of Pakistan (VU) announces the complete admission schedule for Fall 2026. MS/M.Phil programs and Need-Based Scholarships close TODAY, 5 October 2026. General BS, Associate Degrees, and Diplomas remain open until 10 October 2026. Classes commence 12 October.
content: ### Comprehensive Fall 2026 Admission Schedule

The **Virtual University of Pakistan (VU)**—Pakistan’s pioneering federal public sector university based on modern information and communication technology—has published its official **Admission Schedule for Fall 2026** on `vu.edu.pk/Admissions/AdmissionProcedure`. Prospective students across Pakistan and overseas communities can pursue fully recognized higher education with world-class digital flexibility.

> [!WARNING]
> **CRITICAL DEADLINE DIFFERENTIATION:**
> - **MS / M.Phil Programmes & Need-Based Scholarships:** Close **TODAY, 05 October 2026**.
> - **Undergraduate BS, Associate Degrees (AD), B.Ed & Diplomas:** Close on **10 October 2026**.
> - **Commencement of Fall 2026 Classes:** Scheduled for **12 October 2026**.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Institution:** Virtual University of Pakistan (Federal Chartered Public University)
- **Intake Session:** Fall 2026 Admissions
- **MS / M.Phil Application Deadline:** 05 October 2026 (Closes Today!)
- **Need-Based Scholarship Deadline:** 05 October 2026 (Closes Today!)
- **General Undergraduate & Diploma Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Course Exemption / Credit Transfer Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Processing Fee Deposit Deadline:** 10 October 2026
- **Change of Study Program Deadline:** 11 October 2026
- **Commencement of Academic Classes:** 12 October 2026
- **Course Selection (Add/Drop) Deadline:** 21 October 2026
- **Admission Processing Fee:** Rs. 500/- (Payable online or via bank challan)
- **Study Modes:** Campus-Based (over 200 campuses) or Home-Based (Distance e-Learning)
- **Official Application Portal:** [www.vu.edu.pk/apply](https://www.vu.edu.pk/apply)
### Program Portfolio Offered in Fall 2026

1. **Faculty of Computer Science & Information Technology:**
   - BS Computer Science (BSCS), BS Software Engineering (BSSE), BS Information Technology (BSIT), BS Data Science, and BS Cyber Security.
   - 2-Year Associate Degrees in Computer Science, Database Management Systems, and Web Design & Development.

2. **Faculty of Management & Business Studies:**
   - Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA - 4 Years), BS Accounting & Finance, BS Banking & Finance, and BS Commerce.
   - 2-Year Associate Degrees in Accounting, Islamic Banking, Human Resource Management, and Sales & Marketing.

3. **Faculty of Arts & Social Sciences:**
   - BS English (Applied Linguistics), BS Psychology, BS Mass Communication, BS Sociology, and BS Economics.

4. **Faculty of Education:**
   - B.Ed (Honours) 4-Year, B.Ed 1.5-Year (for Master's holders), and B.Ed 2.5-Year (for 14-year degree holders).

5. **Postgraduate & Specialization Diplomas:**
   - 1-Year Diplomas in Applied Psychology, Computer Science, Banking, Big Data Analytics, and Human Resource Management.
### Eligibility Prerequisite Overview

- **For 4-Year BS Programs:** Minimum 45% to 50% marks in Intermediate (FA, FSc, ICS, I.Com) or equivalent from a recognized board.
- **For Computing Programs:** Mathematics at Intermediate level is mandatory for BSCS and BSSE as per NCEAC guidelines.
- **For Associate Degree Programs:** Minimum 45% marks in Intermediate (12 years of education).
- **For B.Ed (1.5 Years):** Minimum 16 years of education (MA/MSc/BS) with at least 45% aggregate or 2.00 CGPA.
- **Zero Semester Option:** Candidates who do not meet the minimum percentage criteria for specific programs can qualify by passing the VU Zero Semester.
### Step-by-Step Online Application Procedure

1. **Portal Registration:** Navigate to `https://www.vu.edu.pk/apply` and click *New Registration* using your valid CNIC / B-Form and email address.
2. **Select Study Track:** Choose your preferred study program and mode of education (Home-Based with digital access or Campus-Based at your nearest VU campus).
3. **Enter Educational Profile:** Input your Matriculation and Intermediate grades, roll numbers, and passing boards.
4. **Upload Scanned Documents:** Attach passport-sized photograph, CNIC/B-Form copy, and academic transcripts (DMC/Certificates).
5. **Generate & Pay Processing Fee:** Print the computerized **Rs. 500 Admission Processing Fee** challan voucher. Deposit via 1Link, ATM, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, or any designated commercial bank branch.
6. **Finalize Submission:** Confirm fee deposit on the portal before **10 October 2026** (or **05 October 2026** for MS/MPhil applicants).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the last date to apply for Virtual University Fall 2026 admissions?**
General undergraduate, Associate Degree, B.Ed, and Diploma admissions close on **10 October 2026**. However, MS/M.Phil programs and Need-Based Scholarships close **TODAY, 05 October 2026**.

**Q2: When will classes start for Fall 2026?**
Academic classes for the Fall 2026 semester officially commence on **12 October 2026**.

**Q3: What is the admission processing fee at VU?**
The admission processing fee is **Rs. 500/-**, payable through bank challan or mobile banking.

**Q4: Can I study completely from home at Virtual University?**
Yes. VU offers a fully accredited Home-Based study mode where lectures, assignments, and study materials are accessed online through the Learning Management System (LMS).

**Q5: What is the deadline for credit transfer or course exemptions?**
The last date to submit applications for course exemption and transfer of credits is **10 October 2026**.

**Q6: What is the last date to add or drop courses?**
Students can add, drop, or replace courses through course selection until **21 October 2026**.

title: UET Reciprocal Admissions 2026 – 40 Engineering Seats Available
shortDescription: UET Lahore invites applications from Punjab domicile holders for 40 reserved undergraduate engineering seats in public universities across Sindh, KP, AJK, and Balochistan on a reciprocal basis for Entry Session 2026. Deadline is 09 October 2026 at 4:00 PM.
content: ### Understanding Reciprocal Engineering Admissions

Under inter-provincial educational exchange treaties, public engineering universities in Pakistan allocate a designated quota of seats for students from other provinces on a mutual **reciprocal basis**. The **University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore** coordinates and administers the selection process for all **Punjab domicile holders** aspiring to secure admission into undergraduate engineering programs in sister universities located in Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, and Balochistan for **Entry Session 2026**.

According to the official announcement released on the UET Lahore Admissions portal (`apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83`), a total of **40 reserved engineering seats** are available across six prominent engineering institutions.
### Quick Information Summary Table

- **Administering University:** University of Engineering and Technology (UET) Lahore
- **Intake Category:** Undergraduate Admissions on Reciprocal Basis (Entry Session 2026)
- **Total Reserved Seats:** 40 Engineering Seats
- **Eligible Candidates:** Punjab Domicile Holders Only
- **Mandatory Entrance Exam:** UET Combined Entry Test (ECAT 2026 — March/April or June Session)
- **Minimum Academic Qualification:** Intermediate Pre-Engineering / DAE with at least 60% Marks
- **Application Processing Fee:** Rs. 3,000/- per University Preference
- **Application Form Availability:** Online at [admission.uet.edu.pk](https://admission.uet.edu.pk/)
- **Submission Mode:** In-Person Submission at Students Section, UET Lahore Main Campus (No Postal / Courier)
- **Application Deadline:** 09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM
- **Hafiz-e-Quran Test Date:** 15 October 2026 at 10:00 AM
- **Official Notification Source:** [apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83](https://apply.uet.edu.pk/news/83)
### Complete Breakdown of 40 Reciprocal Engineering Seats

The 40 reciprocal seats are strictly divided among the following six prestigious universities:

1. **NED University of Engineering and Technology, Karachi (04 Seats):**
   - Electrical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats

2. **Mehran University of Engineering and Technology (MUET), Jamshoro (03 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Chemical Engineering: 02 Seats

3. **University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Peshawar (10 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Electrical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Mining Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Agricultural Engineering: 01 Seat

4. **Mirpur University of Engineering & Technology (MUST), Mirpur, AJK (11 Seats):**
   - Electrical Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Computer System Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Software Engineering: 02 Seats

5. **Balochistan University of Engineering and Technology (BUET), Khuzdar (09 Seats):**
   - Civil Engineering: 02 Seats
   - Electrical Engineering: 03 Seats
   - Mechanical Engineering: 04 Seats

6. **Dawood University of Engineering & Technology, Karachi (03 Seats):**
   - Electronics Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Telecommunication Engineering: 01 Seat
   - Energy & Environmental Engineering: 01 Seat
### Academic Eligibility & Merit Formula

To qualify for admission consideration against the reciprocal seat quota, candidates must satisfy the following criteria:
- **Entrance Test Requirement:** Candidates must have appeared in either the First Combined Entry Test 2026 (held from 30 March to 03 April 2026) or the Second ECAT (held from 16 to 21 June 2026) administered by UET Lahore.
- **Intermediate / DAE Marks:** Minimum **60% aggregate marks** in FSc (Pre-Engineering), relevant Diploma of Associate Engineering (DAE), or equivalent qualification recognized by IBCC.
- **Official Merit Calculation Weightage:**
  - **Intermediate / Equivalent Marks:** 70% Weightage
  - **UET Entry Test (ECAT) Marks:** 30% Weightage
- **Hafiz-e-Quran Assessment:** Candidates claiming Hafiz-e-Quran additional marks who did not appear in the test on 17 or 18 July 2026 must appear for the test on **15 October 2026 at 10:00 AM**.
### Step-by-Step Application Procedure

> [!WARNING]
> **In-Person Submission Only:** UET Lahore explicitly mandates that application forms must be submitted by hand at the UET Lahore Administration Block. Submissions sent via Pakistan Post, courier, or delivery services **will NOT be entertained**.

1. **Online Form Generation:** Visit `https://admission.uet.edu.pk/` and fill out the reciprocal admission application form.
2. **Generate Bank Challan:** Print the computerized bank challan for the preference fee of **Rs. 3,000/- per university** and deposit the amount at designated bank branches.
3. **Print Completed Form:** Print a physical copy of the filled application form and sign the declarations.
4. **Attach Required Documents:** Attach certified copies of Punjab Domicile, Matric certificate, Intermediate DMC / DAE transcript, ECAT result card, and original bank payment slip.
5. **Submit at UET Lahore:** Visit the **Students Section (Administration Block), UET Lahore**, on any working day between **9:00 AM and 3:30 PM**.
6. **Submission Deadline:** Ensure your application is deposited before **09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the deadline to submit the UET Reciprocal Admission form?**
The final closing date and time for receipt of applications at UET Lahore is **09 October 2026 (Friday) at 4:00 PM**.

**Q2: Can applicants from other provinces apply through this quota?**
No. This reciprocal quota is exclusively reserved for candidates holding a valid **Punjab domicile**.

**Q3: Can I send my application by courier or post?**
No. UET Lahore strictly requires physical in-person submission at the Students Section, Administration Block, UET Lahore.

**Q4: How many reciprocal engineering seats are available in total?**
Exactly **40 seats** are available across six universities (NED, MUET, UET Peshawar, MUST, BUET Khuzdar, and Dawood UET).

**Q5: What is the processing fee per university preference?**
The application fee is **Rs. 3,000/- per university** applied for.

**Q6: What is the aggregate merit formula for reciprocal seats?**
Merit is calculated based on **70% Intermediate marks** and **30% UET Entry Test (ECAT) score**.

title: CBD Punjab Youth Career Program 2026 – Paid Internship for Fresh Graduates
shortDescription: Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (PCBDDA / CBD Punjab) has opened applications for the Youth Career Program 2026. A structured, up to 3-month paid internship for fresh graduates with a minimum 3.0 CGPA and max age 25. Apply online before October 12, 2026.
content: ### Program Overview & Authority Mandate

The **Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (PCBDDA)**, prominently known as **CBD Punjab**, is the statutory government body driving Pakistan’s premier master-planned smart urban district and global financial hub. Under its youth empowerment charter, CBD Punjab has officially launched the **Youth Career Program 2026 (YCP 2026)** to recruit ambitious fresh university graduates for an immersive, **up to 3-month paid internship placement**.

Interns will gain direct exposure to mega-infrastructure engineering projects, commercial asset management, advanced GIS mapping, and corporate strategic management at the authority’s headquarters in Lahore.
### Quick Overview Summary Table

- **Administering Authority:** Punjab Central Business District Development Authority (CBD Punjab / PCBDDA)
- **Initiative Title:** CBD Punjab Youth Career Program 2026 (YCP 2026)
- **Placement Type:** Paid Graduate Internship
- **Program Duration:** Up to 3 Months
- **Office Location:** CBD Punjab Complex, Yasir Shaheed Road, Lahore
- **Academic Requirement:** Minimum 16 Years of Education (BS / BE / BBA / MA / MSc / LLB)
- **Minimum CGPA:** 3.0 out of 4.0 (or equivalent 1st Division)
- **Maximum Age Limit:** 25 Years on application closing date
- **Target Group:** Fresh Graduates Only
- **Financial Remuneration:** Monthly Paid Internship Stipend
- **Application Deadline:** 12 October 2026 (7 Days Remaining)
- **Official Information Portal:** [cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026](https://cbdpunjab.gov.pk/ycp2026)
- **Official Online Application System:** [careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda](https://careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda)
### Directorates & Eligible Academic Disciplines

Applicants can compete for placement within specific directorates based on their academic qualification:

1. **Finance & Accounting Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: BBA Finance, BS Accounting & Finance, BSc/MSc Finance, ACCA, CMA, or specialized financial management degree.

2. **IT & Human Resources Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or Human Resource Management.

3. **Legal & Contracts Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Master of Laws (LLM), or Contracts Management specialization.

4. **Procurement & Supply Chain Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Procurement Operations.

5. **Land & Estate Management Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree holders in relevant management or property administration disciplines.

6. **Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: BS / MSc in GIS, Geomatics, Space Sciences, or Remote Sensing.

7. **Audit & Internal Governance Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Accounting & Finance, Auditing, Commerce, or professional certifications (ACCA, CA, CMA, CIMA).

8. **Business Development, PR & Marketing:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Public Relations, Communication Studies, Media Studies, Journalism & Mass Communication, Sales & Marketing.

9. **Engineering & Architecture Directorate:**
   - Eligible Degrees: Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Architecture, and Urban & Regional Planning.
### Comprehensive Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill the rigorous standards set by PCBDDA:
- **Educational Threshold:** Minimum 16 years of completed formal education from an HEC-recognized institution in Pakistan or accredited foreign university.
- **Academic Performance:** Minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average of **3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 1st Division).
- **Age Criterion:** Maximum **25 years** as of the closing date, 12 October 2026.
- **Fresh Graduate Status:** Designed strictly for candidates who have recently completed their degree and are seeking their first career-defining professional immersion.
### Key Benefits & Professional Deliverables

- **Financial Remuneration:** Monthly competitive stipend throughout the 3-month duration.
- **Official Certificate:** Formal PCBDDA Experience Certificate detailing projects delivered and skills mastered.
- **Executive Mentorship:** Practical on-site coaching by senior project directors, civil architects, and corporate executives.
- **Networking Platform:** Direct engagement with multidisciplinary consultants, financial institutions, and contracting consortiums.
### Step-by-Step Application Guide

1. **Visit Official Recruitment Portal:** Access the PCBDDA digital portal at `https://careers.accelerec.com/career/pcbdda`.
2. **Locate YCP 2026 Listing:** Select **Youth Career Program 2026**.
3. **Create Account:** Register with your email address and create a secure login.
4. **Complete Profile Data:** Fill in your academic credentials, degree title, university name, final CGPA, and date of birth.
5. **Upload Credentials:** Attach an updated curriculum vitae (CV), clear copy of CNIC, and official final transcript showing CGPA 3.0 or above.
6. **Submit Application:** Finalize submission prior to the official deadline of **October 12, 2026**.
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the closing date for CBD Punjab Youth Career Program 2026?**
The last date to submit online applications is **12 October 2026**.

**Q2: Is the CBD Punjab internship paid?**
Yes. Selected candidates receive a monthly paid stipend during the 3-month internship tenure.

**Q3: What is the minimum CGPA required?**
Candidates must have a minimum **CGPA of 3.0 out of 4.0** (or equivalent 1st Division).

**Q4: What is the maximum age limit?**
The maximum age limit is **25 years** on the application closing date.

**Q5: Are result-awaiting candidates eligible?**
No. Only candidates who have successfully graduated with a minimum 16-year degree and available transcript are eligible.

**Q6: Where is the internship located?**
The internship takes place at the CBD Punjab Complex, Yasir Shaheed Road, Lahore.

title: HEC USAT & HAT Registration 2026 – Apply Online Before October 2
shortDescription: HEC Education Testing Council (ETC) invites online registrations for Undergraduate Studies Admission Test (USAT) and Higher Education Aptitude Test (HAT) 2026.
content: The Education Testing Council (ETC) under HEC Pakistan is conducting nationwide registrations for USAT and HAT 2026 standardized aptitude tests.

title: Punjab University Jobs 2026 — Faculty & Staff Vacancies Online Application
shortDescription: University of the Punjab (PU) Lahore has announced recruitment for teaching faculty (Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Lecturers) and contingent staff. Apply online before November 30, 2026.
content: ### Simple Introduction & Overview

The University of the Punjab (PU), Lahore—Pakistan’s oldest and premier public research institution—has officially released its comprehensive recruitment advertisement for 2026. Opportunities are available across diverse academic faculties (Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, Lecturers) and daily-wage / contingent support staff.

As a public government-chartered university, PU offers permanent pensionable seats, Tenure Track System (TTS) appointments, and government-approved pay scales with comprehensive medical and housing allowances.
### Important Dates & Deadlines
- **Official Announcement Date:** September 2026
- **Faculty Application Closing Date:** **November 30, 2026**
- **Contingent Staff Application Deadline:** October 2026 (varies by post)
- **Official Application Portal:** `https://pu.edu.pk/careers/`
### University Sector & Status
- **University Type:** Public / Government Sector Chartered University
- **Governing Authority:** Higher Education Commission (HEC) & Government of Punjab
### Available Job Positions
1. **Academic Faculty:**
- Professor (BPS-21 / TTS)
- Associate Professor (BPS-20 / TTS)
- Assistant Professor (BPS-19 / TTS)
- Lecturer (BPS-18)
2. **Support & Contingent Staff:**
- Junior Clerk (BPS-11)
- Laboratory Attendant (BPS-05)
- Security Guard & Support Staff
### Detailed Eligibility & Qualification

- **Faculty Positions:** PhD or MPhil/MS in relevant discipline from an HEC-recognized university as per HEC / PU minimum eligibility criteria. Prior teaching and research publications in impact-factor journals required for senior posts.
- **Staff Positions:** Matriculation / Intermediate with basic IT proficiency and typing speed as specified.
### Key Benefits & Remuneration
- Government BPS Salary Package with regular increments and allowances.
- Medical coverage, provident fund, and university housing eligibility.
- Research grants and international conference travel support for faculty.
### Step-by-Step Application Process
1. **Step 1:** Visit the official PU Careers portal at `https://pu.edu.pk/careers/`.
2. **Step 2:** Select your desired position and print the prescribed fee challan form.
3. **Step 3:** Deposit the application processing fee at any designated Habib Bank Limited (HBL) branch.
4. **Step 4:** Fill out the online application form and upload scanned academic transcripts, CNIC, and paid fee challan.
5. **Step 5:** Submit the application before 5:00 PM on November 30, 2026.
### Required Documents Checklist
- Scanned copies of CNIC, Domicile (Punjab), and Passport size photographs.
- HEC-attested degrees and semester-wise transcripts.
- Paid HBL fee challan receipt.
- Experience certificates and research paper copies (for faculty applicants).
### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

**Q1: Is Punjab University a public or private university?**  
PU is a public government-chartered university established in 1882.

**Q2: What is the last date to submit faculty applications?**  
The application deadline for academic faculty posts is **November 30, 2026**.
### Final Important Note
Incomplete applications or forms submitted without HEC-attested degree copies will not be entertained. Keep a printed copy of your submitted application form for future reference.

Candidates researching **SBOTS eligibility criteria**, **OG-2 in bank salary** benefits, and **SBOTS careers** preparation can review the verified State Bank of Pakistan framework below and monitor [sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/) for the next official advertisement.

## Overview of the State Bank Officer Training Scheme (SBOTS)

The **State Bank Officer Training Scheme (SBOTS)** is the flagship merit-based induction programme of the **State Bank of Pakistan (SBP)**—Pakistan's central bank—for recruiting entry-level **Assistant Directors (Officer Grade-2 / OG-2)**.

Selected candidates undergo rigorous residential classroom and applied central-banking training at the **National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF)** in Islamabad before assuming permanent responsibilities across monetary policy, banking supervision, foreign exchange operations, financial stability, payment systems, and economic research at **SBP Head Office (I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi)** and SBP Banking Services Corporation (SBP-BSC) field offices nationwide.

## Verified SBOTS Eligibility Criteria (Assistant Director OG-2)

Based on official State Bank of Pakistan SBOTS recruitment notifications, candidates must fulfill the following academic, grade, and age requirements:

| ELIGIBILITY PARAMETER | OFFICIAL SBP SBOTS REQUIREMENT |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Eligible Disciplines** | Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems & Technology, Mathematics, Statistics, Human Resources, Law, Media/Communications, or Agriculture |
| **Academic Qualification** | Minimum **16 years of education** (Master's or 4-year Bachelor's degree) from an **HEC-recognized** Pakistani university or an equivalent foreign degree with HEC equivalency |
| **Minimum Marks / CGPA** | At least **60% aggregate marks** where the percentage system applies, OR minimum **2.50 out of 4.00 CGPA** (or **3.50 out of 5.00 CGPA**) where the GPA system applies |
| **Maximum Age Limit** | **26 years** as of the closing date of applications |
| **Age Relaxation Rules** | Upper age limit is relaxed by **3 years (up to 29 years)** for candidates holding valid domicile of **FATA/Merged Districts, Gilgit-Baltistan (Northern Areas), Balochistan, and Azad Jammu & Kashmir (AJK)**, and by **5 years (up to 31 years)** for existing SBP employees fulfilling academic criteria |

## Competitive Examination, Selection Stages & NIBAF Training

Induction under SBOTS is strictly merit-based and follows provincial/regional quota allocations prescribed by the Federal Government:

1. **Phase 1 — Written Recruitment Test:** Administered nationwide by SBP's designated testing agency, evaluating **English Comprehension & Composition**, **Quantitative & Analytical Reasoning**, and **Pakistan Economy, Current Affairs & General Knowledge**.
2. **Phase 2 — Group Discussion & Psychometric Assessment:** Candidates qualifying the written cut-off are invited for group exercises and psychometric evaluations assessing leadership, policy analysis, and communication.
3. **Phase 3 — Final Panel Interview:** Conducted by senior SBP executives across regional centers.
4. **Phase 4 — Residential Training at NIBAF Islamabad:** Finalists join as **Trainee Assistant Directors (OG-2)** at the **National Institute of Banking and Finance (NIBAF), Sector H-8/1, Islamabad**, completing applied central-banking training prior to confirmation at SBP Karachi or SBP-BSC offices.

## OG-2 Salary Structure, Perks & Career Progression in SBP

Candidates searching for **OG-2 in bank salary** and central bank compensation under SBOTS receive a comprehensive package governed by State Bank of Pakistan service rules:

- **Consolidated Monetized Monthly Salary Scale:** SBP offers a competitive consolidated monetized monthly salary package in the **OG-2 pay scale** (the exact rupee figure is specified in each batch's official advertisement and is periodically revised by the SBP Board of Directors).
- **Central Bank Medical & Loan Benefits:** Comprehensive medical facility for self, spouse, children, and dependent parents; concessional staff house-building, motor-car, and personal loan schemes; Contributory Provident Fund; and Gratuity in accordance with SBP rules.
- **International Higher Education:** Confirmed SBP OG-2 officers are eligible to compete for fully sponsored international Master's and PhD scholarships at top global universities after completing the required service tenure.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q1: What is the SBOTS eligibility criteria for Assistant Director (OG-2)?**
Applicants must hold a 16-year Master's or 4-year Bachelor's degree from an HEC-recognized university in an eligible discipline with at least **60% marks** (or **2.50/4.00 CGPA** / **3.50/5.00 CGPA**) and be no more than **26 years old** (relaxable by 3 years for Balochistan, AJK, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Ex-FATA domiciles, and 5 years for SBP employees).

**Q2: Are SBP SBOTS Batch 27, 28, or 29 applications currently open?**
No. Batches 27 and 28 have completed recruitment, and Batch 29 online registration closed on **14 September 2026**. Future SBOTS batches are announced exclusively on [sbp.org.pk/careers/](https://www.sbp.org.pk/careers/).

**Q3: What does the OG-2 salary and benefits package at State Bank of Pakistan include?**
Assistant Directors (OG-2) receive a consolidated monetized monthly salary under the SBP OG-2 scale (announced in each cycle's official notice), plus family & parental medical coverage, concessional staff housing and vehicle loans, Provident Fund, and Gratuity.

title: Engro Corporation Management Trainee Program 2026
shortDescription: Engro Corporation’s flagship Management Trainee Program is open for fresh graduates across business and engineering backgrounds.
content: Engro Corporation has opened applications for its Management Trainee Programme 2026, one of the most competitive graduate hiring programmes in Pakistan, spanning its fertiliser, energy, foods and chemical businesses.
Eligible candidates should hold a BBA, Engineering or MBA degree (16 years of education) with a strong academic record, and should have no more than one year of prior work experience.
The selection process includes an online aptitude assessment, case study exercise, assessment centre and a final interview panel with senior leadership.
Trainees will undergo an 18-month structured rotation across functions before a permanent placement based on business need and individual performance.
Interested candidates should apply through the Engro careers portal before the stated closing date.
